fdroid:com.jjrapps.sleepnoise.name: Sleep Noise
fdroid:com.jjrapps.sleepnoise.summary: Noise to sleep, or to cover the room around you. Plays when you open it.
fdroid:com.jjrapps.sleepnoise.description:
Sleep Noise generates noise to help you sleep, and to cover the room around you when you cannot leave it. Open it and it plays — there is nothing to press.
Four sounds, and not one more. No catalogue to scroll through, no mix to configure at two in the morning: each one does something different.
• Masking, the one it starts with. Its shape is built to cover conversation: it puts 71 % of its energy in the band where speech lives, against brown noise's 9 %. This is the one you want with headphones on in a room full of people.
• Pink, the balanced one. The one hearing perceives as most natural, because it spreads equal energy across every octave.
• White, flat across the spectrum. Good at covering sharp, sudden sounds.
• Brown, deep and enveloping, closer to distant rain or the sea in the background. The most comfortable for sleeping, and the least able to cover a conversation.
The noise is not a recording: it is generated on your phone, sample by sample, as you listen. That means there is no loop that repeats until you start noticing it, and none of the metallic texture that compressed audio leaves behind when it tries to compress something with no structure in it. It sounds as clean in the eighth hour as in the first.
The sleep timer stops the sound whenever you say: in fives up to half an hour, in tens up to an hour, then 90 or 120 minutes. At the end the volume fades down through the last minute instead of cutting out, because an abrupt stop wakes up the person who was finally falling asleep.
You can control it without opening the app: the notification lets you pause, change sound and add ten minutes to the timer, and your headphone button works too. Close the app and put the phone face down — the sound keeps going.
It covers the noise the phone itself makes, too: while the sound plays it switches Do Not Disturb on for you, and off again when you stop. Alarms still get through, because it keeps the exceptions you already set. Android insists that permission is granted by hand, so the app explains it once and takes you to the screen; if you would rather it left your phone alone, turn it off in Settings.
And when you press pause, that is that: the notification clears itself away and nothing is left hanging around. Listening again means opening the app, which is what you were going to do anyway.
The interface is dark, always. There is no light mode, and that is not an oversight: this app gets used in bed with the lights off, and a white screen there is blinding.
No accounts, no cloud, no ads and no tracking. The app never uses the internet: it does not even request the permission to connect, so it could not do it if it wanted to.
What you get:
• Four noises generated on your device: masking, pink, white and brown.
• Plays as soon as you open the app, with the last sound you were listening to.
• Sleep timer with a gradual fade out, and a button to add ten minutes.
• Do Not Disturb switched on for you while it plays, optional, with alarms untouched.
• Control from the notification and from your headphones; pausing clears the notification away.
• Its own volume, independent of the system media volume.
• Keeps playing with the screen off and the app closed.
• English and Spanish.
• No internet, no accounts, no ads, no tracking.

fdroid:es.jjrh.bikeradar.name: Bike Radar
fdroid:es.jjrh.bikeradar.summary: Overlay and audio alerts for BLE bike radars. Offline, no account, no cloud.
fdroid:es.jjrh.bikeradar.description:
Bike Radar shows and sounds what your rear bike radar sees, on top of whatever app you are already running.
A thin strip down the edge of the screen shows each approaching vehicle's distance, closing speed and lateral position. Tiered beeps rise as the closest vehicle gets nearer, and a distinct urgent tone fires when an impact looks imminent - including while you are rolling slowly toward a junction with a fast vehicle behind. A clear chime sounds when the radar sees nothing left within your alert distance.
Everything runs on your phone: no account, no cloud, no analytics. The optional Home Assistant integration publishes ride stats to your own server and nowhere else. Another app on your phone can ask to use your radar, and nothing reaches it until you allow it on a screen naming the app; that handover happens on the device, app to app.
Features:
- Live overlay with per-vehicle distance, closing speed and lateral position
- Tiered proximity beeps, urgent imminent-impact tone, all-clear chime
- Post-ride summary notification: overtakes, close passes, distance, tightest pass
- Front camera/light auto mode by local sunset (from a rough area, read while the app is open)
- Bosch Smart System eBike telemetry, strictly read-only
- Walk-away and forgot-to-lock reminders
- Optional Home Assistant publishing: batteries, close passes, ride summaries
- Sharing with another app on your phone (with your permission): the radar feed, and if you also allow it control of your tail light and hiding the overlay
- Optional on-device capture log for diagnostics, off by default and never uploaded
- English and Spanish
Requires a supported rear radar paired over Bluetooth (pair it once in system Settings) and Android 12 or newer. There is no standard Bluetooth profile for bike radars, so support is per model; the compatibility list on the project's source page says which units work, and the list is short.
A radar that reports distance only is expected to get the approach beeps, the all-clear and an overlay coloured by distance; the per-vehicle speed and side readouts, the urgent tone and close-pass counting need one that also reports closing speed and lateral position. The radar, camera and eBike integrations degrade gracefully: each works without the others.
Bike Radar is a riding aid, not a safety guarantee. It supplements your own attention and mirrors - it never replaces them.
This is an independent open-source project (GPL-3.0-or-later), not affiliated with or endorsed by any radar or eBike manufacturer.

fdroid:org.osservatorionessuno.bugbane.b.name: Bugbane Beta
fdroid:org.osservatorionessuno.bugbane.b.summary: Beta channel of Bugbane, a guided forensic self-triage tool for Android
fdroid:org.osservatorionessuno.bugbane.b.description:
This is the beta channel of Bugbane, released ahead of the stable app for early testing. Expect rough edges; it installs alongside the stable app. 
 Bugbane is an open-source Android application designed to help users perform basic forensic self-triage on their own devices. It uses Wireless ADB to collect the same type of data that tools like AndroidQF or MVT would extract, but without requiring external computers, cables, or command-line expertise.
 Requirements 
 Wireless ADB must be available on your device (Android 11+).
 A Wi-Fi connection to pair the device locally.
 Basic understanding that this tool is for self-triage and cannot guarantee detection.
 Features 
 A step-by-step wizard to guide you through enabling developer options, pairing ADB, and preparing for acquisition.
 One-click forensic acquisition of relevant device logs and configurations.
 Encrypted export options through system dialogs, Signal, or email.
 Ability to delete or rename existing acquisitions locally.
 Indicators of compromise are periodically updated from mvt-indicators .
 Ability to keep acquisitions on device, and scan them multiple times using new indicators, to detect past compromises.
 Security and Privacy 
 Bugbane does not transmit your data automatically. All exports remain on-device until you decide to share them with trusted organizations or analysts.
 Planned Improvements 
 Streamlined workflows for collaborating organizations.
 Localization and accessibility enhancements.
 Automated rescan of past acquisitions after each indicators update.
 Translations 
 Help us improve translations and documentation by contributing via our GitHub repository .
 Important Notice 
 Bugbane is intended for individuals who suspect their device may be compromised by stalkerware, spyware, or non-consensual forensics, however no app can confirm if your phone is clean. If you have strong reasons to believe your device is compromised, consider using a separate trusted device and consult with professionals.

flathub:org.babelserver.spekter.name: Spekter
flathub:org.babelserver.spekter.description:
Visual GUI tool for recursive directory and file comparison.
 Side-by-side and unified diff views with synchronized scrolling,
 inline character-level highlighting, Meld-style Bezier gutter
 connectors and a tabbed interface. It follows your light or dark
 system theme.
 Binary files are detected and reported with sizes rather than
 rendered as garbled text. Spekter detects when JSON or JSONL files
 differ only in element ordering, and applies hunk-slider
 postprocessing so an inserted object in a JSON array is marked as
 one whole object.
 Code and data files are syntax coloured, with grammars for a lot of
 languages built in and more available as plugins: a plugin is just a
 folder of Sublime Text grammar files, with no code to install.
 Colouring is instant.
 Large files stay responsive: a file's text appears instantly while
 its diff is computed on a background thread, computed diffs are
 cached, and the changed files are prefetched as you browse, so
 opening or revisiting them feels immediate even at a million lines.
 Ignored entries (.git, node_modules, editor swap files and the
 like) are skipped but listed as dimmed stubs rather than silently
 erased, and the rules go both ways: expand an ignored directory or
 open an ignored file to compare it anyway, or right-click any entry
 to ignore it yourself. These choices are remembered per directory
 pair.
 An instant, keyboard-driven alternative to Meld and diff for
 comparing folders and code.

fedora-packages:levmar/levmar.name: levmar
fedora-packages:levmar/levmar.description: levmar is a native ANSI C implementation of the Levenberg-Marquardt optimization algorithm. Both unconstrained and constrained (under linear equations, inequality and box constraints) Levenberg-Marquardt variants are included. The LM algorithm is an iterative technique that finds a local minimum of a function that is expressed as the sum of squares of nonlinear functions. It has become a standard technique for nonlinear least-squares problems and can be thought of as a combination of steepest descent and the Gauss-Newton method. When the current solution is far from the correct on, the algorithm behaves like a steepest descent method: slow, but guaranteed to converge. When the current solution is close to the correct solution, it becomes a Gauss-Newton method.

Black Menu for Google gives you quick access to your favorite Google services with a convenient drop-down menu that lets you use Gmail, Drive, Search, Translate, and many others without leaving the page you’re on. Click on menu items to get a small windowed preview or click on the open in new button on the right to open them in a new tab.
Customize the menu by pointing at ‘Add’ and dragging/clicking the services you want from a comprehensive list of services. To remove services, drag them to the right to remove them.
Access these and more with Black Menu for Google:
Google Search. Quickly search the web or switch tabs to search for images, books, news, etc.—all within the mini window.
Google Translate. Type or paste text into the box to get a quick translation for that comment you received in a foreign language. View your translate history and save your favorite ones.
Google Maps. Find the next restaurant to try out by using the mini map that has search, Street View, and layers for satellite, traffic, public transport and cycling.
YouTube. Watch popular videos or those recommended to you. Do a search and filter the results to find that one video you wanted to share. Sign in to find useful shortcuts at the bottom.
Google News. Read top news from your locale or any country you choose. Also browse sections like World, Business, Sci/Tech and Entertainment. Use search to find news about any topic.
Gmail. Get a full-featured Gmail inbox to check or send mail from. Reply to colleagues, edit labels, forward emails, or archive them—do almost everything Gmail can do right from the menu.
Google Drive. Browse folders or search for files in a nice familiar layout. View your documents as a list or see images in a grid view. Click the add button to upload files or make new ones.
Google Calendar. See your upcoming events summarized in a list. Toggle which calendars you’d like to see from the side drawer or just search for specific events.
Google Keep. Create lists, reminders, or paste snippets from the web. All your notes are here, including archived ones. Organize and rearrange them as you want.
Apps page. Access shortcuts to common (and obscure) Google websites like Google Contacts, Google Groups, Google Art Project, Google Follow Your World and 500+ more!

bluejetty:00040899:ios.summary:

Every wall has a story to tell. WallPictureApp helps you bring those stories to life by visua
bluejetty:00040899:ios.description:
WallPictureApp helps artists, photographers, and designers in presenting their artworks to fans or clients in a professional and engaging manner.
Every wall has a story to tell. WallPictureApp helps you bring those stories to life by visualizing your art, photos, paintings, and designs on any wall in realistic room settings. See how your cherished memories or creative visions can transform your space before you even lift a nail & hammer.
For artists and photographers looking to sell their work, WallPictureApp is the perfect sales tool. Showcase your creations on our diverse collection of walls to help potential buyers visualize them in their homes, or take it a step further by importing photos of their own walls for a truly personalized preview.
KEY FEATURES
• Augmented Reality (AR): Place your art on any real-world wall, resize it, and view it from any angle for a truly immersive preview
• 300+ Premium Walls: Explore a diverse collection of stunning backgrounds in different categories (Living Room, Bedroom, Office, Gallery, Close Up,…)
• Picture your art in either landscape or portrait—whichever orientation you prefer
• Tell your story with multiple artworks on a single wall
• Square, rectangle, or even round art? WallPictureApp handles it all
• Create separate projects for different rooms or clients
• Offer your clients a personalized art preview experience by importing photos of their own walls
• Dark mode provides a visually enjoyable experience, regardless of lighting conditions
• Export high-resolution images of your wall displays (choose predefined or custom crop ratios)
• Easily share your masterpiece with your fans or clients via your favorite platforms (Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp, Email, iMessage,…)
BENEFITS
• Give your clients instant visual previews & boost your sales
• Create professional presentations with stunning realism
• Simple to use! Save time and effort with an intuitive, user-friendly interface
EXTENSIVE EDITING OPTION
• Create realistic scenes by placing your art behind existing objects in the wall preview
• Create professional-looking presentations with customizable mats and frames
• Add shadows to enhance the depth and realism of your mockups
• Enhance your art with various professional photo effects (black & white, sepia, and more)
• Rotate or precisely scale your image in any direction
• Present your artwork in accurate real-world dimensions (inches/cm)
• Unleash your creativity with freeform PNG image support
FLEXIBLE PRICING
• Free to use: You can use the app at no cost, and as a bonus, we provide 6 free walls
• Small project? We’ve got you covered; No commitment is needed. Use credits to pay as you go
• Don’t want to feel restricted? Choose any of our subscription options that offer you flexibility
• Gain lifetime access with a single payment. You will never have to pay for anything else in our app!
Use the app that offers realistic wall visualization and showcase your art or photography like never before—in just seconds!
Get the most out of the app and connect with the WallPictureApp community!
Discover daily art inspiration, see stunning user-created mockups, and learn valuable tips and tricks
SOCIAL MEDIA
• Follow us on Instagram @wallpictureapp
• Like us on Facebook WallPictureApp
• Check tutorials on YouTube @wallpictureapp
• Visit our website https://wallpicture.app
We are here to assist with any questions or suggestions. Chat with real humans!
SUPPORT
• Contact us via the contact form in the app (the best option)
• Direct message us on Instagram @wallpictureapp
• Use a contact form on our website https://wallpicture.app
• Simply send an email to hello@wallpicture.app
Terms of use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Created with passion by professional photographer Milan Zarecky & Team © 2016-2026

Nosh makes everyday payments effortless, whether you’re topping up airtime, paying utility bills, booking flights, funding accounts, or handling international bill obligations. It’s a single app with all the features you need to make fast, secure digital transactions across Nigeria, Ghana, and beyond.

1. Purchase & Activate eSIM for Instant Mobile Data 
2. Pay International Bills With Local Wallets
3. Book Flights To Anywhere

4. Responsive customer service and in-app live chat
5. High-level encryption, trust, and security

Nosh is your all-in-one app for fast and secure digital payments in Nigeria and Ghana.
With Nosh, you can easily manage everyday transactions from one simple platform.

• Pay electricity, internet, and cable TV bills
• Pay international bills
• Book local and international flights
• Fund your betting accounts
• Top up your wallet with a personalised virtual account
• Withdraw funds to your bank account
• Redeem Nosh gift codes
• Purchase and activate eSIM
• Earn rewards through referrals and user levels
WHY YOU’LL LOVE NOSH

• Secure and encrypted payments
• 24/7 availability
• Responsive in-app customer support
Nosh makes digital payments simple, convenient, and accessible all in one place.
Download Nosh today and handle your payments with ease.

Stress Relief: Relax with calming puzzles after a long day

No Pressure: Play casually or challenge yourself with difficult levels

Regular puzzle play can help improve:

bluejetty:00044994:ios.description:
Z5 Mobile – The best video call experience, wherever life takes you.
With Z5 Mobile, the industry’s premier VRS (Video Relay Service) app, deaf and hard-of-hearing individuals can make and receive videophone calls anywhere using Wi-Fi or a cellular data connection. And now we’ve completely redesigned this app to bring you the top features and experience in the industry. 
Recent updates now include text chat, the ability to share a follow-up number with an interpreter straight from your contact list, and even the power to block unwanted callers. Our users love our intuitive user interface with a choice of two themes and the sort your contact list by first or last name. You’ll also enjoy the ability to quickly review, record or delete your Video Mail greeting from your phone. Even when you're not using the app, you can now receive full-screen notifications at the moment a call is incoming.
Z5 Mobile still has all the great features users have come to expect including Number Lookup, powered by Google Maps, to help you find phone numbers and conduct map searches without having to leave the app. No matter where you go, there’s no better way to keep in touch!
Download/upgrade Z5 Mobile today and tell us what you think.

bluejetty:00095600:ios.description:
Welcome to Hexa Color: Sort Puzzle – a fun and relaxing game where you sort, arrange, and combine colorful hexagon blocks in 3D!
The rules are simple: move the hexagon pieces, match blocks of the same color, and clear the board. Think carefully, plan your moves, and enjoy the feeling of making the perfect combination. Whether you want to challenge your brain or just relax for a while, this game is perfect for you!
FEATURES:
- Easy to learn, fun to master gameplay
- Beautiful 3D graphics with bright colors
- Hundreds of exciting levels to complete
- Smooth and satisfying drag-and-drop controls
- Relaxing ASMR sound effects
- Useful boosters to help you solve tricky puzzles.
HOW TO PLAY:
- Drag the hexagon pieces and place them on the board.
- Match blocks of the same color to make them disappear.
- Arrange carefully to clear all pieces and win the level.
- Use boosters when you get stuck to make things easier!
Start your colorful puzzle journey with Hexa Color: Sort Puzzle today! Enjoy simple, satisfying gameplay that helps you relax and train your brain at the same time. Download now and have fun sorting!

bluejetty:00071035:ios.name: Wordzee! - Puzzle Word Game
bluejetty:00071035:ios.summary:
You can train your brain as you make words, play with friends, and compete in different word games and word game modes in new Wordzee.
Show off your puzzle solving, spelling, and anagram word skills as you search for the best scoring word
bluejetty:00071035:ios.description:
You can train your brain as you make words, play with friends, and compete in different word games and word game modes in new Wordzee.
Show off your puzzle solving, spelling, and anagram word skills as you search for the best scoring word combination in this exciting, free, new, word game.
Wordzee is a new twist in word puzzle, anagram, and crossword games! It is free to play, and there are so many new words to make and ways to play!
Roll your word tiles like dice, build words and play them on the board to get the highest score as you connect with friends in thrilling matches. Play classic matches in order to try and win against other players by building the biggest word score and making a Wordzee! Can you fill all of the rows on the board with words of the correct length to get a huge Wordzee point boost to your score?
START PLAYING
Your new word puzzle game playing experience starts here! Start a new game with friends or family members who love word puzzles, dice games, and crossword puzzles. 
Or you can start a classic match with a new opponent. 
Shuffle the word tiles to find the highest scoring word on the board and play your move. Then it’s time for your opponent to try and find their best word to play. Why not start another game with a friend while they are playing!
PLAY WORDZEE AT FULL SPEED
Choose an instant game so you can play Wordzee in a quick game mode. Make words from the anagrams and play your tiles to get high scores with no waiting between rounds
IMPROVE YOUR SKILLS IN THE WORDZEE SOLO MODE CHALLENGES
Flex your word finding muscles in Journeys. Specially themed rounds let you explore and play your way to the top of the word map. Can your anagram and word puzzle skills get your word brain moving enough so you can complete the journey?
Play the High Score challenge and build the highest scoring words in a round to win exciting rewards. Play your best words to take your word puzzle game skills to the next level.
Can you make it to the top in the Showdown mode? Supersized tile values let you build huge scores against Kevin the Wordzee mascot. Use your word puzzle skills and play to win!
Totaliser lets you build your score the more you play. The game is to carry on playing great words to get high scores, build totals, and win rewards! 
CUSTOMIZE YOUR TILE STYLE
Show off your word game style and skills as you unlock special letter tiles like the cute teddy bear, sushi, or watermelon
Special seasonal tiles mean your word games always look good
Love word puzzles and word games? Love Wordzee? Like us on Facebook or follow us on Twitter to stay up-to-date on MAG word game news, special contests, polls and lots of other fun stuff.
www.facebook.com/wordzeegame
www.twitter.com/wordzeegame
www.instagram.com/wordzeegame
Wordzee has been lovingly created by MAG Interactive, where we take fun seriously. We’ve made word games, puzzle games and fun social games on mobile for 10 years. Download Wordzee now!
Good Times!
Additional Information:
The Wordzee game is free to play. In-app purchases are available for additional content and in-game currency.

bluejetty:00042007:ios.description:
Business Guru: Tycoon Simulator is more than just a business simulation game. It's an engaging and interactive experience that puts you in the driver's seat of your own business empire. Make strategic decisions, take calculated risks, and watch your empire flourish.
Install Business Guru: Tycoon Simulator and explore a wide range of opportunities to build and expand your empire. You can start businesses in six diverse categories, including retail, hospitality, finance, and more. Hire employees, make key decisions, and see your profits soar as you grow your enterprises.
For those with a keen interest in the stock market, Business Guru: Tycoon Simulator allows you to buy virtual shares in well-known companies. Monitor your investments closely to maximize your earnings. Additionally, you can venture into real estate investments, purchasing properties in prestigious locations to generate passive income and boost your net worth. Players can also delve into the exciting world of cryptocurrencies, buying and selling to capitalize on market trends.
Luxury items play a significant role in enhancing your status and prestige within the game. Purchase high-end vehicles, private jets, and even expand your fleet and hangar to travel in style.
Overall, Business Guru: Tycoon Simulator offers a highly immersive and interactive business management experience. Whether you aspire to build and manage a store or a bank, become a savvy investor, or indulge in luxury purchases, this game has something for everyone. The engaging gameplay provides endless possibilities for you to build your empire and become a true Business Guru.
Download Business Guru: Tycoon Simulator now and start your journey to entrepreneurial success!

bluejetty:00031963:ios.description:
Make every screen feel more like yours.
Keep useful information close with widgets, then bring your Home Screen together with wallpapers, themes, and icons. OneWidget helps you personalize your Home Screen, Lock Screen, and Dynamic Island in one place.
HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
Mix clocks, calendars, countdowns, health stats, football fixtures, weather, photos, text, and app launchers. Choose a size, layout, font, color, and background. Create a transparent look, pick from a range of clock faces, and keep favorite apps within reach.
LOCK SCREEN & DYNAMIC ISLAND
Decorate your Lock Screen with widget combinations, animated artwork, icons, and text. On supported devices, explore pet, holiday, relaxation, health, launcher, and football activities. Customize the content and appearance of the Dynamic Island Top Bar in its expanded and compact views to make it your own.
DUO MOCKUP
Place photos or videos on both screens of a foldable device mockup. Choose the device finish and background, build fold animations with keyframes, and export a video of your design.
THEMES & WALLPAPERS
Explore curated wallpapers and Home Screen themes. Pair them with app icons and widgets for a consistent look.
PERMISSIONS & SUBSCRIPTIONS
OneWidget asks for permission when features need access to Health, calendars, or reminders. You can manage access in system settings. Some content requires OneWidget Pro. In the United States, the current subscription prices are $0.99 per month or $5.99 per year; prices elsewhere and the final charge are shown at checkout. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm. The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the current period ends. Manage or cancel it in your Apple Account subscription settings.
Feature availability varies by device and system version. Share feedback at hi@onenice.tech.

bluejetty:00134094:ios.description:
Interval Flow: Experience a Workout Revolution
Interval Flow is your ultimate fitness companion, designed to transform your workout experience with deep customization and advanced tracking. This versatile app is perfect for a wide range of activities including HIIT, TABATA, CrossFit, Yoga, Pilates, Meditation, and more. With Interval Flow, you can stay focused on your fitness goals while the app handles the details.
Key Features:
- Color-Coded Intervals: Customize your workout visually with color-coded intervals. Set distinct colors for warm-ups, high-intensity bursts, rest periods, and more, to easily navigate through your routine.

bluejetty:00027252:ios.summary: Welcome to Tile Star: Match Puzzle Game, where relaxing tile matching meets the glamorous world of fashion makeovers! If you enjoy challenging your brain while transforming your characters with stunning fashion, this game is your perfect ma
bluejetty:00027252:ios.description:
Welcome to Tile Star: Match Puzzle Game, where relaxing tile matching meets the glamorous world of fashion makeovers! If you enjoy challenging your brain while transforming your characters with stunning fashion, this game is your perfect match. Dive into a world of endless puzzles, stylish outfits, and satisfying makeovers, all designed to keep you entertained for hours.
Challenging Tile Match Puzzles
Sharpen your brain with tile-matching puzzles that will test your skills and strategy! In Tile Star, you’ll find beautifully crafted 3D tiles waiting to be matched. The gameplay is simple but addictive: match identical tiles to clear the board. With hundreds of levels, ranging from easy to challenging, you’ll never run out of puzzles to solve! Whether you’re an expert or just starting out, Tile Star has something for every player.
Addictive Gameplay
Start each level with a board full of colorful and unique tiles. Your mission? Match three identical tiles to clear them from the board. But don’t get too comfortable—space is limited, and strategy is key. As you advance, new elements and tricky layouts will challenge your puzzle-solving abilities, keeping the gameplay fresh and exciting. With special power-ups and boosters to assist you, you can clear tough levels, achieve high scores, and unlock stylish rewards.
Unleash Your Inner Stylist
But that’s not all – once you complete puzzles, it’s time for a makeover! Choose from a wide variety of fashionable outfits, hairstyles, and accessories to transform your characters. Whether it’s prepping for a romantic date or crafting a runway-ready look, the possibilities are endless. Match tiles, unlock new styles, and show off your fashion sense as you help your characters look their best.
Express Your Fashion Flair
After each successful puzzle, dive into the world of fashion and beauty! Use your rewards to create stunning looks with a variety of trendy outfits, elegant dresses, chic accessories, and dazzling makeup styles. Whether you want a glamorous red carpet appearance or a fun, casual vibe, the customization options let you tailor each character’s makeover to fit the occasion. With each level you conquer, unlock even more fashion-forward styles to complete the ultimate transformations.
Key Features
Challenging Tile Puzzles: Start with easy levels and work your way up to more complex puzzles that will test your skills.
Fashion Makeovers: Unlock fabulous outfits, hairstyles, and makeup options.
Relaxing & Brain-Training: Enjoy a perfect balance of fun and mental engagement with every tile you match.
Large, Easy-to-Read Tiles: Designed for players of all ages, especially those who enjoy brain-training puzzles.
Power-ups & Boosters: Use them to overcome challenging puzzles and unlock more styles faster.
Offline Play: Play anytime, anywhere – no internet required!
A World of Makeovers & Style
From casual looks to glamorous makeovers, your fashion choices make every transformation exciting. Create the perfect look for every occasion and let your creativity shine. Fashion meets fun as you mix and match outfits, complete puzzles, and immerse yourself in this tile-matching makeover adventure.
Relax & Train Your Brain
Whether you’re looking to relax after a long day or give your brain a workout, this game is perfect for you. The soothing background music, satisfying tile matches, and creative makeovers provide the perfect mental escape while keeping your mind sharp.
Download now and start your tile-matching and makeover journey today! Transform puzzles and people as you master both tiles and trends. With hundreds of levels and countless style options, this game is sure to keep you entertained for hours!

bluejetty:00085073:ios.description:
Sunshine Village Banff is your official guide to Sunshine Village Resort, all at your fingertips. 
• See which runs are groomed and which closed. Locate yourself on the trail map — not a hard-to-read GPS map.†
• Share your location on the mountain with friends, and see your friends' locations on the trail map.†
• Record your runs and log vertical feet and distance. If you have an Apple Watch, record your runs as a workout and see your workout in the Health app. Display your tracks and replay your runs on the trail map. • Get up-to-the-minute lift status information.
• Quickly find information about lessons and other programs and amenities.
• Easily locate and contact key places at the resort and in the village with the built in directory.
• Learn about events from the events calendar.
• Get the latest news from Sunshine Village via the resort's Twitter feed and Facebook posts.
† Location and Logging services require a GPS-equipped device. Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00146058:ios.name: AnyTrans: Send Files Anywhere
bluejetty:00146058:ios.summary: AnyTrans is an iOS content transfer app to transfer files across iPhone, iPad, other phones/tablets, computer, even cloud drives. AnyTrans can manage diverse categories of data on computer in a more stable way. No matter you want to send ph
bluejetty:00146058:ios.description:
AnyTrans is an iOS content transfer app to transfer files across iPhone, iPad, other phones/tablets, computer, even cloud drives. AnyTrans can manage diverse categories of data on computer in a more stable way. No matter you want to send photos, share videos, transfer music, copy contacts, or upload files to cloud, it goes wirelessly and instantly. You can send files to anywhere in any way you like! 
1. Fast File Transfer from Phone to Phone
- Copy data/files from iPhone to iPhone, iPhone to iPad, iPhone to other phones/tablets. 
- Move data/files from old phone to the new iPhone/iPad for device switch without erasing data. 
- Browse iPhone/iPad photos, music, videos, movies, contacts by category to back up and share files you want. 
- Direct phone-to-phone transfer via same wifi or hotspot. And simply air content to start file transfer.
- Compatible with all iPhone/iPad/iPod touch running iOS 9.0 and above, including iOS 14.
2. Wireless transfer between iPhone/iPad and Computer- Export photo, music, movie, document, etc. whatever data & files from iPhone/iPad to computer.- Manage your content in the safest way on computer. (Selectively back up iPhone/iPad to computer without USB using)- Air display iPhone/iPad video, movie, music from iPhone/iPad to computer, and play it on the big screen.- Import photos, music, contacts, files like PDF, Word, etc., from PC/Mac to iPhone/iPad without installing any program on computer.- Work with all web browsers running IE 9 or later, such as Google Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Opera, etc.
3. File Explorer and File Downloader for Multiple Cloud Drives
- View files and folders from iCloud Drive, Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox within one single app on iPhone/iPad. 
- Send, move, delete, rename, upload or download photos, videos, documents, and more from Google Drive, Dropbox, iCloud Drive, etc. 
- Back up photos/live photo/music, save files/documents, copy videos/movies and more to cloud drives. 
- Protected by 256-bit SSL encryption when uploading and downloading files/documents.
- AnyTrans never retains any of your data or information on our servers.
4. File Manager and File Organizer for iPhone/iPad Contents 
- Organize iPhone/iPad pictures, live photo, live photo video, music, videos, contacts, documents, zip files by category, and share it as you want, no quality loss.
- Built in an mp3 player and video player to play music, videos, or movies in MP3, MP4, MOV, M4A, or other formats.
- Access and play music synced from iTunes library or music shared from others. 
- Quickly delete multiple contacts at once, and share files with friends, including large files. 
- View iPhone/iPad free storage space, and battery remaining status. 
We're always pleased to hear from you! If you have any feedback, questions, or concerns, please email us at cs@imobie.com
Or connect with us for the latest news and tips:
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/iMobie
Twitter: https://twitter.com/iMobie_Inc
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/user/iMobieInc

bluejetty:00119285:ios.name: Kuwait Finder
bluejetty:00119285:ios.developer: Public Authority For Civil Information (PACI - Kuwait)
bluejetty:00119285:ios.summary:
Kuwait Finder application is developed by The Public Authority for Civil Information to provide users with the following features:
• Login via personal accounts (Apple, Google, Facebook, Twitter), Phone Number, Email Address or login as a
bluejetty:00119285:ios.description:
Kuwait Finder application is developed by The Public Authority for Civil Information to provide users with the following features:
• Login via personal accounts (Apple, Google, Facebook, Twitter), Phone Number, Email Address or login as a Guest to access the full features of Kuwait Finder
• Search for addresses and landmarks by PACI Number
• Find addresses and landmarks by partial, full address or name assisted by an auto-complete search feature
• Search for addresses effortlessly using a quick search via Governorates, Areas, Blocks, Streets and Parcels/Houses
• Search categories to find the closest gas stations, hospitals, cafes, restaurants and more
• Find landmarks on parcels via What Is Here search feature
• Locate and find your current address via current location at anytime
• View funerals and its details including the time and location for each funeral
• View live traffic on a digital or satellite map
• Explore a 360 street-view for any location
• Save any address or location as a favorite, home or work
• Save the location where you parked your car
• View all your search history at anytime
• Get to your destination faster and avoid traffic
• Provide textual and voice instructions during navigation guidance till arrival to the destination
• Introduce Head-up Display (HUD) with realistic view for safer navigation with voice instructions
• Share any location including your current location with other users via social media applications such as WhatsApp
• Receive personalized notifications about PACI news, funerals, or traffic
• Send feedback to The Public Authority for Civil Information to suggest an enhancement or report a problem
Disclaimer:
Kuwait Finder is using the location services when the application is running in the background during navigation to provide guidance notifications and voice instructions. Continued use of location services (GPS) in the background can dramatically decrease the device battery life.

bluejetty:00042406:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00042406:ios.description:
Hey Famm - LGBTQ+ Professional Networking
Finally, a queer networking app built FOR us, BY us. Connect with over 18,000 LGBTQ+ professionals and business owners in a safe, supportive community where authentic relationships drive real opportunities.
PROVEN RESULTS:
• Members landing record-breaking sales through community connections
• Freelancers finding dream clients within their first week
• Business owners growing their customer base through trusted referrals
• Professionals discovering mentors, collaborators, and career opportunities
WHY HEY FAMM WORKS:
• High-Intent Community - No random DMs or spam. Our members return weekly to genuinely connect, support, and do business with one another, built on trust and shared values, through our community feed, messaging, and events.
• Safe Space - Strong code of conduct, terms, and content moderation tools, zero tolerance for hate, sexual advances, spam, and no public profiles mean you can show up fully.
• Business + Social in One - This is a place where you can build meaningful professional relationships and get discovered by a community actively looking to support queer people in work and business.
• Intentional Connections - Connect based on shared vibes, location, and goals like partnerships, mentorships, skill trades, and more. 
• Local & Global - Find LGBTQ+ professionals nearby or across industries based on shared interests. Available in 15+ countries and growing.
• Events & Community - Join virtual and in-person networking events hosted by community members. Promote your events for free. People who save your events will even get a reminder the day before!
• Jobs - Discover curated job opportunities from impact organizations, mostly remote and salary always listed!
WHAT MEMBERS SAY:
"It’s refreshing to have an inclusive space where we can discuss both our professional and personal lives in a warm, supportive environment."
"This is *more* than just LinkedIn for our community. For many of us, it’s how we’ll both grow professionally and stoke our power for years to come."
"Beyond generic networking, I’ve already made genuine connections for myself & my business."
WHO THIS IS FOR:
• LGBTQ+ professionals seeking career growth
• LGBTQ+ business owners wanting more visibility
• Any LGBTQ+ folks looking for a supportive community
• LGBTQ+ professionals tired of impersonal networking platforms
• LGBTQ+ artists, creatives, and entrepreneurs
• LGBTQ+ professionals seeking job opportunities
ADD YOUR BUSINESS & EVENTS:
It's completely free to list your business and events. Our goal is queer economic empowerment through real, meaningful connections. Join us for free today! 
Ready to network with purpose in a community that gets you?
Download Hey Famm and join more than 18,000 LGBTQ+ professionals building careers, businesses, and authentic connections. 
Terms of Use: https://www.heyfamm.com/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://www.heyfamm.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00144934:ios.summary: A Saúde Diária é uma plataforma com programas especialmente desenvolvidos para pessoas acima dos 40 anos de idade, com exercícios fáceis e sem impacto. São programas concentrados em melhorar a mobilidade, recuperação muscular e aceleração d
bluejetty:00144934:ios.description:
A Saúde Diária é uma plataforma com programas especialmente desenvolvidos para pessoas acima dos 40 anos de idade, com exercícios fáceis e sem impacto. São programas concentrados em melhorar a mobilidade, recuperação muscular e aceleração do metabolismo. Incluem treinos com bastão para melhorar a mobilidade, treinos com peso para fortalecer os músculos e diminuir a flacidez muscular, e caminhadas em casa para queimar calorias e aumentar o metabolismo. Esta plataforma é projetada para ajudar as mulheres acima dos 40 anos a se sentirem melhores, mais fortes e saudáveis em geral, com uma atenção especial à segurança dos exercícios.
A Plataforma se fundamenta em 3 pilares:
1° PILAR: EXERCÍCIOS FÁCEIS, RÁPIDOS E SEM IMPACTO: Os exercícios oferecidos pela plataforma Saúde Diária são projetados para serem curtos, fáceis de seguir e sem impacto, para que possam ser realizados por pessoas de todas as idades e níveis de condicionamento físico. Com apenas 10 minutos por dia, os usuários podem já começar a ver resultados na luta contra o sobrepeso e a flacidez.
2° PILAR: COMUNIDADE DE ALIADOS: A plataforma Saúde Diária oferece uma comunidade ativa de mais de 15.000 alunas com o mesmo objetivo, o que permite que os usuários sejam apoiados e motivados pelos outros membros. Essa comunidade também oferece a possibilidade de compartilhar experiências e dicas para manter a motivação.
3° PILAR: SUPORTE: A plataforma Saúde Diária oferece suporte técnico personalizado para ajudar os usuários a entender melhor os exercícios e superar quaisquer dificuldades. Os usuários também têm acesso ao Aurélio Alfieri, o professor fundador e responsável pelo programa, através de uma sessão ao vivo semanal chamada "Café com Aurélio", onde podem esclarecer suas dúvidas.
Instale o aplicativo da plataforma Saúde Diária agora mesmo e tenha sua dose diária de saúde.
===============================
Responsável técnico
Aurélio Alfieri Neto CREF: 009911-G/PR

bluejetty:00180764:ios.name: Accounts 3 Checkbook
bluejetty:00180764:ios.summary:
Top Selling Checkbook App
Accounts 3 is an easy to use application to replace your paper checkbook. With the Accounts 3 application, you will have a quicker and more convenient way to track your daily finances. You can schedule transaction
bluejetty:00180764:ios.description:
Top Selling Checkbook App
Accounts 3 is an easy to use application to replace your paper checkbook. With the Accounts 3 application, you will have a quicker and more convenient way to track your daily finances. You can schedule transactions, transfer funds, capture photo receipts, reconcile, view reports, export data, print, and much more. All features of the Accounts 3 app are designed to be quick, clean, intuitive, and easy to use. 
FEATURES
* Touch and Face ID Support
Use Touch or Face ID to authenticate and launch the app quicker and more conveniently.
* Sync Data via iCloud
Sync your data across iPhone, iPad, and iPod Touch devices
* Universal Binary
Designed for iPhone, iPad, and iPod Touch devices. No need to buy separate apps for each device. 
* Graphs and Reports
Review your monthly income vs. expense, spending by category, or income by category summaries with beautiful graphs and reports. 
* Photo Receipts
Capture and store photo receipt as part of a transaction. 
* AirPrint Support
Print reports directly from your iPhone or iPad to any AirPrint-enabled printer.
* Recurring Transactions
Schedule transactions to repeat weekly, biweekly, monthly, semimonthly, quarterly, biannually, or yearly on a start date that you choose. 
* Split Transactions
Split a transaction among several categories for more precise tracking. 
* Search
Quickly search for transactions and edit them from the same screen or export your search results.
* Reconcile Transactions
Reconcile by checking off cleared transactions and comparing the actual and outstanding balances against a bank statement.
* Smart Autocomplete
As you type, a list will show you your previously entered descriptions and corresponding category. Selecting an entry from the list will fill both fields of the transaction. 
* Auto-increment Check # Field
Accounts 3 will suggest the next check number for you based on the previously entered number. If you replace your checkbook, just enter the new starting number and Accounts 3 will auto-increment from there. 
* Transfers
Make a one-time transfer between accounts or set up recurring transfers to automatically repeat.
* Export in CSV, QIF & HTML Formats
Export transactions via email attachments for used with desktop applications such Numbers, Excel, or MS Money. 
* Customization Settings & Themes
Configurable settings and themes to customize the Accounts 3 application based on your preferences. Themes are now also available in dark mode.
* Transaction Sorting/Hiding
Sort transactions by date in either ascending or descending order. You can also hide reconciled transactions to keep your current list from being cluttered. 
* Accounts Reordering
Reorder your accounts from the account list in any order you choose. 
* Accounts Delete Lock 
Prevents accidental deletion of all the transactions under an account. 
* Backup / Restore 
Backup your data for safekeeping via iCloud, Dropbox, or email. Then restore it to your device whenever you need to.
* Passcode Security
Keep your accounts information private.
* FREE Accounts 3 Lite version
Please download the Accounts 3 Lite version to try before you buy.

The All Classical Portland Radio App allows you to listen to All Classical Portland, pause and rewind the live audio, and view the program schedule all at once! You can explore On Demand content, search for programs, bookmark a program for later, and wake up to All Classical Portland with the alarm clock!
Live Streaming
• DVR-like controls (pause, rewind, and fast forward). You can pause the live stream to have a conversation and pick up right where you left off! Or rewind to catch a comment you just missed!
• Listen to live streams from All Classical Portland even while traveling! Start the app and your favorite station starts playing – no clicks to start listening.
• Integrated program schedules for the All Classical Portland stream! 
• Listen to All Classical Portland in the background while browsing the web or catching up on your emails!
On Demand
• Access All Classical Portland programs easily and quickly.
• DVR-like controls. Pause, rewind and fast forward your program with ease. 
• When listening to programs, individual segments (when available) are listed so you can review and choose one or listen to the entire program.
• Easy to access past programs.
• The All Classical Portland Radio App displays the web page associated with the program or program segment you are listening to On Demand so you can explore for more information.
Additional features
• A built in Sleep Timer and Alarm Clock allows you to go to sleep and wake up to your favorite station.
The All Classical Portland Radio App is brought to you by the people at All Classical Portland and Public Media Apps. We work to provide our valued listeners with great solutions to find what you want, when you want it, and where you want it.
Please support All Classical Portland by becoming a member today!
http://www.allclassical.org
http://www.publicmediaapps.com

bluejetty:00124410:ios.description:
Make Every minute enjoyable with Mahjong Solitaire. Play now!
Get ready for a new, original and challenging Mahjong Solitaire game. The goal in Mahjong Club is to match identical tiles in order to remove them from the board. When all tiles have been removed, you will have solved the mahjong puzzle! Can you complete all 5000+ levels? Install Now!
Features
* Over 5,000 free board setups
* Beautiful landscapes as backgrounds
* Auto Fit
* Choose your own score system:
- No timer no pressure
- Mahjong combi points
- Stars & time
- No score system
* High scores & personal statistics
* Turn sounds on or off
* No Wifi, no problem! Play offline if you wish.
* Join a club, play & chat together
* Simple pick-up-and-play controls
This is how you play Mahjong Club:
► On the Mahjong board, pairs of tiles are dealt at random. The maximum amount of tiles is 144.
► Your task is to find pairs and match them
► A matched pair will be removed from the Mahjong board
► When all tiles are removed from the board, you have completed the level
► Once you have completed a level, you will unlock the next level
► Use a booster when you are having a hard time completing a Mahjong puzzle
► Make sure you are online for the best experience. Offline is possible as well!
Can you beat all the levels in Mahjong Club? Play for free and relax!
Contact & more info:
Many more cool features will be added to Mahjong Club in the coming months. Feel free to let us know what you would like to see in the game!
Terms of Service can be found here: https://www.gamovation.com/legal/tos-qc.pdf
Privacy Policy can be found here: https://www.gamovation.com/legal/privacy-policy.pdf

bluejetty:00044555:ios.description:
Nobody should have to live with a stranger they didn't choose.
Bunky is how you find a roommate before you move in. Someone you actually
picked, in your school or your city.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Pick your community. Your school, or the city you're moving to.
2. Build a profile that's actually you. Photos, prompt answers, your
 dealbreakers, and where you're headed and when.
3. Like the people you could live with. If they like you back, it's a match and
 you can chat.
You can only message someone once you've both liked each other. So the people
you talk to are people who chose you too.
WHAT YOU SEE BEFORE YOU DECIDE
How close their habits are to yours on the stuff that actually causes problems.
Cleanliness, noise, social energy, how much you want to hang out.
Shout outs from people who have actually lived with them.
Mutual friends and linked socials, when people add them.
MOVING TO CAMPUS
Your class already has a community on Bunky. Find your roommate before housing
assignments go out.
ALREADY HAVE A PLACE?
Add it to your profile with rent, move-in date and photos of the place, then
match with people looking to move in.
THINKING ABOUT A MOVE?
Nothing has to be signed yet. Pick the city you're considering and see who's
already there. What they're like, what they're looking for, who's arriving
around the same time as you.
Free to download. 210k+ downloads.

bluejetty:00093017:ios.description:
Store all of your passwords in your iPhone easily and securely.
•• If you are looking for SIMPLICITY and SECURITY of use, as well as EASE in creating a BACKUP COPY of your information, Password Control is the application for you!
••Have you ever needed one of your passwords and didn’t know where it was stored or just didn’t have it on hand? 
••Password Control provides you with totally secure access to your passwords anytime through your iPhone.
FEATURES:
•Password protected access to the Application.
•The passwords you enter are stored in the operating system Keychain for maximum security.
•You can organize your passwords by groups.
•Make a backup copy easily, quickly and securely so you avoid exposing your data to servers that are out of your control.
•The backup copy is created in a protected file, and each file is protected by a different, individual password that no one knows but you.
•Enter or edit your password information with just a couple of taps on the screen
•Passwords are hidden onscreen to avoid prying eyes.
Available languages: English and Spanish
*********************
IMPORTANT: Please be aware that it's very important to backup your data using the app's backup system. For security reasons there is no other way to restore your data.
*********************

bluejetty:00033613:ios.description:
Welcome to the kittengarten! These little restless fuzzballs love to learn and play, but they need your help! Take care of the purring little fellas, and enjoy the fun!
KEEP AN EYE ON KITTIES
Our daycare is bustling with new arrivals, each unique in their own way! Do your best to feed, bathe, and tuck them in at the right time!
EXPLORE THE SUMMER FOREST
Time to go to the lake and catch some yummy fish! You can also fill your basket with juicy apples and pet a playful squirrel. This forest holds as much adventure as many it has trees!
TEACH YOUR FUZZY KITTENGARTNERS
Play with vibrant ABC cubes and learn new words, or delve into numbers and solve math problems! The joy of learning is amplified when shared!
SAVE SEA LIFE
While the kittens were busy building sandcastles and eating ice cream, some sea dwellers got into trouble! Help the brave fuzzballs free fish from a bottle and remove the debris stuck to a turtle. This game teaches kids to care about the environment.
Features:
20+ mini-games for children aged 3–5 years
10 adorable kittens to play with
3 enchanting locations for fun and adventure
Kindergarten simulator mechanics
Exciting way to learn and form good habits
Gameplay for developing kids’ empathy and animal care skills
Fire up our game—it’s purr fun!
Please note: only part of the content in the screenshots is available in the free version of the app. To gain access to all app content, you need to make an in-app purchase.
ABOUT BINI GAMES
Bini Games (ex-Bini Bambini) was started in 2012 by four parents with experience in children's education. And today, we are a 250-people team of dedicated designers, artists, animators, and educators. To date, we have more than 30 apps, with our user base having reached 98M. We are inspired by the idea of bringing fun into early education and enhancing a child's natural love of learning through educational apps for kids.
If you need help, have questions or just want to say “hi!”, get in touch at feedback@bini.games 
https://teachdraw.com/terms-of-use/
https://teachdraw.com/privacy-policy/

This Kids App and its curriculum and analytic capabilities are really taking the educational process to a whole new level. It’s highly recommended this app to all parents who want to build a great future for their kids. Having access to that kind of data can play a huge role in the future of kids.

• Kids can get rewards and certificates for completing milestones.

3. Color & shape recognition
4. Fruit recognition
5. mind focus
6. Logical thinking
7. Problem solving
8. Creativity
9. Self confidence
10. Attentiveness & alertness

bluejetty:00032312:ios.name: UPDF - AI-Powered PDF Editor
bluejetty:00032312:ios.summary: UPDF for iOS is an AI-powered PDF editor for iPhone and iPad. Read, edit, annotate, convert, sign, and AI chat with your PDFs — all from your iOS device. Summarize lengthy documents, translate full PDFs, scan paper to PDF, and manage all yo
bluejetty:00032312:ios.description:
UPDF for iOS is an AI-powered PDF editor for iPhone and iPad. Read, edit, annotate, convert, sign, and AI chat with your PDFs — all from your iOS device. Summarize lengthy documents, translate full PDFs, scan paper to PDF, and manage all your files in one place.
Amazing features of UPDF for iOS:
Edit PDF
- Edit text in PDF (change color, font style, font size)
- Edit images in PDF (rotate, extract, replace, and crop images)
- Edit watermark in PDF (add, edit, delete and favor watermark)
- Edit links in PDF (add, edit, copy, and delete)
AI Assistant
- Summarize, translate, explain, and rephrase lengthy PDFs in minutes.
- Engage in a chat with UPDF AI and ask it any questions you have.
- Summarize or translate PDF by pages.
- Export conversations to Markdown or TXT files.
- NEW AI Bookmark Agent: Auto-generate bookmarks and get instant section summaries for any PDF.
- NEW AI Semantic Search: Search your PDF by meaning, not just exact words.
- NEW AI Editing Suite: Rewrite, refine tone, or correct grammar directly.
Read PDF
- Flexible reading: vertical and horizontal scrolling, single page or two-page view
- Dark mode to protect your eyes
- Add and manage bookmarks with AI Bookmark Agent's help
- Search text in PDF
- Present PDF as a slideshow
- Text-to-speech support
Annotate PDF
- Annotate PDFs using markup tools: pencil, highlight, underline, strikethrough, squiggly line
- Add text boxes, text comments, callouts, sticky notes
- Add shapes, stamps, and stickers to PDFs
- Free-hand drawing on PDF pages
OCR PDF
- Convert scanned documents and images into searchable and editable PDFs
- Recognize text in 38 languages
Scan to PDF
- Scan physical documents to PDF with your camera
- Scan ID cards onto one page
- Crop, rotate, and filter scanned images
Convert PDF
- Convert PDF to Word, Excel, PPT, and images
Organize PDF Pages
- Insert, replace, extract, split, rotate, remove, and reorder pages in PDFs
- Merge multiple PDFs into one file
- Copy, paste, and share specific pages in a PDF
Sign PDF & Fill PDF Form
- Create handwritten signatures
- Import and add image signatures
- Fill PDF form and add e-signatures
- Save signatures to cloud for cross-platform use
Create PDF
- Create PDF with blank, lined, dotted, grid, and graph papers
- Combine multiple files/images into one PDF
Protect PDF
- Password-protect PDFs to restrict opening, editing, and printing
- Add or remove watermarks
- Add digital signatures
Manage Files
- Upload, create, rename, move, copy, duplicate, and organize files or folders
- Unzip files by simply tapping .zip files
- Search for files
- Supports two-finger multiple selections and operations
- Move files or folders to trash, and find deleted items in the trash
- Protect PDF files with a password or unlock protected PDF files
- Compress one or multiple files into a zip file
Security Space
- Protect your privacy by moving files or folders to Security Space
- Enable Face ID & Passcode to access your Security Space
Import File
- Import files from Photos albums
- Import files from the Files App
- Transfer files from a computer over the same Wi-Fi
View files in All Formats
- Browse dozens of different file formats including PDFs, Office documents (.doc, .docx, .ppt, .pptx, .xls, .xlsx), Pages, Keynotes, and Numbers with a single app
- Open other formats such as text, HTML, XML, Web Archive, Images (JPG, JPEG, GIF, PNG, TIFF, SVG, BMP), video, audio
*** Pro Features of In-App Purchase ***
- Use UPDF across all platforms including desktops and mobiles
- Free Users will get 1 GB of Cloud Storage; Paid users will get 10 GB of Cloud Storage for free
- Advanced PDF features such as Convert PDF with OCR, batch process, etc. are available on the desktop
- Unlimited use of Scan to PDF (Free trial only scans up to 5 pages)
- Unlimited use of Security Space (Trial version stores up to 10 items)
- Secure App with passcode/TouchID/FaceID
Need help? Email us at support@superace.com

bluejetty:00180700:ios.name: ASUS GlideX
bluejetty:00180700:ios.summary:
It's so easy to improve your efficiency with this convenient tool. Enjoy the amazing experience on any screen, on any device, anywhere! 
[Screen Mirror]
Mirror your phone’s screen on your PC so you can use your PC's keyboard and mouse to
bluejetty:00180700:ios.description:
It's so easy to improve your efficiency with this convenient tool. Enjoy the amazing experience on any screen, on any device, anywhere! 
[Screen Mirror]
Mirror your phone’s screen on your PC so you can use your PC's keyboard and mouse to navigate and input text instead of relying your phone's small screen virtual keyboard. Not only will your productivity improve significantly, you will also have a richer and less constrained visual experience.
[Screen Extend]
Use your phone or tablet as a secondary display on-the-go for dual-display convenience. This feature expands your space and can be exceptionally useful when you need to cross-reference multiple documents or visuals. Multitasking has never been easier.
[Unify Control]
Unify Control lets you control different devices and transfer files from one PC with a single mouse and keyboard, across different OSes, so you don’t need to switch between devices.
* Support Wi-Fi and/or USB to connect mobile devices to the PC.
* GlideX mobile app must be used together with GlideX for Windows (Win 10/11)
[File Transfer]
Simply drag and drop to send files to other PCs or mobile devices in the blink of an eye. It is many times faster than the traditional Bluetooth file transfer, with a user-friendly drag and drop experience to ensure seamless transfer among devices.
[Shared Cam]
Turn your mobile device camera into a webcam. Simply select “GlideX – Shared Cam” as the video source in your PC video conference app, then you can easily enjoy seamless webcam sharing.
[Hands-Free Phone Calls]
Make and take phone calls, which can be routed through your PC’s speakers and microphone. You can also access your phone’s contacts on your PC, so you can search for contacts and call them directly. There's no need to dig out your phone from your bag or pocket!
[Remote Access]
Use your mobile device to remotely access files stored on your ASUS PC and use your PC as a personal cloud replacement, which can be accessed from your mobile device, anywhere and anytime. Remote Access, including Remote File Access and Remote Desktop, can be extra beneficial for commercial users who need access to office files when on business trips or working from home.
* Remote Desktop is not supported on Windows 10 Home edition.
[URL Share]
Simply click the Share icon in your PC's browser, and then click GlideX. A link to the webpage currently displayed will be instantly sent to another PC or a connected mobile device — where it will open automatically for seamless on-the-go convenience.
GlideX for Windows link: https://www.microsoft.com/store/apps/9PLH2SV1DVK5
Learn more at ASUS Software Webpage: https://www.asus.com/content/GlideX/

bluejetty:00120923:ios.description:
Explore the excitement of Bid Whist Classic, the ultimate destination for fans of trump-taking and trick-taking card games. Whether you're a seasoned veteran or just discovering Bid Whist, this app delivers the most immersive and authentic experience on the Apple App Store. Play fast-paced speed card games or challenge others in 2 player whist—every game is a test of your strategy and skill.
Unmatched Bid Whist Classic Gameplay
Sharpen your skills in intense rounds of Bid Whist Classic. This trick-taking card game puts you in the heart of the action, combining the strategic depth of 2 player whist with the thrill of trump-taking. Outsmart your opponents, make the right bid, and seize victory in every trump card challenge.
Core Features:
Competitive Battles: Take on the best in Bid Whist and Spades, mastering the classic mechanics of trick-taking card games. Each match is a test of strategy in this exhilarating speed card game.
Global Multiplayer: Engage with players from around the world in trump-taking duels and 2 player whist showdowns. Enjoy the blend of social interaction and intense competition that only Bid Whist Classic can offer.
Personalized Play: Customize your experience with a wide range of card decks and backgrounds. Tailor the look and feel of your trump-taking battles to suit your style.
Achievements & Milestones: Track your progress as you climb the ranks. Whether you're excelling in Bid Whist Classic or mastering 2 player whist, your achievements will be recognized.
Completely Free: Dive into Bid Whist Classic without spending a dime. Download now and enjoy endless hours of trick-taking card game fun.
Distinctive Bid Whist Modes
Bid: Partner up and outbid your rivals in this strategic trick-taking card game. Set the trump card and lead your team to victory.
Whiz: Experience fast-paced action with no bidding required. The trump suit changes automatically, keeping you on your toes in this dynamic speed card game.
A New Era of Trump-Taking Games
Immerse yourself in the visually stunning and seamlessly smooth gameplay of Bid Whist Classic. Whether you're competing in 2 player whist or team-based challenges, you'll find endless opportunities to prove your skills in trump-taking and trick-taking card games. Join a global community of card enthusiasts and take your place among the champions of Bid Whist.
Download Now
Get Bid Whist Classic today and start your journey to becoming a card game legend. Master the nuances of bidding, excel in trick-taking card games, and rise through the ranks in this must-have Bid Whist Classic adventure.

bluejetty:00114198:ios.description:
Turn your ideas, memories, and photos into stunning tattoo art - instantly with AI.
Design your dream tattoo in seconds using the power of artificial intelligence. Whether it's a meaningful quote, a beloved pet, a portrait of someone special, or a symbolic story - Tattoo Style AI transforms your vision into ink-ready tattoo designs with stunning detail and style.
No more guesswork or risky sketches. Explore dozens of tattoo styles, preview your design on your skin, and bring your next tattoo to life with confidence.
Key Features:
► AI Tattoo Generator
Describe your idea and select a style - from minimalist to watercolor - and let the AI design your perfect tattoo.
► Portrait Tattoo
Turn a photo of someone special into a beautiful tattoo, in your favorite style.
► Pet Tattoo
Immortalize your pet by transforming their photo into meaningful ink art.
► Story Tattoo
Share a memory, emotion, or life story - and get a symbolic tattoo inspired by your words.
► Tattoo Enhancer
Already have a sketch or concept? Upload it and let AI refine or stylize it with artistic flair.
► Quote / Text Tattoo
Type a name, phrase, or date, then stylize it with fonts, layouts, and classic tattoo decorations.
Preview Your Tattoo Before You Commit:
► AR Preview
Use your camera to project your tattoo design directly onto your body in real time.
► AI Photo Preview
Upload a photo and see exactly how the tattoo would look on your skin.
Why Tattoo Style AI?
► Hyper-personalized designs in seconds
► Explore diverse styles: Realism, Geometric, Minimalist, Old School & many more
► Perfect for inspiration or showing ideas to your tattoo artist
► No drawing skills required - just your vision
Unlock the Full Experience
To access all features and create unlimited designs, an active Tattoo Style AI subscription is required.
If you have questions or ideas, we'd love to hear from you:
support@lumetro.com
Privacy Policy: https://lumetro.com/tattoostyle/privacy
Terms of Use: https://lumetro.com/tattoostyle/terms

bluejetty:00185008:ios.description:
Introducing the most famous footballers from around the world, now with photo-realistic likeness!
Play at your own pace with auto matchplay and high-quality 3D graphics!
Use the best players and tactics to take on world-class opponents on the pitch!
- Player Cards with popular real life players!
Players from the world's top national teams are here, including Argentina, France and Belgium, as well as stars from some of the most popular club teams, including FC BARCELONA, AC MILAN and MANCHESTER UNITED.
*Player cards featured in the screenshots/cutscenes may include player cards that were previously available but can no longer be signed.
- Accessible gameplay in high-quality 3D!
Experience CHAMPION SQUADS with all-new high-fidelity 3D animations. Get ready for realer-than-ever graphics to go with authentic stadium sounds and pro commentary!
Implement your choice of formation built around your choice of players and tactics, then leave the rest to the AI to handle. This is what managing football is all about!
When you feel like gauging your team's progress, you can do so by playing matches in real time against rivals from across the globe.
With the new 'Elevens Match' feature, you bring your squad's top star to the changing room along with 10 other users to form a full team of 11 players.
- From the annuls of footballing history...A legend is reborn
Relive the most exciting moments of footballing history with SHOWTIME!
- Team up with friends in eClub Mode!
A new feature where you get to build a club from the ground up with a friend.
Collaborate in-game with the chat feature to build the best squad and play against other opponents!
- Join your friends from around the world in frequent festivals!
In CHAMPION SQUADS, the Championship is a mammoth tournament held regularly to determine the very best team. With a range of campaigns and special draws, festivals have something for everyone. 
- Recommended for all football gaming fans
A football game anybody can play, and free-to-play

bluejetty:00035084:ios.description:
The Stanley Parable: Ultra Deluxe is an expanded re-imagining of the critically acclaimed, award winning indie game The Stanley Parable from 2013.
Everything that was in the original Stanley Parable is here, preserved just like it was back in 2013. But The Stanley Parable: Ultra Deluxe also dramatically expands the world of the original game with new content, new choices, and new secrets to uncover. The labyrinth has just gotten bigger.
In addition, the game has been visually upgraded to reflect modern technology while faithfully preserving the tone of the original game. Accessibility features have also been added to the game, including localization of in-world text, colorblind options, and content warnings.
And just as before, the impeccable voicework of Kevan Brighting will accompany you every step of the way.
In The Stanley Parable: Ultra Deluxe, everything you remember has been recreated, yet it's different somehow. We've been here before, haven't we? Is Stanley still the same as he was back then? Or is it you who has changed?

 - Interchangeable backgrounds
 - Statistics
 - Achievements

bluejetty:00015407:ios.description:
Inspire Young Learners with Live Online Classes for Chinese, English, Math & More.
LingoAce is an award-winning online learning platform offering engaging, personalized instruction in Mandarin Chinese, English and Math for kids ages 3–15. With 20M+ live classes delivered to students in 110+ countries, we connect young learners with professionally certified teachers – anytime, anywhere.
Whether your child is just starting out or aiming for academic excellence, LingoAce helps them build confidence, fluency, and critical thinking skills through immersive, expert-led lessons.
LingoAce Chinese
The best way for kids to learn Mandarin Chinese
Designed for ages 3–15, our research-based curriculum helps children speak, listen, read, and write in Chinese with confidence.
Why families love it:
- Live 1-on-1 or group classes with native, accredited Chinese teachers
- Curriculum aligned with HSK, AP Chinese, and global language standards
- Interactive courseware with games, picture books & fun homework
- Supports all levels & bilingual backgrounds
LingoAce English
Build real fluency with native English teachers
For learners ages 4–11, our English program combines proven techniques and native-speaking teachers to spark language growth.
Program highlights:
- TEFL-certified British & American teachers with TPR techniques
- Curriculum aligned with CEFR language standards
- Engaging storytelling, gamified practice & closed-loop review
- Helps children excel in listening, speaking, reading, and writing
LingoAce Math
Master math with the proven Singapore Math method
Ideal for ages 5–15, our Math program strengthens logic and analytical skills in a fun, collaborative way.
Why parents choose LingoAce Math:
- Developed by the Stanford Doctor
- Aligns with US CCSS standards
- Small class sizes (max 6 students) for personalized learning
- Prepares for Olympiad Math and academic excellence
About Us
Founded in 2017, LingoAce is a global edtech company headquartered in Singapore with teams across the US, Europe, China, and Southeast Asia. We have over 5,000 certified teachers and are proud to have taught more than 20 million classes to PreK-12 learners worldwide.
Recognized by:
- Fast Company’s World’s Most Innovative Companies (2023)
- GSV EdTech 150 (2022 & 2023)
Support & Contact
Website: www.lingoace.com
Email: welcome@lingoace.com
Follow us:
- Facebook: LingoAce Global
- Instagram: @lingoaceus
- Twitter: @LingoAce

bluejetty:00023561:ios.description:
NZeTA – Get it before you go
Download this free official New Zealand government app and use it to request your NZeTA and pay the IVL. The app is the fastest way to request an NZeTA and should take you less than 5 minutes.
You can use the app to scan your passport to upload your details and scan your credit or debit card for ease of payment.
You can request and pay for up to 10 NZeTAs in one transaction for your family or group.
What are the NZeTA & IVL?
The NZeTA is a border security measure introduced by the New Zealand Government on 1 October 2019.
To find out more, visit the Immigration New Zealand website. https://www.immigration.govt.nz/nzeta
Most visitors coming to New Zealand must pay an International Visitor Conservation and Tourism Levy (IVL). The IVL is a way for you to contribute directly to the tourism infrastructure you use and help protect the natural environment you enjoy during your stay in New Zealand. For more information on the IVL, visit this website https://www.mbie.govt.nz/immigration-and-tourism/tourism/tourism-funding/international-visitor-conservation-and-tourism-levy/.
The Legal stuff
Immigration New Zealand (INZ) will use the information you provide in this app about yourself or others, including photographs, to assess NZeTA requests. Information may also be used to improve INZ’s services and administration of the Immigration Act 2009. See our privacy statement (https://www.immigration.govt.nz/about-us/site-information/privacy) for more information about our handling of personal information and your rights. The use of this app is subject to our terms of use https://www.immigration.govt.nz/about-us/site-information/terms-of-use. 
It is your responsibility to ensure that to the best of your knowledge the information you provide via this app is accurate and that you answer the questions truthfully and correctly. The information will be retained and will become part of New Zealand immigration records. INZ may provide information to other agencies in New Zealand and overseas where such disclosure is required or permitted by the Privacy Act 1993, or otherwise required or permitted by law.

• Interactive radar maps

bluejetty:00016324:ios.name: DStv Stream
bluejetty:00016324:ios.summary:
As a DStv customer you can enjoy the shows, movies and sport you love with the DStv app. Download now and get watching!
Never miss your favourite TV shows, sports team or breaking news with the DStv app, watch live on your iPhone, iPad or
bluejetty:00016324:ios.description:
As a DStv customer you can enjoy the shows, movies and sport you love with the DStv app. Download now and get watching!
Never miss your favourite TV shows, sports team or breaking news with the DStv app, watch live on your iPhone, iPad or Apple TV; catch up on the latest episodes and movies or download to watch offline later on your mobile app.
As a DStv customer you can enjoy all of these features on the DStv app.
- Watch it as it happens, tune in and start live streaming selected TV channels via 3G/4G or WIFI.
- Missed it live, catch it later by watching a selection of the most popular shows, sport highlights, and movies on Catch Up.
- Don’t want to use mobile data to watch shows or movies, download up to 25 videos on Catch Up while on WIFI to enjoy offline later across 4 mobile devices.
- Want your own experience based on the sport, shows and movies you like to watch, setup up to 6 profiles to personalise each family members viewing experience.
- Want to plan your viewing in advance, add Catch Up items to your watchlist to come back to later or access the full 8-day TV Guide and set reminders to arrange your viewing.
- Need to keep the kids entertained, our Kids section on the mobile app is a safe and fun viewing environment with PIN controlled access so your kids can enjoy the coolest shows and movies unattended.
The DStv mobile app gives you the freedom to watch your best-loved DStv entertainment when you’re on the move.
If you don’t have DStv, no problem, just download the app, sign-up, and start watching our selection of free live streaming channels and video on your iPhone, iPad or Apple TV (available in South Africa only). As long as you’ve got the data, you’re good to go.
*The Live TV and Catch Up content on the DStv app will be as per your subscription package and country. Due to geo-blocking this content can only be played within the countries in the DStv territories.

bluejetty:00016714:ios.summary:
