MAGICO is an exciting color-by-numbers
bluejetty:00016714:ios.description:
Take a deep dive into the immense and fascinating world of pixel art – impress your friends, family and the entire world with your wonderful masterpieces. Become a part of a new pixel art community! 
MAGICO is an exciting color-by-numbers game and a great way to feel like a real artist. Our app will help you relax and relieve stress. You will learn how to choose the right color combinations and also improve your fine motor skills, concentration and accuracy.
App features:
• 2000+ of uniquely designed coloring book games, updated weekly
• amazing magic tools helps to make your gameplay more fun
• smart one-touch filling tool and changeable shape of pixels
• works offline** No connection needed to play and relax;
• optimized for iOS 14, iPhone Xs & iPhone Xs Max & iPad Pro;
• ability to save and share your artworks or videos with friends on the most popular social networks
Upgrade to the Premium version to get unlimited access for a huge collection of wonderful coloring pictures, magic tools, features and remove ads. Every week, new images will be available for download and you'll be able to access unlimited coloring pages for the duration of your subscription.
Choose from 3 subscription options:
- a weekly subscription (with a 3-day free trial) for $0.99 USD*;
- a monthly subscription (with a 3-day free trial) for $2.49 USD*;
- an annual subscription (with a 3-day free trial) for $5.99 USD*.
Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. You will be able to color all available images for the duration of the subscription. 
Subscription automatically renews for the same price and duration period as the original "one month"/"one year" package unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the cost of the chosen package (monthly or yearly package). Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's iTunes Account Settings after purchase. No cancellation of the current subscription is allowed during active subscription period. You may cancel a subscription during its free trial period via the subscription setting through your iTunes account. This must be done 24 hours before the end of the subscription period to avoid being charged. Please visit http://support.apple.com/kb/ht4098 for more information. You may turn off the auto-renewal of your subscription via your iTunes Account Settings. However, you are not able to cancel the current subscription during its active period
Privacy Policy: https://magmagames.online/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://magmagames.online/terms-of-use
For complete access to all features, you will need to allow access to the following:
• Notifications - so that you will be kept informed when New or Special pictures are added to the app.
• Photos - so that you can import your pictures for coloring and save your artwork;
• Camera - so that you can capture your own coloring pages to color them in the app.
* the prices are for United States customers. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to your local currency depending on the country of residence.
** for downloaded images only

bluejetty:00153335:ios.name: Live Tile Star
bluejetty:00153335:ios.summary:
Welcome to "Live Tile Star"! You have entered a dream world composed of wisdom and beauty! Here, you will meet a variety of beautiful girls, and through your efforts, you can discover their different appearances.
Gameplay: The game feature
bluejetty:00153335:ios.description:
Welcome to "Live Tile Star"! You have entered a dream world composed of wisdom and beauty! Here, you will meet a variety of beautiful girls, and through your efforts, you can discover their different appearances.
Gameplay: The game features classic tile mechanics. Simply click on the stunning glass tiles , cleverly place them in the grid below, and strive to match three identical tiles together to achieve a glamorous elimination and earn affection hearts. As your affection level rises, the beautiful streamers will change into exquisite outfits, showcasing even more stunning fashion styles.
Game Features:
Dynamic Backgrounds and Fashionable Streamers Every level is filled with challenges and fun, featuring different beautiful streamers in the background, whose dynamic displays add infinite charm to the game. As you eliminate tiles and accumulate hearts, upon reaching a certain quantity, the streamers will change into gorgeous outfits. You can also unlock more unique fashion through clearing levels, enjoying these stylish looks as if you were in a visual feast.
Innovative Tile Upgrade System In the game, you will experience a unique tile upgrade system. The collected heart items can be used to upgrade the patterns of the tiles; eliminating upgraded tiles will yield higher points, helping you achieve greater accomplishments in the game. This upgrade mechanism makes every elimination filled with anticipation and surprise, allowing you to feel the thrill of continuous progress!
Powerful Item System The game also provides four powerful assist items to help you navigate the challenges with ease! Whether it’s “reset” or “undo,” these items will help you overcome difficulties, easily tackle level challenges, and fully enjoy the fun and excitement of the game!
Stylish and Elegant Design "Live Tile Star" features a stylish yet elegant design, with constant challenges and exciting moments . The game is easy to pick up, focusing on testing your intellect and strategy, allowing you to immerse yourself in this elimination feast completely.
In "Live Tile Star," every successful elimination brings surprising moments. We look forward to you embarking on this exciting elimination journey . Come and experience a journey that is both mentally stimulating and visually pleasing, allowing you to enjoy the dual pleasure of fun and fashion in the game! 
Privacy Policy: http://www.live-tile-star.com/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use:http://www.live-tile-star.com/terms-of-service.html

bluejetty:00174555:ios.summary:
Don’t let your mood affect your life. Take control over it!
Meet Moodnotes - a super easy mood tracker & journaling app to capture your mood and help you improve your thinking habits. Moodnotes empowers you to track your mood over time, av
bluejetty:00174555:ios.description:
Don’t let your mood affect your life. Take control over it!
Meet Moodnotes - a super easy mood tracker & journaling app to capture your mood and help you improve your thinking habits. Moodnotes empowers you to track your mood over time, avoid common thinking traps, and develop perspectives associated with increased happiness and well-being. 
Created by design experts and clinical psychologists (creators of MoodKit), Moodnotes is grounded in the scientifically-supported content of cognitive behavior therapy (CBT) and positive psychology. Includes Apple Watch app and iCloud sync/backup.
KEY FEATURES: 
Moodnotes helps you to:
- Track your mood and identify what triggers it
- Scan your face automatically using device camera
- Keep your memories with photos or pictures
- Read self-awareness articles written by mental health experts
- Develop healthier thinking habits
- Learn about “traps” in your thinking and how to avoid them
- Reduce anxiety and enhance your sense of well-being
- Bring new, helpful perspectives to situations
- Increase your self-awareness
Exclusively featured by Apple in the App Store Today tab story "All The Feels".
MOODNOTES PREMIUM
Become a Premium member to unlock the following features:
- Make unlimited entries per day
- Monitor your personal statistics and check your mood insights
- Add notes to enrich your mood entries
- Get access to “Notable insights” section to learn more about your mood

bluejetty:00133683:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00133683:ios.description:
Small app
Yango Lite is a lightweight taxi app for getting around the city. It's nearly 10 times smaller than the well-known Yango taxi app.
Any internet connection
Yango Lite app is designed to work with any internet connection, even 2G and weak signals!
Compatibility across devices
The app is also compatible with all devices, giving you more flexibility to get where you’re going at the same great savings as with the larger Yango app.
Choose the right service class for you
Reach your destination at the right level of comfort and price for you. Choose from several service classes. Start is perfect for short taxicab rides. Economy is awesome for when you need an affordable car fast with this ride app. Comfort lets you sit back and enjoy the ride. The Delivery service class let you send and receive things from businesses and friends and family. And The Fastest offers rides when the service class doesn’t matter… you need the closest available taxi!
Track your driver’s location
Want to see your taxicab driver's current location? With Yango Lite, you can see their route and current location in real time directly in this ride app.
An international service
Yango Lite is a ride-hailing service that operates mobility and delivery aggregators in 19 countries, including Ghana, Cote d'Ivoire, Cameroon, Senegal and Zambia.
Enjoy your ride!
Yango is an informational service and not a transportation or taxi services provider. Transportation services are provided by third parties. 
The 30% (max 4 GH₵/450 FCFA) discount is valid on the first three rides for new users in Accra, Kumasi, Douala and Yaoundé until 31.12.2023. Up to 30%/20% (max 400 FCFA/500 FCFA) discount is valid on the first three rides for new users in Bouake/Abidjan until 31.12.2023.

3. Take a picture of each Item that belongs in a box
4. Repeat steps as necessary!

This app was made with a ton of passion to help simplify and organize your life - we hope you love it!

bluejetty:00040005:ios.description:
Turn your phone into a beautiful personal library. TF Reader is a 100% FREE ebook reader that lets you enjoy your favorite books and stories (EPUB, PDF, MOBI, comics…) anytime, anywhere — with a stunning, modern interface and powerful read‑aloud voices that bring every page to life.
Whether you love reading with your eyes or listening on the go, TF Reader is built for you.
* COMPLETELY FREE
No subscriptions, no paywalls. Read all your books for free.
* READ MANY FORMATS — YOUR WAY
- EPUB, MOBI/AZW3, FB2, DOCX, RTF, HTML, CHM and TXT with a smooth, fast reading engine
- PDF: page view, outline, and a text mode for comfortable reading on your phone
- CBZ/CBR/CBT comics; combine several images into one book
- Import from your device, a whole folder, or open straight from other apps
- Transfer books wirelessly over Wi‑Fi (LAN) — no cables needed
* Read fully offline, anywhere
* TEXT‑TO‑SPEECH (READ ALOUD)
Let your books read themselves to you:
- Natural read‑aloud with adjustable speed, pitch, voice & language
- Sleep timer — perfect for bedtime listening
- Relaxing background music while you listen
- Lock Screen & Control Center controls — listen with the screen off
- Keep listening while you drive, walk, or work out
* BEAUTIFUL, MODERN DESIGN
- Clean, elegant interface with smooth animations
- Light & Dark reading modes to protect your eyes
- Gorgeous glassmorphism (blur) effects
- Organized bookshelf with covers and reading progress
* FULLY CUSTOMIZABLE READING
Make every book feel just right:
- Choose fonts, add your own, or download more
- Adjust text size, line spacing, indent & background color
- Multiple page‑turn styles: scroll, slide, page curl, webtoon & more
- Turn pages with a tap or a swipe
- Portrait, landscape & two‑column modes
- Keep screen on, RTL/LTR support and reading reminders
* POWERFUL READING TOOLS
- Bookmarks & notes/annotations
- In‑book search
- Chapter list & reading progress tracking
- Track how much of each book you've read
* AVAILABLE IN 13 LANGUAGES
English, Vietnamese, Russian, Chinese, Japanese, Thai, Indonesian, French, Spanish, German, Korean, Portuguese and more.
Download TF Reader today and discover a smarter, more beautiful way to read and listen to your books — completely free!

bluejetty:00081647:ios.description:
Got tired of normal texts? Want your bios on social media or nickname in games to be attractive and unique?
These days most conversations happen over text and how your text looks matters a lot. A stylish text will stand out among the plain texts and a cool nickname will stand out among plain, boring names. How the username appears in the gaming world matters. A fancy nickname looks cool. A stylish text looks distinctive enough to catch eye-balls. Plain text seems lifeless but when combined with fancy text, cool symbols around stylish letters, it becomes impressive. To gain that kind of attention, you need to make your nickname or text designer. Creating a designer text has never been this easy.
One symbol sometimes is worth a thousand words, right? For that letter style change, Stylish Text App is an amazing tool. It helps you in turning boring nicknames to stylish nicknames with the help of numerous symbols, letter styles to decorate your names. The app offers a plethora of symbols and letter style change options for your text decoration. With the help of this letter style change app, you will be able to make your nickname stylish, make fancy text in different styles and can also decorate it with various symbols. This helps make the stylish text stand out among the crowd. With this letter style change app, you will have a ton of cool symbols to make the designer text and impress your friends a super-duper cool nickname or a funky stylish text.
This app can also act as a text generator app or username generator for your games where you can create your distinctive design text from scratch, make your status updates fun and your chats special. Make your own cool name or nickname for your friends and family, or design text you want to share with your friends. You can amaze everyone with your choice of styles and stylish letters by using this letter style change app.
Utility
This letter style change app will help in creating username for your character in your favourite game or for impressing crowd with a stylish text for your bio, profile name, status, nickname for your social media account. Using stylish symbols, customisation of normal text to stylish text for your blogs. You can easily design your text with lenny faces or kaomojis.
Usage
This app is incredibly easy to use with its plain, simple user interface, you will be able to make your fancy text with a plethora of characters to choose from and the best part is, the stylish text can be written in many unique text styles.
How to use it?
To add style to your text, simply type your name or the normal text on the text field that you want to convert into stylish text. Your text will be converted into different fancy text style when you select your desired style and add in cool characters or emojis across the letters of your plain text.
Share
It has an easy copy and paste feature, using which you can copy the design text that you have just created and paste it in chats, social media channels or any game of your choice. Say no to plain text with this cool text app. It also allows you to quickly share your created design text with your friends using any of the social media app. Now you can express yourself through designer text the way you want, with this text generator app.
No Limitations
Letter style change app can be used to generate unlimited text styles by all users. Users can style their text as much as they want. You can use this text changer app anytime and anywhere. Spice up your chat with cool letters and symbols. Make something great of your everyday conversations. Turn heads, stand out, get creative.
Feedback
We are constantly working to make this app better. Your voice is important to us. Please reach out with suggestions.
---
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://fundeasy.in/stylish-text-privacy-policy/

Connect with Creativity: Skizz - Drawing Together
Seeking a unique way to connect and create with your friends and loved ones? Introducing Skizz - Drawing Together! This innovative app is designed to inspire creativity and strengthen connections among friends and couples. With Skizz, you can enhance your photos and videos with magical drawings, share your creations in real-time, and experience the enchanting together.
Skizz's Enchanting Features:
- Drawing Widget: Your drawings and those of your friends will appear on the phone's widget screen, allowing you to stay connected and inspired even when you are using your phone.
- Drawing Together: Create captivating artwork within the app itself, using your phone as the canvas. Explore various backgrounds and utilize over 100 stickers to add flair to your creations, all for free.
Special Features to Enhance Your Experience
- Custom Backgrounds: Choose from a selection of themed backgrounds or use your own photos to create the perfect setting for your drawings. Themes include love, pastels, and watercolors, ensuring endless inspiration.
- Stickers and Effects: Access a library of over 100 stickers to embellish your drawings. Convey your message with style and charm, all at no cost.
- Easy Sharing: Seamlessly share your creations with friends through QR codes, links, or social media. Surprise them with your artistic skills and enjoy their reactions in real-time.
- Save and Revisit: Save your completed drawings for future reference or share them with others. Relive your magical moments anytime you want.
Perfect for Couples
Skizz is especially suited for couples in love. Express your feelings with cute drawings, so that every time your partner sees them, they can feel your affection and creativity.
Join the Magic
Embrace the latest trend in social creativity and start expressing your imagination with Skizz. Download Skizz - Drawing Together today and share your enchanting creations with friends in a truly unique way! If you love Skizz, please give us a 5-star rating. bluejetty:00017030:ios.description:
Can’t decide what to eat, who goes first, or which name to pick? Let Random choose.
Explore 30+ generators for everyday decisions, games, creative ideas, and more. From a quick coin flip to a wheel filled with your own choices, there’s a tool for whatever you’re deciding.
TURN YOUR OPTIONS INTO AN ANSWER
Add names, meals, activities, or ideas to a list and pick a random result. Spin Lucky Wheel, build a custom Super Wheel, or make your choices visual with Photo Wheel. Save your lists to use them again whenever you need them.
MAKE GAME NIGHT EASY
Keep dice ready in your pocket, flip a coin to settle who starts, or divide players into random teams without picking favorites. Bring everyone into the conversation with Questions, Would You Rather, and Truth or Dare.
GENERATE SOMETHING NEW
Choose a range for random numbers and decimals, discover a color, find a word, generate a name, or create a password. Whether you need a result for a task or a starting point for an idea, Random gives you plenty of possibilities.
DO MORE IN ONE TAP
Use Simultaneous to run multiple generators together. Combine the tools you need and generate their results at once.
KEEP YOUR FAVORITES CLOSE
Put your most used generators on your home screen for quick access. Reuse saved lists, revisit results in supported generators, and explore statistics to see how your results add up.

Premium unlocks additional generators, more customization, and app themes. Make Random your own with more ways to create, choose, and play.

bluejetty:00026952:ios.description:
The #1 golf GPS app and rangefinder trusted by 5M+ golfers worldwide. Hole19 delivers pinpoint accurate yardages, AI-powered shot tracking, a digital scorecard, and a handicap tracker, all on your iPhone and Apple Watch.
Whether you're chasing your first sub-90 or defending single digits, Hole19 has the tools to lower your score. Coverage of 42,000+ courses in 201 countries, a full-featured Apple Watch integration, and features built with 10+ years of real golfer feedback.
Golfers who track their shots with Hole19 Premium save an average of 3 shots per round. Try Premium free for 14 days.
FREE FEATURES:
- Golf GPS Rangefinder: Pinpoint distances to the front, center, and back of the green plus every hazard and target across 42,000+ courses.
- Digital Scorecard: Scores, putts, fairways hit, and GIR tracked on your phone or Apple Watch.
- Course Preview: Explore every hole layout and hazard before you tee off.
- Apple Watch GPS: Front, center, back distances on your wrist. Phone-free play.
- LivePlay: Organize rounds, track live leaderboards, and share the round in real time.
- Golf Social Network: Connect with golfers worldwide, share scores and course photos.
- Siri Voice Commands (iOS): Start a round hands-free.
- Monthly Challenges: Compete for prizes.
PREMIUM FEATURES:
- Plays Like Distances: Real yardages adjusted for elevation.
- Shot Tracker: Track every shot and see exactly where it landed.
- Club Recommendation: Personalized club suggestions based on your actual distances.
- Augmented Reality (iOS): Distances and directions overlaid on your camera view.
- Handicap Calculator: Global-standard handicap index with improvement tracking.
- Club & Overall Stats: Driving accuracy, greens in regulation, short game, putting.
- Apple Watch Scoring & Maps: Full score input and flyover maps on your wrist.
- Game Modes: Stroke Play, Stableford and Side Games free; Match Play and team formats Premium.
- Shot Dispersion Tool: See where your shots are likely to land and pick smarter aim points.
- Auto-Change Hole: The app advances automatically as you move.
- Distance Arcs: Free in Course Preview only; Premium in-round.
- Notes & Highlights: Course strategy notes plus your career highlights.
- Ad-free experience.
INTELLIGENCE (Hole19's AI tier):
- Otto AI: Your personal AI caddie. Unlimited AI round reports that tell you exactly where you're losing strokes and what to work on.
- Auto Shot Detection: Track every shot with one tap after the round.
- Strokes Gained Analysis: Pro-level stats that reveal which part of your game is costing you the most.
- Handicap Benchmark: Compare your game to golfers at your exact handicap level.
- CORE Golf included (iOS Only): 100+ drills and 15+ practice plans to structure your practice.
Payment will be charged to your Apple Account upon confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed by you and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings. If you upgrade to Premium or Intelligence during your free trial any remaining time left on your trial will be forfeited.
NOTES:
- help@hole19golf.com - Technical support
- mapping@hole19golf.com - Mapping requests
- partners@hole19golf.com - Partnerships
- Premium and Intelligence features are available via in-app purchase
- The app is optimized for iOS 18.0+ on iPhone SE (2nd generation) and newer
- Hole19 for Apple Watch requires watchOS 10 or later
- Hole19 is not optimized for iPad
- Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life
- Family Sharing is not supported
- Privacy Policy - https://www.hole19golf.com/terms/privacy-policy
- Terms of Use - https://www.hole19golf.com/terms

Whether you're chasing your first sub-90 or defending single digits, Hole19 has the tools to lower your score. Coverage of 42,000+ courses in 201 countries, a full-featured Apple Watch integration, and features built with 10+ years of real golfer feedback.

Golfers who track their shots with Hole19 Premium save an average of 3 shots per round. Try Premium free for 14 days.

FREE FEATURES:
- Golf GPS Rangefinder: Pinpoint distances to the front, center, and back of the green plus every hazard and target across 42,000+ courses.
- Digital Scorecard: Scores, putts, fairways hit, and GIR tracked on your phone or Apple Watch.
- Course Preview: Explore every hole layout and hazard before you tee off.
- Apple Watch GPS: Front, center, back distances on your wrist. Phone-free play.
- LivePlay: Organize rounds, track live leaderboards, and share the round in real time.
- Golf Social Network: Connect with golfers worldwide, share scores and course photos.
- Siri Voice Commands (iOS): Start a round hands-free.
- Monthly Challenges: Compete for prizes.

PREMIUM FEATURES:
- Plays Like Distances: Real yardages adjusted for elevation.
- Shot Tracker: Track every shot and see exactly where it landed.
- Club Recommendation: Personalized club suggestions based on your actual distances.
- Augmented Reality (iOS): Distances and directions overlaid on your camera view.
- Handicap Calculator: Global-standard handicap index with improvement tracking.
- Club & Overall Stats: Driving accuracy, greens in regulation, short game, putting.
- Apple Watch Scoring & Maps: Full score input and flyover maps on your wrist.
- Game Modes: Stroke Play, Stableford and Side Games free; Match Play and team formats Premium.
- Shot Dispersion Tool: See where your shots are likely to land and pick smarter aim points.
- Auto-Change Hole: The app advances automatically as you move.
- Distance Arcs: Free in Course Preview only; Premium in-round.
- Notes & Highlights: Course strategy notes plus your career highlights.
- Ad-free experience.

INTELLIGENCE (Hole19's AI tier):
- Otto AI: Your personal AI caddie. Unlimited AI round reports that tell you exactly where you're losing strokes and what to work on.
- Auto Shot Detection: Track every shot with one tap after the round.
- Strokes Gained Analysis: Pro-level stats that reveal which part of your game is costing you the most.
- Handicap Benchmark: Compare your game to golfers at your exact handicap level.
- CORE Golf included (iOS Only): 100+ drills and 15+ practice plans to structure your practice.

Payment will be charged to your Apple Account upon confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed by you and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings. If you upgrade to Premium or Intelligence during your free trial any remaining time left on your trial will be forfeited.

NOTES:

- help@hole19golf.com - Technical support
- mapping@hole19golf.com - Mapping requests
- partners@hole19golf.com - Partnerships
- Premium and Intelligence features are available via in-app purchase
- The app is optimized for iOS 18.0+ on iPhone SE (2nd generation) and newer
- Hole19 for Apple Watch requires watchOS 10 or later
- Hole19 is not optimized for iPad
- Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life
- Family Sharing is not supported
- Privacy Policy - https://www.hole19golf.com/terms/privacy-policy
- Terms of Use - https://www.hole19golf.com/terms

bluejetty:00143883:ios.description:
累計900万ダウンロードを突破した大人気の英語学習アプリ！
TOEIC®、英検®、大学受験、TOEFL、大学入学共通テスト、日常英会話、ビジネス英会話、IELTS、GREなど豊富な学習コースを用意！
また、無料でも単語学習が可能で、発音も一緒に聞くことができるので暗記しやすい！さらに、有料プランに登録すると、TOEIC®や英検®などの英文法・リーディング・リスニングの実践問題まで学習し放題！
【こんな方にオススメ】 
・英単語、熟語をとにかく楽しくサクサク暗記したい
・TOEIC®や英検®、大学受験などのテスト・試験対策として、英単語はもちろん文法・リーディング・リスニングまで総合的に学習したい 
・海外留学に向けて、発音と一緒に英語の語彙（単語・熟語）を増やしたい 
・通勤、通学時間などのスキマ時間を英語学習で有意義な時間にしたい 
【mikanでできる学習①：英単語・熟語学習】 
● 200冊以上の英単語・熟語教材ラインナップ
大学受験であれば「英単語ターゲットシリーズ」や「速読英単語」、 英検であれば「出る順パス単シリーズ」、 TOEIC®であれば「金フレ・銀フレを含む特急シリーズ」など、200冊以上の英単語・熟語教材が収録されています。 
● 英単語の定着度判断はmikanにお任せ 
英単語を暗記しているかどうかの管理は必要なし！mikanが独自のアルゴリズムで覚えたかどうかの習熟度を判定します。 苦手な英単語を効率よく覚えていきましょう！ 
● 発音を聴いて、リスニング対策！ 
ネイティブの発音を収録しているため、すべての単語の発音を聴くことができ、リスニング力も身につけることができます。 
● 4択学習でサクサク記憶度チェック 
1単語3秒、10単語30秒で、その単語を覚えられているかをチェック。ゲームみたいにサクサク進められる上に、有料プランならスキップや赤シートなど学習効率を上げる機能も使用可能です！ 
● カードめくりで単語を覚える 
知っていたら右へ、知らなかったら左へカードをめくるだけで、あなたの習熟度にあわせた適切な単語が表示され、学習できます。 覚えていない単語は何回も触れて、暗記しよう！ 
● 辞書を活用して、多面的に単語を勉強 
各学習の結果画面や、教材詳細の単語一覧画面から、各単語に紐づく辞書を確認することができます。 他の意義、類義語、単語の成り立ちや例文などを確認することで、英語を多面的に覚えよう！ 
【mikanでできる学習②：実践問題（英文法・リスニング・リーディング）】 
● 300冊以上の実践教材ラインナップ 
TOEIC®であれば「文法特急、読解特急を含む特急シリーズ」や「精選模試シリーズ」、 英検®であれば、「予想問題ドリルシリーズ」や「過去問題集シリーズ」など、約300冊以上を収録。 
● 長文問題でもサクサク解ける 
長年選ばれ続けているmikanを作ったメンバーがデザイン・開発しているため、 文法やリスニングはもちろん、長文読解の問題もサクサク解くことができます。 
● 解答から復習、さらには書籍の中身の確認までスマホで完結 
アプリ内で解答、採点、解説確認、復習ができるため、スマホ1つでどこでも学習できます。 また、電子書籍機能も利用可能なので、より詳しい説明や、読み物として活用したい方もお使いいただけます！ 
【mikanの特徴】 
● 勉強なのに楽しい！ 
mikanのキャラクターがあなたの学習を応援してサポートします。ただ問題を解くだけではなく、どんな点数でも励ましてくれるので楽しく勉強できます。 
● 学習記録が貯まってモチベーションが上がる 
アプリ内で行った学習は全て蓄積され、「学習データ」タブで可視化されます。 なんと1,000日も連続で学習してくださるユーザーさんも・・・！ 毎日コツコツ勉強して英語をマスターしましょう！ 
● 圧倒的な人気 
累計ダウンロードは900万を突破し、レビューは15万を超えても平均評価4.8をキープするなど、ユーザーの皆様から圧倒的な支持をいただいております。 
【掲載書籍 ※一部抜粋 / 順不同】 
・TOEIC L&R TEST 出る単特急 金のフレーズ、1駅1題 TOEIC L&R TEST 文法特急シリーズ / 朝日新聞出版 
・TOEICテスト 新形式精選模試 シリーズ、関正生の TOEIC L&Rテスト 文法問題 神速100問 / ジャパンタイムズ出版 
・でる順パス単シリーズ、英検過去6回問題集シリーズ、TOEFLテスト英単語3800、実践IELTS英単語3500、英単語ターゲットシリーズ / 旺文社 
・改訂版 鉄緑会東大英単語熟語 鉄壁、世界一わかりやすいTOEICシリーズ / KADOKAWA 
・どんどん話すための瞬間英作文トレーニング / ベレ出版 ・速読英単語シリーズ / Z会 ・DUO 3.0 / アイシーピー 
・英単語Stock3000、中学英単語MAX3200 / 文英堂 
・夢をかなえる英単語 新ユメタン シリーズ / アルク 
・英単語の語源図鑑、英会話は筋トレ。 / かんき出版

また、無料でも単語学習が可能で、発音も一緒に聞くことができるので暗記しやすい！さらに、有料プランに登録すると、TOEIC®や英検®などの英文法・リーディング・リスニングの実践問題まで学習し放題！

大学受験であれば「英単語ターゲットシリーズ」や「速読英単語」、 英検であれば「出る順パス単シリーズ」、 TOEIC®であれば「金フレ・銀フレを含む特急シリーズ」など、200冊以上の英単語・熟語教材が収録されています。

英単語を暗記しているかどうかの管理は必要なし！mikanが独自のアルゴリズムで覚えたかどうかの習熟度を判定します。 苦手な英単語を効率よく覚えていきましょう！  

● 発音を聴いて、リスニング対策！ 
ネイティブの発音を収録しているため、すべての単語の発音を聴くことができ、リスニング力も身につけることができます。  

● 4択学習でサクサク記憶度チェック 
1単語3秒、10単語30秒で、その単語を覚えられているかをチェック。ゲームみたいにサクサク進められる上に、有料プランならスキップや赤シートなど学習効率を上げる機能も使用可能です！  

● カードめくりで単語を覚える 
知っていたら右へ、知らなかったら左へカードをめくるだけで、あなたの習熟度にあわせた適切な単語が表示され、学習できます。 覚えていない単語は何回も触れて、暗記しよう！  

● 辞書を活用して、多面的に単語を勉強 
各学習の結果画面や、教材詳細の単語一覧画面から、各単語に紐づく辞書を確認することができます。 他の意義、類義語、単語の成り立ちや例文などを確認することで、英語を多面的に覚えよう！

TOEIC®であれば「文法特急、読解特急を含む特急シリーズ」や「精選模試シリーズ」、 英検®であれば、「予想問題ドリルシリーズ」や「過去問題集シリーズ」など、約300冊以上を収録。

長年選ばれ続けているmikanを作ったメンバーがデザイン・開発しているため、 文法やリスニングはもちろん、長文読解の問題もサクサク解くことができます。  

● 解答から復習、さらには書籍の中身の確認までスマホで完結 
アプリ内で解答、採点、解説確認、復習ができるため、スマホ1つでどこでも学習できます。 また、電子書籍機能も利用可能なので、より詳しい説明や、読み物として活用したい方もお使いいただけます！

アプリ内で行った学習は全て蓄積され、「学習データ」タブで可視化されます。 なんと1,000日も連続で学習してくださるユーザーさんも・・・！ 毎日コツコツ勉強して英語をマスターしましょう！

累計ダウンロードは900万を突破し、レビューは15万を超えても平均評価4.8をキープするなど、ユーザーの皆様から圧倒的な支持をいただいております。

- Get daily insights & tips.

bluejetty:00121096:ios.description:
COP Trânsito é um app de apoio prático para consulta de legislação e informações relacionadas à fiscalização de trânsito no Brasil.
NOVO: ASSISTENTE COP
Faça perguntas em linguagem natural sobre enquadramentos de trânsito, CTB, Código Penal e resoluções do CONTRAN. Pesquise por artigo, código ou descrição de uma situação e receba respostas rápidas e organizadas, com indicação da fonte disponível no app.
Para usuários autenticados, o Assistente COP também pode apresentar resumos protegidos do histórico de autuações e dos veículos de interesse, sem utilizar identificadores pessoais na consulta.
Desenvolvido para auxiliar policiais militares, agentes de segurança pública, agentes fiscalizadores e usuários que desejam consultar informações sobre infrações de trânsito de forma rápida e organizada.
No app você encontra:
- Assistente COP para consultas em linguagem natural
- Consulta rápida de enquadramentos de trânsito
- Pesquisa por artigo, código, tipificação ou descrição da situação
- Tipificação resumida e tipificação completa
- Informações sobre natureza da infração, pontuação, valor, penalidade e medidas administrativas
- Consulta ao CTB
- Consulta ao Código Penal
- Resoluções do CONTRAN
- Histórico de autuações
- Favoritos
- Consulta e registro de veículos de interesse
- Recursos de localização
- Identificação aproximada de rua, bairro, cidade e código do município
- Velocímetro em tempo real em km/h e mph
- Latitude e longitude
- Suporte a recursos no Apple Watch
As respostas fornecidas pelo Assistente COP são informativas e não substituem a conferência da legislação, das normas e dos procedimentos oficiais aplicáveis.

bluejetty:00017967:ios.name: Gold Tracker: Live Spot Price
bluejetty:00017967:ios.summary: Gold Tracker is the all-in-one precious metals app for iPhone. Track the live gold price, silver price, and spot prices for platinum and palladium. View fast charts, manage your portfolio, and record every coin, bar, purchase, and sale in o
bluejetty:00017967:ios.description:
Gold Tracker is the all-in-one precious metals app for iPhone. Track the live gold price, silver price, and spot prices for platinum and palladium. View fast charts, manage your portfolio, and record every coin, bar, purchase, and sale in one place. Built for stackers, Gold Tracker helps you track bullion, monitor your holdings, and stay on top of the precious metals market with powerful tools designed for real-world use.
Live Gold and Silver Prices
Follow the gold price and silver price in real time, along with platinum and palladium spot prices. View the market in the units and currencies that matter to you.
Widgets
Keep up with the precious metals market using home screen and lock screen widgets for live spot prices.
Apple Watch App
Check gold, silver, platinum, and palladium prices right from your wrist.
Calculators
Use customizable precious metals calculators for fast pricing. Ideal for gold stores, coin shops, pawn shops, and in-person bullion deals. Need discretion? Hide the percentage you are paying so you can calculate values in front of customers without showing your margin.
Vault
Use the Vault to record your precious metal purchases and sales with item-level detail. Track the coins and bars you actually own, including products such as American Gold Eagles, American Buffalos, Canadian Maple Leafs, Krugerrands, and bars from trusted names like PAMP Suisse, Perth, Valcambi, and many more. Add each item individually to maintain a detailed inventory, then track gain or loss per item and keep a complete history of every transaction.
Portfolio Tracking
Monitor your stack with a clear view of your holdings, transactions, and performance over time.
Currencies and Units
Gold Tracker supports more than 150 currencies and multiple weight units, including troy ounces, grams, kilograms, and pennyweights.
Charts
View precious metals charts across multiple units and currencies to better understand market movement and spot price changes.
Whether you stack gold, silver, platinum, or other precious metals, Gold Tracker gives you a faster way to follow prices, track your bullion, and manage your portfolio.

- Charity Fairy: Donations are made when fans achieve 55,555,555 votes on special days (Birthdays, Comebacks, Anniversaries).
- This is how your votes create positive influence!

- Team up with global fans to gift special ads (Subway, Large Billboards) to your idol on anniversaries.

- Miracle of the Month: Vote for idols with birthdays this month! The winner gets a large-scale ad reward.
- CHOEAEDOL Rookie: Promote rookies (debuted within 18 months) with a subway ad reward!
● Real-time Voting & Hall of Fame
- Vote every day! Vote counts reset daily at midnight (KST) for a fresh start.
- Cumulative rankings over 30 days decide the Hall of Fame ranking.

- The ultimate hub for fans! Share KPOP photos, videos, fancams, GIFs, and memes.

- Supports 17 languages for effortless global connection.
- Join the Open Chat Rooms to talk 24/7 with fans who love the same artists!

- Download high-quality, phone-optimized wallpapers, fan art, and official photos for free.
- Share and collect HD images for your own photocards (poca)!

- Stay updated onl schedules for comebacks, concerts, fan meetings, fansigns, music show broadcasts, and awards.
- Set reminders so you never miss a moment!
● KPOP Quiz & Fan Wiki
- Stay updated on comebacks, concerts, fan meetings, music shows, and award ceremonies.
- Contribute to the Idol Wiki and share everything you know about your favorite idol.
● Heart Arcade (Play Games, Get Hearts)
- Play fun mini-games (like Retro Snake) and collect more hearts to vote for your idol!
● Idol Face Match
- Who do I look like? Upload your photo to find the KPOP idol you resemble most.
● Bannagram (Community Banners)
- Make your community unique! Square images that get the most hearts become your idol's profile icon.
- Top 3 images become the community's header banner!

- Official voting app for major awards like SBS Gayo Daejeon, Asia Artist Awards (AAA), K-Global Heart Dream Awards, Soribada Awards, Gaon Chart Music Awards, etc.

bluejetty:00082948:ios.description:
Take command of your Smart TV effortlessly with our TV Remote app, right on your smartphone. Designed with a user-friendly interface, it’s compatible with a wide range of TV brands. Seamlessly connect your device to your TV over WIFI and gain comprehensive control over TV functions like volume, channels, input sources, and more, all from your mobile device. Whether you're streaming movies, gaming, or just chilling out, this app simplifies managing your TV from any location. Experience a new way to control your TV.
Effortlessly enhance your viewing experience by wirelessly linking your phone to TV: cast photos and videos from your phone to smart TV, transforming your compact screen into a vibrant, larger-than-life display; mirror your entire screen seamlessly for gaming, presentations, or enhanced browsing on a larger display; stream web videos directly via advanced web casting tools, enjoying high-quality playback for a cinematic experience in your living room—perfect for sharing personal media or web content.
Key Features
● Universal Remote for Smart TVs: Use your iPhone or iPad to operate nearly any Smart TV. This app is compatible with numerous Smart TV models.
 ● Screen Mirroring for Smart TVs: Directly stream all the content from your phone to your TV. Enjoy your content on the big screen with seamless screen mirroring.
●Web Browser: Stream online content from the web effortlessly using web casting tools, supporting open and casting multiple browser tabs. Enjoy high-quality playback straight on TV.
● Channel Management for Smart TVs: Flexibly manage your channels. Easily add new ones, toggle between channels, and access favorites with a single click.
● Effortless Search: Swiftly locate your favorite shows and movies with a virtual keyboard. Just type to explore channels.
● Automatic Device Recognition: The Smart TV remote app identifies compatible devices on your WiFi network automatically, ensuring a quick and easy setup.
● 24/7 Support: Offer timely and professional help and support.
Compatible with the remote functions of major TV systems. If your TV system is one of the above systems but the brand is other, don't worry, we can also adapt it. At the same time, it is compatible with the Casting function of many TVs.
Disclaimer: This app is not affiliated with or endorsed by any specific TV brands.
How to use:
● Step 1: Make sure your phone and powered-on Smart TV are on the same Wi-Fi network.
● Step 2: Enable local network access permission. iOS system must allow this permission to discover your TV.
● Step 3:Tap the Connect icon at the top right.
● Step 4: Select and pair your Smart TV from the list displayed on your phone screen.
● Step 5: You are ready to use. Try out every feature of our app!
For complete access to all Cast to TV Universal TV Remote features, you will need to subscribe to Premium. For Smart TVs / Devices, the only setting required is to connect your phone as well as your Smart TV / Device to the same Wifi network.
Unlimited Access Membership Subscription
Weekly Premium Membership offers $4.99.

About Lineage 2: Revolution
Venture into a breathtaking new fantasy world with stunning visuals powered by the Unreal Engine 4. Experience large scale, open-world combat where up to 200 players can battle in real time on a single screen! Party up with strangers or form clans with friends to conquer epic raid dungeons, take down fearsome boss monsters, or compete with thousands of other players around the world in competitive battles.
Lineage 2: Revolution is a groundbreaking, new online role-playing game that brings top-quality visuals, a massive open-world, and large-scale PvP battles to life on mobile devices. Players can finally experience what it truly means to have a gorgeous, fully-featured, persistent world MMORPG that can be enjoyed alongside millions around the world, all within the palm of your hands! 
The time has now come for new heroes to rise, to begin a new chapter in history, and to save the world from eternal darkness. 
Join the revolution!
※KEY FEATURES※
▶REAL-TIME MASSIVE BATTLES
Battle other players in thrilling real-time, open-field PvP battles or wage war on an epic scale through competitive 50-vs-50 Fortress Siege matches!
▶STUNNING VISUALS
Powered by the Unreal Engine 4, Lineage 2: Revolution pushes the boundaries of what’s graphically possible. Witness never-before-seen graphics on your mobile device!
▶SEAMLESS OPEN-WORLD
Explore a vast, stunning, and lush open-world that allows thousands of players to simultaneously explore, discover, and conquer.
▶CLANS & GUILDS
Group up with friends and guildmates, or party up with thousands of other players around the world to take down epic bosses, engage in mass-scale PvP combat, and uncover loot in epic raid dungeons.

LoA needs lots of teamwork. Each team has five players. Each player has to select a role to play with, such as Tank, Healer, Shooter, Mage, Ganker. Players must cooperate to beat the enemies.
LoA is the best place to show off your talent. With the ranking system and matchmaking system, you will meet all the players around the world. Anyone with great skill can be famous here.

bluejetty:00039824:ios.name: ConnectStats -
bluejetty:00039824:ios.summary: WARNING: The current version due to an API change will currently not see any existing history of your activities for Garmin, but only download activities done after your first install. We are working on a fix, meanwhile you can use strava i
bluejetty:00039824:ios.description:
WARNING: The current version due to an API change will currently not see any existing history of your activities for Garmin, but only download activities done after your first install. We are working on a fix, meanwhile you can use strava in addition to Garmin to see some history
DESCRIPTION
Connect Stats is an activity viewer for Garmin Connect or Strava. It provides in-depth review of your activities, search, analysis, plot and see basic statistics on all your data collected in garmin connect or strava from your iphone or ipad. You can read some of the motivation behind the app in the blog
NOTES
 - Data from activity trackers like vivofit or vivosmart are not supported by this app.
 - In case of initial connection trouble or issue, please check the support web site, the help or send me a bug report. If you write a negative review I can't reply to you and help you.
 - This app is updated incrementally regularly, so the latest reviews constantly drop. Feel free to look at all reviews or leave a new one if you like the app.
 - This app is now open source. See the support web page for details.
FEATURES
- Detailled report on your activities, with laps break down, map gradient, graphs and statistics
- Use gradient color to visually see on the map your heart rate, speed, power or cadence
- Calendar view of your activities
- Activity search
- Monthly/Weekly summary statistics of your activities
- Monthly/Weekly/Detailled Historical report and graphs on any collected data
- Display scatter plots, trend lines for both historical and track data.
- Best Rolling Plots, histograms.
- Support multiple garmin connect account simultaneously with multiple profiles.
- Support most activity types, including support for lap swimming, ski, run bike, ...
- Display the location name for your activities.
- Derived metrics (stride length, Power kJ,...),
- Calculated and auto laps for arbitrary distances or time. Let's you see you split time or distance, fastest km, etc
- Display time in zone for power and heart rate. Zones are downloaded from garmin connect.
- Best Rolling plots and lap for HR, pace and power (Critical Power Plot)
- This app can import information from your HealthKit Data like the weight to add it to the analysis of your fitness
FIRST USE
- when you start the program you will be have to choose and enable download for the service of your choice. 
 * Garmin: you can choose the connectstats service, which will pop up a login message or to download from the website in which case you will have to enter your user name and password. 
 * Strava: upon first refresh, the strava login page will popup.
- you can then download activities by pulling down on the activity list.
- Note that the initial download process can be slow if you have a lot of activities. Also for Garmin activities from Garmin there will be an initial synchronisation that can take some time before the activities are ready.
- If you have issue connecting check the trouble shooting section on the web page.
- There is also a help section in the setting tab.
HOW TO USE IT
- You can refresh by pulling down the activity list
- You can navigate the different tabs and touching most data will let you drill down on that number.
- You can touch a graph or the gear button to rotate through the different graphs options or bring in the graph full screen.
- You can reload an activity to update changes in garmin connect by pulling down on the detail tab
- You can see full history of any field by selecting the field name in the stats page
Check the web site and the blog for a lot more details on how to use it and what the different screen and graph mean.

  * Garmin: you can choose the connectstats service, which will pop up a login message or to download from the website in which case you will have to enter your user name and password. 
  * Strava: upon first refresh, the strava login page will popup.
- you can then download activities by pulling down on the activity list.
- Note that the initial download process can be slow if you have a lot of activities. Also for Garmin activities from Garmin there will be an initial synchronisation that can take some time before the activities are ready.
- If you have issue connecting check the trouble shooting section on the web page.
- There is also a help section in the setting tab.

HOW TO USE IT

- You can refresh by pulling down the activity list
- You can navigate the different tabs and touching most data will let you drill down on that number.
- You can touch a graph or the gear button to rotate through the different graphs options or bring in the graph full screen.
- You can reload an activity to update changes in garmin connect by pulling down on the detail tab
- You can see full history of any field by selecting the field name in the stats page

Check the web site and the blog for a lot more details on how to use it and what the different screen and graph mean.

In 2148 A.D., the center of the United Government of Humanity was moved from the 3rd planet of the solar system(Earth), to the 2nd planet of the Aldebaran(Taurus a) system(Deoria), where the declaration of the founding of the Galactic Federation was made, and the year was changed to the first year of the cosmic calendar.
 With the advancement of controlled nuclear fusion, subspace jump navigation, gravity control and inertial control, the human sailed to the vast sea of stars in space ships in order to explore the unknown world of space.
 However, these wanton interstellar voyages have also attracted the attention of other civilizations in the universe.
 In the 12th year of the cosmic calendar, several space stations located on the planet Betelgeuse(Orion a) were attacked by the mysterious alien mechworm. The Mechworm is a kind of metal life form completely different from human. They are warlike by nature and have highly developed technology. After paying a great price, the advance troops of the Mechworm were repelled, and the human were able to survive.

Therefore, human decided to set up an expeditionary force to go to outer space to find traces of the Mechworm troops, and transfer the next battlefield to the planet where they lived. -Touch the screen to move and shoot enemies

-Powerful and diverse starships

bluejetty:00157698:ios.description:
Peek is the money app that doesn't lecture you. No spreadsheets, no guilt trips, no budgets you'll abandon by Tuesday.
Instead, Peek talks to you. It notices a charge, asks what happened, and helps you see the story behind your spending — the impulse TikTok buy, the Friday coffee ritual, the "while I'm here" spiral. Over time, it learns how you think about money and reflects it back so you actually understand your own patterns.
How it works:
Peek checks in with you about your recent spending through quick, casual conversations. It asks the right questions — not "did you stay under budget?" but "was that worth it to you?" — and builds a picture of your spending behavior that gets sharper over time.
What makes Peek different:
→ Conversations, not spreadsheets
→ Self-awareness, not restrictions
→ Understands your "why," not just your "what"
→ Built for how Gen Z actually relates to money
Peek won't tell you to stop buying oat milk. It'll help you notice that you buy it every time you're stressed — and let you decide what to do with that.
Your money. Your patterns. Your call.

View important device details like model, iOS version, screen size, UUID, and more. Perfect when you need accurate data for apps, troubleshooting, or support.

Track battery status, storage usage, and system performance. Understand how your device is running and make smarter decisions.

Solve network issues faster

- Useful tools like compass and flashlight

bluejetty:00170033:ios.description:
What could be kinder than a friendly reminder?
Is your to-do list full of to-didn'ts? You meant to get to them. You really did. But a list can't tap you on the shoulder at 3:47 PM. RE.minder PRO+ can.
RE.minder PRO+ isn't about getting organized — it's about getting things done on time. Set a reminder in as few as three taps, and RE.minder PRO+ makes sure the nudge arrives right when you need it. Even offline. Everything is included: every feature, every sound, every icon, and no ads.
REMINDERS THAT ACTUALLY GET THROUGH
• Time-Sensitive notifications break through Do Not Disturb, so the important ones don't get silenced along with everything else.
• CarPlay alerts sound while you're driving (or turn them off in Settings).
• Bug Me nags you every minute or every hour until you deal with it.
• Running late? Delay a reminder in one tap — or delay them all, or just the overdue ones.
• Mute reminders for a while when you need some quiet.
YOUR NEXT REMINDER, AT A GLANCE
• A Home Screen widget shows your next reminder — or the next several on larger sizes — with its own colors, icon, and photo.
• A countdown to your next reminder, right at the top of the list.
• Every repeating reminder shows how often it repeats — like "2w" for every 2 weeks — in the list and on the widget.
• Siri & Shortcuts: add reminders hands-free — try "Remind me with RE.minder" — or build them into your own Shortcuts.
YOUR REMINDERS, YOUR WAY
• Photos on reminders, so you remember exactly what it's about.
• Advanced repeats: days of the week, a set number of repetitions, end dates, and schedules like "every 2 months on the second Tuesday" — right on the reminder screen, with a plain-language summary.
• iCloud sync and backup, with a sync status that shows when your reminders last synced. Clear a reminder on one device and it's cleared on all of them.
• Color schemes: pick a built-in one or design your own.

bluejetty:00142385:ios.description:
Dynamic Lyrics is an app that displays real-time lyrics and translations on your lock screen, Dynamic Island, widgets, floating windows, and more. It supports Apple Music and Spotify.
You can also use the Shazam mode to identify music playing on any app, webpage, or in your surroundings.
• Lock Screen Lyrics & Dynamic Island Lyrics
Display real-time lyrics on the lock screen and Dynamic Island, enhancing your music experience.
• Lyrics Widget
Show real-time lyrics on the home screen widget and StandBy mode.
• Floating Lyrics
Display lyrics anywhere using a floating window.
• Supports Lyrics Translation
Translate lyrics into any supported language, breaking down language barriers.
• Supports Multiple Music Apps
Seamlessly compatible with Apple Music and Spotify for a smooth experience.
• Shazam Mode
With Shazam mode, you can identify music playing on any app, webpage, or in your surroundings and view the lyrics.
• Lyrics Sharing
Share beautiful lyrics cards effortlessly with friends.
Dynamic Lyrics® Membership Description:
By becoming a Dynamic Lyrics® member, you can unlock all premium features, enjoy free updates in the future, and benefit from an ad-free experience.
You can choose between a subscription or a lifetime membership with a one-time payment.
If you choose a subscription, it will automatically renew through your iTunes account.
Your Apple iTunes account will be charged within 24 hours before the current period ends, and the subscription will renew for the next cycle.
To cancel the renewal, please manually turn off the auto-renewal option in your Apple ID settings at least 24 hours before the current subscription period ends.
If you do not cancel during the trial period, the subscription will automatically activate and charge you at the end of the trial.
This service is entirely optional. If you choose not to cancel, the next billing period will renew automatically.
Privacy Policy: https://musiclyrics.cn/privacy.html
User Agreement: https://musiclyrics.cn/agreement.html

bluejetty:00029731:ios.description:

Sound Scouts values your privacy. Your data will not be shared with any third party.
Refer to our privacy policy.

PopAi is an all-in-one AI productivity app that helps you scan and solve homework, create presentations, grade homework, identify anything from a photo, translate text instantly, and generate images or videos—quickly and effortlessly. - Simply snap a photo of any object—plants, animals, insects, stones, bones, landmarks, products, food, or tools—and PopAi will instantly identify what it is.
- Smart Recognition: Backed by AI, it provides accurate results with detailed information to satisfy your curiosity or support your learning.

- Engage in real-time Chat AI conversations to ask anything and get quick answers and insights for free.

- Input a topic, and AI automatically generates a well-structured presentation
- Choose from various PPT templates for classrooms, meetings, and speeches

bluejetty:00076563:ios.description:
iTourTranslator—Your Personal Translator, Where Accuracy Meets Excellence! Bridge global communication effortlessly with just one click!
 Whether it's for studying abroad, business, or travel, no more language barriers! Supporting over a hundred languages, with detailed accents differentiation, iTourTranslator combines recording, translating, and history logging all in one to help you fluently manage multilingual scenarios.
Main Features: 
【Simultaneous Interpretation & Real-Time Recording Translation】:
● Efficient and precise translation in 100+ languages: accurately recognizes speech even with noise, distance, or heavy accents.
● One-click recording, instantly converted to text: Capture pivotal information anytime, anywhere like in meetings, classrooms, or while traveling. 
● Bi-directional translation: Facilitates real-time bilingual communication, eliminating language obstacles. 
● Floating subtitle window (ideal for TV shows, podcasts, live-streams): Choose between internal or external recording option, to enjoy bilingual subtitles without fear of noise. 
【Phone Calls & Audio/Video Translation】:
● Phone Call Translation: The other party doesn't need to install the app; real-time bilingual subtitles are displayed. You speak in Chinese, and foreign languages are heard; they speak in a foreign language, and you see the Chinese translation. 
● * Audio/Video Translation: Supports platforms like Skype, WhatsApp, Facebook, without requiring installation, enabling barrier-free communication with real-time bilingual subtitles. 
【Bilingual Conversations】:
● Real-time bi-directional translation: Speak in Chinese, they hear in English (and vice versa). 
● Face-to-face conversation translation: Two-person dialogue mode, split-screen displaying bilingual results, useful during chats, meetings, or travels. 
【 Document Translation】: Document Translation: Supports multiple formats, quick translation, and export, making work and study more efficient. 
 Ideal for: 
【Students】: Online & offline classes, one-click recording translation, mark key points, insert images, easily record course notes for efficient learning. 
【Professionals】: Foreign corporations & trade, office meetings, business negotiations, phone/meeting translation, intelligently summarizing meeting contents, simplifying work. 
【Business Travelers】: Global travel, real-time recording translation, never fear not understanding again! 【Clerical Workers】: Managing various meetings with ease, one-click complete meeting records. 【Translators】: Assisting in quickly understanding and translating between different languages, reducing work pressure, and improving efficiency when facing extensive translation tasks. 
Supported Languages: 
We support real-time online translation in 104 languages including Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Arabic, Russian, Portuguese, Spanish, Thai, Finnish, Italian, Dutch, Hebrew, Persian, Maltese, Vietnamese, Urdu, Polish, Indonesian, Malay, Turkish, Burmese, Filipino, Ukrainian, Swedish, Turkish, Lao, Zulu, and more.
【Automatic renewal subscription instructions】
1. Subscription service: one month package, one year package
2.Subscription price: depending on the type of package, $14.99-$249.99
3. Auto Renewal: Accounts purchasing consecutive monthly packages will be automatically deducted from the iunes account 24 hours before the monthly expiry date, and the membership validity will be extended by one month.
 4.close subscribe: To cancel your subscription, Please manually open the "Settings" of ios Enter "iTunes Store and App Store"-->Click "Apple ID",Select "View Apple ID", enter the "Account Settings" page, and click "Subscriptions",Then choose "mounth package" to cancel your subscription.
 5.Terms of Use: https://www.tranzi.cn/privacy/sipsa_en.html
 Privacy Policy: https://www.tranzi.cn/privacy-policyEn.html
 Automatic renewal agreement：https://www.tranzi.cn/privacy/iOS/automatic-renewal.html?lan=en

bluejetty:00044771:ios.description:
تطبيق دانة هو الوجهة الصحيحة لعالم أزياء المرأة وفضاء التسوق الإلكتروني. ولأن دانة هي لؤلؤ التميز والرقي؛ تم إنشاء التطبيق ليجمع درر من أجمل العبايات والجلابيات والفساتين والبناطيل وغيرها من أزياء المرأة بتصاميم عصرية وأنيقة، وتصاميم أخرى كلاسيكية وفخمة تلبي احتياجات كل امرأة، وتوافق مختلف الأذواق.
دانة هو تطبيق تسوق إلكتروني مختص بأزياء المرأة أطلقته شركة مقرها في المملكة العربية السعودية، وتوفر لكم خدمة التوصيل لجميع دول مجلس التعاون الخليجي.
مميزات تطبيق دانة:
- يضع بين يديكِ تشكيلة واسعة من أزياء المرأة تتضمن العباية بأشكالها المختلفة (عبايات ملونة – عبايات شتوية وصيفية)، ويوفر لكِ أيضاً جلابيات شتوية وصيفية، فساتين، جمبسوت، بناطيل، بلايز، تيشيرتات وغيرها من أنواع وأشكال الأزياء المختلفة التي يفصل بينكِ وبين الحصول عليها ضغطة زر.
- يوفر لكِ صور واضحة للمنتجات بأكثر من زاوية، ووصف لتفاصيل المنتجات، ودليل للمقاسات لتجربة تسوق أكثر دقة وسهولة.
- وجهة مناسبة لجميع النساء من مختلف الفئات العمرية.
- سهولة الاستخدام وإتمام عملية الطلب بخطوات بسيطة.
- توصيل لجميع مدن المملكة العربية السعودية والإمارات العربية المتحدة وسلطنة عمان والبحرين وقطر والكويت.
- طرق دفع متعددة وآمنة.
- دفع عند الاستلام
- خدمة عملاء، وقسم خاص للمساعدة والأسئلة الشائعة والتواصل.
- خدمة التقسيط على مدى عدد من الشهور لطرق دفع محددة، أقسام خاصة بالقطع المخفضة، كوبونات خصم، عروض متعددة، برنامج نقاط الولاء للعملاء، وخدمة التوصيل المجاني بشروط واضحة وسهلة وميسرة للجميع.
الدعم والمساعدة: care@daanah.com

bluejetty:00044006:ios.description:
** Welcome to Cozy Home: Comfy Coloring Book! **
Relax, color, and enjoy a world full of warmth and happiness. This cute coloring book for adults and teens brings you cozy places to paint, from peaceful bedrooms to charming cafes. A perfect way to relieve stress and spark creativity!
** Why you’ll love Cozy Home: Comfy Coloring Book: ** 
 - # Cute and cozy coloring pages # - Paint beautiful home spaces, bookshops, cafes, and more!
 - # Relaxing and stress-relief experience # - Enjoy peaceful moments while coloring.
 - # Easy to paint, fun to explore # - Bold lines and big spaces make it simple and enjoyable.
 - # Hand-drawn artwork # - Every picture is created by professional artists, no AI used!
 - # Unlimited colors and gradients - Use color palettes, custom colors, and stunning gradients.
 - # CozyHub community # - Share your artwork and get likes from other players.
 - # Perfect for all skill levels # - No matter your experience, your pictures will look amazing!
** A cozy coloring book made just for you ** 
Cozy Home: Comfy Coloring Book is all about happiness, creativity, and calm. This coloring book for adults and teens is designed to bring joy and relaxation through art. Our artists have carefully drawn every picture to make coloring easy and fun, with big spaces and clear lines.
Inside, you’ll find tens of beautiful coloring pages featuring cozy home spaces: kitchens, bedrooms, bathrooms, laundry rooms, storage rooms, children’s rooms, and home offices. There are also charming bookshops, cafés, and gyms. Every place feels alive, full of personality, and waiting for color! Imagine a bedroom with an electric guitar or a creative workspace - these details let you picture the people who might live there, even though no people are shown. This makes coloring even more fun and engaging!
We believe coloring should be a true stress relief activity. That’s why Cozy Home: Comfy Coloring Book is designed for comfort. You can choose from a wide range of color palettes, create your own custom colors, and even add depth using gradient colors. Whether you want a bright and cheerful look or a soft and dreamy atmosphere, the choice is yours! Even if you have never colored before, your pictures will turn out great.
** Share your cozy world in CozyHub! ** 
Coloring is even more fun when shared! Cozy Home: Comfy Coloring Book has a simple built-in community called CozyHub, where you can post your artwork and get likes from other users. Show off your creativity, explore other players’ work, and enjoy the friendly and happy atmosphere.
** Cozy, calm, and full of color! ** 
Cozy Home: Comfy Coloring Book is the perfect coloring book for adults and teens who love cute, happy, and relaxing art. Whether you want to unwind, boost creativity, or just enjoy a moment of peace, this comfy coloring book is here for you. Get ready to bring cozy spaces to life with color!

bluejetty:00046611:ios.description:
Features:
--Security first to protect confidential information (ePHI) including secure messaging between caregivers, care recipients, and their agency
--Verify visits using all data required by DHS, or simply use as a timesheet prior to state implementation of EVV
--Caregivers and consumers can use the app to sign timesheets together, or each use their own login.
--Suitable for PCA Choice or PCA Traditional: visits can be scheduled or on-demand
--View service agreement usage in real time
--View past care history
--Available in 8 languages (Spanish, Hmong, Chinese, Russian, Vietnamese, Somali, Oromo, Amharic, and of course English)
Description:
The Cashé EVV App is your ideal Electronic Visit Verification hub. Cashé EVV is a secure and simple time verification solution that allows you to focus on what really matters - your care recipients.
With the tap of a finger, your caregivers can start a scheduled or unscheduled visit, stop and document the visit, review the visit details, electronically sign and submit the visit, and more.
You can easily ensure your agency is compliant to EVV requirements, while benefiting from additional features like secure messaging, real-time visit alerts, agency dashboards, and more.
Cashé Software - Making a Difference in the Lives of People in Need.

For medical practices, the RxV mobile app helps
bluejetty:00157123:ios.description:
At RxVantage, we are working towards a world where healthcare professionals can connect instantly, effortlessly, and securely to any life science resource they need, to improve patient care.
For medical practices, the RxV mobile app helps drive better engagements with life science experts by giving access to your practice's RxV account while on the go. The app helps you connect with the right life science expert, communicate with those experts via in-app messaging, manage calendars and appointments across all office locations, and more.
For life science representatives, the app helps prepare for better engagements. Representatives can access their RxVantage account to book and manage appointments with practices, respond quickly to communications through in-app messaging, review practice's rules and preferences, and more.
The RxVantage app helps medical practices and the life science experts who call on them drive the right engagements, keep up with the fast-paced and constantly changing landscape to deliver the best care for every patient.
The RxVantage app is provided free of charge to licensed users. Use of the app requires a valid user license. Please visit RxVantage.com or talk to your RxVantage Admin to create and activate your account.

bluejetty:00116743:ios.description:
Glimpse is the easiest way to journal. Speak your thoughts and it can write back to you with AI. It's a conversation with yourself and a way to remember your life.
EFFORTLESS VOICE JOURNALING
Speak your thoughts and watch them transform into beautifully transcribed journal entries. No typing needed—just talk naturally and Glimpse captures everything.
AI-POWERED SUMMARIES (Requires purchase of Glimpse AI Tokens*)
Quickly review what matters with automatic summaries of your daily, weekly, or monthly reflections, making it easy to track your journey.
PERSONALIZED INSIGHTS (Requires purchase of Glimpse AI Tokens*)
Discover patterns in your thinking you might have missed. Glimpse's AI analyzes your entries to offer objective, personalized insights about your thoughts and feelings.
CHAT WITH YOUR JOURNAL (Requires purchase of Glimpse AI Tokens*)
Have meaningful conversations about your entries with Glimpse's AI companion. Ask questions, explore perspectives, and gain deeper understanding through dialogue.
INSPIRING PROMPTS
Never face a blank page again. Choose from diverse journaling prompts across different themes to spark reflection when you need inspiration.
VISUAL JOURNALING
Enhance your entries with images that capture moments.
CUSTOMIZABLE EXPERIENCE
Make Glimpse your own with customizable themes and writing styles that match your personality and preferences.
ORGANIZED & SEARCHABLE
Easily find past entries by date or keywords, so your insights are always at your fingertips when you need them.
JOURNALING THAT FITS YOUR LIFE
Set gentle reminders that work with your schedule, helping you build a consistent journaling practice without feeling pressured.
COMPLETELY PRIVATE & SECURE
Your thoughts remain yours alone. All entries are protected with optional password/biometric security and encrypted cloud backup for peace of mind.
TAKE YOUR JOURNAL ANYWHERE
Seamlessly sync and export entries in various formats whenever you need them.
We believe intentionality is the foundation of a fulfilling life. In a world where journaling hasn't evolved in years, we're pioneering a more meaningful approach—transforming personal reflection from a chore into a journey of discovery. What begins as a glimpse into your thoughts gradually reveals a complete picture of who you are, and how you can live a better life.
*Glimpse Tokens power AI features. Each AI interaction uses 1-3 tokens. Subscribers automatically receive 200 tokens per month. Additional tokens can be purchased within the app.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00079214:ios.summary: Track your USCIS case and your immigration court (EOIR) case in one place, in English, Spanish or Portuguese. See how your judge decides, how many people in your filing block have already been approved, and get an instant alert the moment s
bluejetty:00079214:ios.description:
Track your USCIS case and your immigration court (EOIR) case in one place, in English, Spanish or Portuguese. See how your judge decides, how many people in your filing block have already been approved, and get an instant alert the moment something changes. Official data, no rumors, no ads. More than 2 million people already follow their case with Inmigreat.
YOUR USCIS CASE
• Add your receipt number (I-485, I-130, I-765, I-131, N-400, I-589, I-821 TPS, parole and more) and see your full case history.
• Instant alerts when USCIS changes your status.
• My Block: who filed 7 days before and after you, who has been approved, and how your block moves week by week.
• Smart Prediction: your place in line and an estimated date based on the real pace of approvals (Pro).
YOUR IMMIGRATION COURT CASE (EOIR)
• With your A-number: next hearing, assigned judge, court and case status.
• Your judge's profile: how they decide, in absentia rate, average days and monthly decision pace, from EOIR data.
• Outcomes by nationality and comparison with 700+ immigration judges nationwide.
• Your court case clock: how many days it has been open compared with your judge's average.
LEXI, YOUR ASSISTANT
• Answers in English, Spanish or Portuguese about your process, with your case as context. Clear information, not legal advice.
COMMUNITY BY CASE TYPE
• Groups for I-485, asylum, parole, TPS, N-400 and court. People on the same path as you, verified against their real case.
PRACTICE YOUR INTERVIEW (Pro)
• Voice mock interviews for asylum, credible fear, green card and citizenship. N-400 Hub with civics, English and interview practice.
VERIFIED ATTORNEY DIRECTORY
• Licensed, verified attorneys for when you need real legal advice.
INMIGREAT PRO
• USCIS silent updates: connect your myUSCIS account and see when USCIS touches your case, even when the public status doesn't change.
• Smart Prediction, unlimited interview practice and processing statistics. Monthly or annual, cancel anytime. Your case, your court, your judge and the community are free; Pro adds the analysis.
PRIVACY
• We only look up the receipt number or A-number you add, or the cases in the myUSCIS account you choose to connect. From myUSCIS we keep only your case numbers and their statuses: no names, no documents, no notices. We never store your USCIS password. No ads.
Inmigreat is an independent app. We are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or representing USCIS, EOIR, the Department of Homeland Security, the Department of Justice, or any other U.S. government agency. Inmigreat provides information based on public and official data sources. We do not provide legal advice and we do not represent cases. For legal advice, consult a licensed immigration attorney or a DOJ-accredited representative.
Terms and Conditions: https://www.inmigreat.com/en/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://www.inmigreat.com/en/privacy/
Questions? support@inmigreat.com

Завантаж
bluejetty:00144464:ios.description:
З 2008 року Планета Кіно закохує глядачів у кіно через найновіші технології та комфортний сервіс у Києві, Харкові, Львові, Дніпрі, Сумах та Одесі. Саме ми привезли в Україну IMAX та 4DX, вигадали кіноресторани RE'LUX і кіномаркет.
Завантажуй додаток, щоб зробити свій похід в кінотеатр ще зручнішим.
Купуй квитки онлайн та забудь про черги до каси. Зручний інтерфейс і детальні фільтри допоможуть швидко знайти потрібний сеанс у твоєму кінотеатрі. Електронний квиток контролер просканує на вході до кінозалу просто з твого смартфону.
Бонуси за кожен кінопохід. Реєструйся в клубі Планети Кіно та збирай бонуси за кожну витрачену гривню в кінотеатрах мережі. Стеж за балансом бонусів в особистому кабінеті й обмінюй їх на квитки, попкорн чи напої.
Стеж за виходом найочікуваніших прем’єр. Додавай фільми в обрані та отримуй сповіщення про старт продажів або початок прокату в кінотеатрі.
Повідомляй про проблему на сеансі просто в додатку. Команда кінотеатру зробить усе, щоб її вирішити.
Вже понад 1 млн кіноманів з нами! Встановлюй додаток зараз і приходь насолоджуватися кіно на великому екрані.

bluejetty:00038734:ios.summary:
MedSafeAI: The Advanced AI Assistant for Doctors and Licensed Healthcare Professionals
MedSafeAI is a powerful AI assistant designed exclusively for licensed healthcare professionals. It provides structured access to medical information, a
bluejetty:00038734:ios.description:
MedSafeAI: The Advanced AI Assistant for Doctors and Licensed Healthcare Professionals
MedSafeAI is a powerful AI assistant designed exclusively for licensed healthcare professionals. It provides structured access to medical information, analytical insights, and AI-supported observations across a wide range of clinical specialties. Through a clinician-focused user interface, MedSafeAI gives access to 80+ AI assistants, including 30+ clinical assistants and 50+ specialist AI agents, built on the official APIs of the world’s leading AI companies.
Powered by a dynamically updated ensemble of advanced AI models—including OpenAI GPT-5 and its newer models, as well as the latest models from Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, and xAI Grok—MedSafeAI allows healthcare professionals to work with fast or high-thinking models within a single app interface, while always relying on their own professional judgment and authoritative sources.
Important Disclaimer
MedSafeAI is not a diagnostic tool, treatment platform, or substitute for professional medical advice. It is an informational and educational tool intended solely for use by licensed healthcare professionals. All users must review and agree to a detailed medical disclaimer before using the app.
80+ AI Assistants for Healthcare Professionals
MedSafeAI offers specialized AI assistants designed to support medical knowledge access, analytical workflows, and clinical reference tasks. Users can ask general medical questions, explore medical literature, review clinical guidelines, and gain structured insights into laboratory results, drug interactions, and disease frameworks.
Healthcare professionals may upload medical images, including X-rays, CT scans, MRIs, ECGs, ultrasounds, dermatologic images, mammograms, PET scans, and histopathology slides, for AI-generated observational insights. Specialty-specific assistants span over 50+ medical fields, including cardiology, oncology, radiology, pediatrics, internal medicine, and more.
Medical knowledge assistants cover areas such as laboratory interpretation, pharmacology references, guideline alignment, prognostic considerations, genomic concepts, surgical risk frameworks, and chronic disease knowledge, strictly for informational support.
Why Choose MedSafeAI
Designed exclusively for licensed healthcare professionals, MedSafeAI simplifies access to advanced medical AI capabilities through a clear and professional user interface. The app provides access to multiple frontier AI models in one place and allows users to manually switch between models at any time.
MedSafeAI requires no account creation, email registration, or identity verification. The app does not request information about the user’s identity or professional credentials. Dark Mode and Light Mode are supported for use in different clinical environments.
Commitment to Responsible Use
Healthcare professionals are expected to use MedSafeAI in accordance with applicable privacy, confidentiality, and professional regulations, and to ensure that any information entered into the app does not include identifiable patient data where such use is not permitted.
AI-generated outputs may be incomplete or inaccurate and must always be independently evaluated and verified using authoritative medical sources. MedSafeAI supports, but does not replace, professional clinical judgment.
Third-Party AI Disclaimer: This app uses official APIs of third-party AI providers. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or represent these companies. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.
Subscription and Support
Subscriptions are managed through Apple’s App Store and can be canceled at any time from the user’s Apple ID settings. In-app support is available directly within the app, allowing users to contact the MedSafeAI support team without leaving the application.
Privacy Policy and Terms of Use
Privacy Policy: https://mn-appstudio.com/privacy-policy/
Terms of Use: https://mn-appstudio.com/terms/

bluejetty:00089126:ios.description:
Borne gets you speaking from day one.
Open the app and there's always something to talk about: today's news, a word of the day, the next episode of your story, or any topic you like. You just talk. Your tutor answers out loud, keeps it at your level and helps when you get stuck.
TODAY
• Today's news, picked for your interests, from real newspapers in the language you're learning. Tap to talk about it with your tutor.
• A word of the day, with an example you can listen to.
• Today's episode: a short story mission you play out with your tutor, a new one every day.
PRACTICE
• Talk about anything: type a topic, or just start.
• Scenes: play out real moments, like getting lost in a new city or ordering for a group of picky eaters.
• Your words: say five words out loud, earn a star, and watch them move to mastered.
AFTER EVERY LESSON
• A quick recap of how it went.
• "Say it like this": what you said, a better way to say it, and why.
• The new words worth keeping, ready to hear again.
PROGRESS
Your streak, minutes toward your weekly goal, conversations and words mastered, all in one place.
YOUR TUTOR
Pick a tutor from a real city and switch anytime. Use the Level button in any lesson for more help or for natural speed. Your tutor remembers what you talked about, so every lesson builds on the last.
LANGUAGES
Learn Spanish, French, Japanese, German, Korean, Italian, Chinese, Portuguese, Hindi, Russian, Arabic, Turkish, Dutch, Swedish, Norwegian or English: 16 languages. Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Hindi, Russian and Arabic can show romaji, pinyin or a reading in Latin letters under the text. The app itself is available in 10 languages.
TRY IT FREE
Your first lesson is free. Then start a 3-day free trial.
SUBSCRIPTIONS
Borne offers auto-renewing monthly and annual subscriptions. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel any time in your account settings. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you buy a subscription.
Terms: https://borne.ai/terms-of-service/
Privacy: https://borne.ai/privacy-policy/
Questions? support@borne.ai
