bluejetty:00061556:ios.description:
Use Post-it® Notes anywhere and anytime. Post-it® App brings the simplicity of Post-it® Notes to your iPhone, iPad and Mac. Whether you use Post-it® Notes for teamwork and collaboration, or for reminders and personal note taking, Post-it® App helps you keep the momentum going.
If you work from home or as a student in remote learning, use the Post-it® App to share your ideas with co-workers, structure your assignments and share them with your teacher, or create colorful calendars and share them with your friends.
Simply capture analog notes with your camera or create digital notes right on your device. Arrange, refine and organize ideas anyway you see fit. Collaborate and share notes with co-workers, teachers and friends, or export to your favorite apps and cloud services—including Miro, Trello, Dropbox, iCloud, PowerPoint, Excel, PDF, and more.
Post-it® App features:
• Connect and share ideas from anywhere with co-workers and friends, whether it be a workshop, a brainstorm or you simply want to share notes with each other.
• Capture more than 200 Post-it® Notes at a time with your camera. All our popular note sizes are supported.
• Transcribe your notes automatically using Handwriting Recognition. Great for search and exports.
• Draw, erase, type and change the color of your notes using powerful editing tools.
• Organize your way—group your ideas by thought or simply organize on a grid.
• Share to your favorite formats and cloud services to continue working on your ideas digitally—supports Miro, Trello, Dropbox, PowerPoint, Excel, PDF, and more.
• Use our widget to put your most important notes directly on your home screen.
• Keep your notes and boards in sync across all your Apple devices with iCloud. You can capture Post-it® Notes with your iPhone and edit the board on your Mac before you share with your team.
Learn more about Post-it® App at post-it.com/app

bluejetty:00126280:ios.description:
Deem Mobile is designed for anyone who wants business travel to be fast and easy. With full functionality to book flights, hotels, rental cars, and even Uber for Business, Deem Mobile makes it simple to manage an entire trip from a single app.
Deem Mobile can create a personalized experience for any traveler by remembering your preferences, loyalty memberships, and frequently traveled destinations. And by presenting compliant travel options, Deem Mobile prevents the wrong travel options from being booked in the first place. 
Manage Bookings
Modify or cancel reservations on your own with your mobile device.
Designed for Everyone
Deem Mobile provides features like adjustable text size, VoiceOver, and a clean design to help users with hearing, cognitive, or motor impairments.
EcoCheck
EcoCheck provides accurate carbon emissions data to help guide travelers to greener flights, hotels, rental cars, and more.
Save Time
Book air, hotel, and car reservations in one transaction, anywhere and anytime.
Stay Informed
Upcoming trip information and real-time flight push notifications are a tap away.
Features
Book and Manage
• Full booking capabilities
• View itinerary details
• Offline access to itineraries
• Share itinerary
• Access to company negotiated rates
Air
• Access to unused tickets
• Search for one-way, round-trip and multi-destination flights
• Select a seat
• Book low-cost carriers
• Push notifications for flight status
Hotel
• Access to extensive hotel content and negotiated rates
• Tripadvisor ratings
• View hotel property photos and amenities
Car
• Access to the car rental providers you know and love including Enterprise, Avis, and Budget
• Request a ride with Uber for Business in Deem
Highlights
• Travel SafetyCheck: Health and safety information for your trip
• Delegate booking: Book and monitor travel for the entire team 
• Accessibility: Designed for everyone
• Support: Contact travel support via phone or email
• Full booking capabilities: View, book, modify, or cancel trips
• Low-cost carriers: Access to global low-cost carriers
• Select a seat: Seat selection is available before checkout
• Push notifications: Get real-time flight alerts
• Unused tickets: Book flights with your unused tickets
• Shop faster: Save time with Google ITA engine and flexible fares
• Tripadvisor: Access to Tripadvisor ratings
*If you do not have access to Deem, contact your travel manager or reach out to our sales team today. You’re welcome aboard anytime.

bluejetty:00041367:ios.description:
Embark on an epic adventure with your adorable cats in this captivating idle RPG! Unlock a world filled with giant monsters, mythical realms, and strategic battles. Merge and evolve your feline heroes, engage in thrilling PvP battles, and join alliances to conquer the realm. With charming graphics and engaging gameplay, this game offers hours of enjoyment for cat lovers and RPG enthusiasts alike. Dive into the world of Cat Legends and become the ultimate idle slayer! 
Features in Cat Legends - Idle RPG:
- Adorable visuals: Enjoy charming and visually appealing graphics that bring the feline realm to life, creating an immersive and delightful gaming experience.
- Strategic gameplay: Engage in strategic gameplay mechanics as you lead a team of legendary cats. Choose the right combination of heroes, utilize their unique abilities, and plan your battles to overcome challenges.
- Customizable heroes: Level up your cat heroes, unlock new abilities, and equip them with powerful gear to enhance their skills and make them even more formidable in combat. Additionally, personalize their appearances with a variety of outfits and accessories to create a unique team of stylish feline warriors.
- Guild collaboration: Join forces with friends and other players by forming or joining guilds. Collaborate with guild members, participate in cooperative gameplay features, and work together to achieve common goals.
- PvP battles: Test your skills and strategies against other players in thrilling PvP battles. Compete with fellow cat guardians on leaderboards, prove your prowess, and earn rewards for your victories.
- Epic loot: As you battle against darkness, collect epic loot and valuable rewards. Discover powerful equipment and resources that will aid you in your quest to save the feline realm.
- Endless cat-loving fun: Immerse yourself in a world filled with adorable cats and captivating gameplay. Cat Legends - Idle RPG offers hours of entertainment, with its charming theme and addictive gameplay that will keep you engaged and coming back for more.
Unlock adorable and cute cats to battle giant monster in idle slayer RPG games

bluejetty:00082928:ios.name: Savage Survival: Jurassic Isle
bluejetty:00082928:ios.summary:
In this fierce realm where war dominates, ancient creatures roam, and every inch of the ground dares you to stake your claim, can you evolve from a mere survivor into a master of the wilds in Savage Survival?
Join your tribe in the raw spl
bluejetty:00082928:ios.description:
In this fierce realm where war dominates, ancient creatures roam, and every inch of the ground dares you to stake your claim, can you evolve from a mere survivor into a master of the wilds in Savage Survival?
Join your tribe in the raw splendor of the Stone Age! Move through lands rich with resources and home to giant creatures, where your courage charts the path from mere survival to flourishing prosperity. Merge diplomacy with might, shaping the wilderness to your vision, and tracking beasts to prove your growing strength. Adapt, innovate, and reign, making the wilds a testament to your tribe's triumph.
■■Embark on a Stone Age Strategy Adventure. Explore the Continents with survivors from around the world!■■
□Hunt down mighty prehistoric creatures in the ultimate survival challenge!
□Collect resources, build connections with other survivors, and fortify your territory!
□Create alliances, outwit your enemies, expand your territory, and upgrade your base with the help of strong allies, ready to take on the wild!
□Will you use tactics or will power? Survival instincts are key, as only those who adapt will flourish in this world!
□Don't miss the excitement of our global server's big launch.
■■Key Features■■
□□Strategic Real-Time Tactics□□
Lead your survivors, tame powerful prehistoric creatures, awaken your instincts for survival, and evolve your settlement from humble beginnings to a bustling sanctuary!
□□Stunning HD Graphics with Unity3D□□
Dive into a vibrant, vast world with high-definition 3D graphics and a map inviting you to discover its secrets.
□□Global Rivalries and Unity! Nations compete for survival, ready to write their stories of triumph! □□
Explore for ancient relics and incredible treasures. No matter where you're from, join a global community to tackle thrilling challenges from the ancient world!
□□Witness the intense battle where nature's raw power meets the courage of ancient warriors. Your survival strategy will involve a host of formidable troops ready for your command!□□
△▽ Barbarians, embodying unmatched spirit, confront colossal foes, highlighting their adeptness in navigating the perils of the wild for survival.
△▽ Archers, crucial in combat, unleash lethal precision and swift strikes, wreaking havoc upon their targets!
△▽ Riders, commanding the might of fearsome dinosaurs, spread terror among enemies with their primal power!
△▽ Behemoths, perfect for raiding and pillaging, becomes essential in your quest for survival, leveraging their immense strength to dominate the battlefield!
Official Customer Service Email: support.savagesurvival@phantixgames.com

Learn how to make healthier choices, manage stress, and cultivate a positive relationship with food.
Download the Cleveland Clinic Diet app today and experience the difference of a truly personalized and sustainable weight loss journey. It's time to invest in your health and unlock your full potential.

bluejetty:00123341:ios.description:
Like saving money? Good. With the ampm app, you’ll save on app only deals and get rewarded with incredible Bonus Deals on your favorite stuff. It’s our way of saying “thanks” for making ampm the place you trust for great quality and incredible value. 
GET DEALS YOU’LL LOVE
Enjoy app only deals that can save you extra money every time you visit an ampm. There are even special Bonus Deals that give you the chance to unlock big prizes. Oh. And you’ll probably want to be on the lookout for Flash Deals… but be quick, they are only available for a limited time! 
CLUBS SAVE YOU EVEN MORE MONEY
It’s like a digital punch card. You buy the stuff you love. We’ll track how many in the app. When you’ve bought enough, you get a free one. That’s easy enough, right?
SCRATCH AND WIN GAME
Play Scratch Power for a chance to win FREE stuff. Over 50,000 prizes are available every month! Want more chances to win? Get rewarded with 1 Scratcher for every *$1 you spend (so be sure to scan your barcode every time you visit) and get 1 additional Scratcher every day you check-in to an ampm. 
*excludes fuel, propane, lottery and car washes.
WIN THE WEEKLY GRAND PRIZE – LIKE A $500 PUMP PASS!
With ampm, you can win big! Scan your barcode every time you make a purchase for an entry to win a weekly grand prize like a $500 Pump Pass. The more you scan, the more chances you have to win! 
FIND A STORE
When you’re craving a snack, use the handy Store Locator to find an ampm near you. Looking for something specific? Easily get each store’s location and all the ampm amenities that are available such as beer, hot foods, fresh bakery, cold deli, fountain drinks and car wash.
INVITE YOUR FRIENDS
Invite your friends to join the app and you both get rewarded. Each time someone signs up with your personal invite code and makes their first purchase, you’ll both get a special reward.
HOW IT WORKS
Get great deals, rewards and prizes in a few easy steps! 
1. Download the ampm app.
2. Register your account using your email, mobile number or existing social login.
3. Check-in daily or make a purchase to get rewarded with Scratchers to play Scratch Power.
4. Scan your barcode every time you shop to maximize your savings. 
JOIN NOW
What are you waiting for? We’ve got something you need or crave with your name on it. Download the ampm app now and start saving!

bluejetty:00090855:ios.description:
All of Turkey's radio in one app. Listen to hundreds of live FM stations with no membership, no fees and no interruptions.
Over your morning coffee, on the road, at work or as you drift off to sleep — the station you love is always with you.
LIVE AND UNINTERRUPTED
• Hundreds of stations, high-quality streaming
• The last station you listened to resumes right where you left off
• Reconnects automatically when your connection drops
• Keeps playing in the background and on the lock screen
EASY DISCOVERY
• Fast search with station, category and city filters
• Stations grouped by style: Pop, Slow, Arabesk, Rock, Folk, Islamic
• Local stations from your own city
• The most listened stations of the day, the week and the month
• Wander through random stations with the Radio Scanner
FAVORITES
• Add the stations you love to your favorites
• Arrange and sort your list however you like
• Reach them with a single tap
NOW PLAYING
• See the artist and track currently playing on the station
SLEEP TIMER
• Set a timer between 1 and 120 minutes
• Optionally let the sound fade out gently so your sleep is not disturbed
HOME SCREEN WIDGETS
• See the station that is playing right on your home screen, play, pause and switch stations (small, medium, large)
• Put your favorite stations on the home screen and tap one to start playing (medium, large)
IN THE CAR
• Apple CarPlay support
• Control your stations safely from your car's screen
IN YOUR LANGUAGE
• Interface in Turkish, English, German, French, Spanish, Dutch and Arabic
YOUR ACCOUNT AND YOUR STATION
• Sign in easily with Apple, Google, e-mail or phone
• Add your own station and follow its statistics under "My Radios"
SUPPORT US
• Contribute through "Watch ads, lend support"
• Help us by sharing the app and leaving a rating
Radyo Burada is completely free. Download it now and start discovering the stations you love.
Contact: iletisim@radyoburada.com
---
This app does not host, own, or redistribute any audio content.
Radyo Burada functions solely as a directory and player for publicly available radio streams.
All streams are provided directly by the original broadcasters via their own publicly published streaming URLs.
The app does not store, cache, download, or retransmit any content.
Content remains fully hosted and controlled by the respective broadcasters.
Upon request from any rights holder, content is removed immediately.

bluejetty:00144814:ios.description:

Whether you're a podcaster, musician, content creator, or audio enthusiast, Audio Maker provides the tools you need to craft professional-quality soundtracks on the go. Its sleek interface and advanced features make it perfect for both beginners and seasoned audio editors.
• Key Features
1. Audio Editing Made Easy:
 - Cut, trim, splice, and merge audio clips effortlessly.
 - Apply fades, crossfades, and transitions with precision.
2. Multi-Track Editing:
 - Work with multiple audio tracks for complex compositions.
 - Adjust track volumes, panning, and effects independently.
3. High-Quality Recording:
 - Record in crystal-clear quality using your device's microphone or an external input.
 - Support for stereo and mono recordings with real-time monitoring.
4. Professional Audio Effects:
 - Add reverb, echo, distortion, equalization, and more.

 - Import files directly from your device, iCloud, or other cloud services.

 - Share directly to social media platforms, email, or cloud storage.

bluejetty:00161602:ios.description:
Drive mate is the fastest growing peer-to-peer car sharing marketplace across Australia. Book any car you want from a variety of friendly and reliable hosts anytime. We are proud to have a growing community of car owners and renters on our platform.
Rent cars on an hourly, daily or monthly basis for a more flexible car sharing experience. There’s zero registration and verification fee. 
With Drive mate you can go shopping, drive your family around, haul your furniture or take those wonderful road trips seamlessly. We are on a mission to build a greener future together with car-sharing! 
Download the app, book a car and drive.
FOR RENTERS:
Rent a car by the hour or the day
Choose from a variety of vehicles —sedans, hybrids, vans, and more
Sort cars by available dates, time and location
View and manage your upcoming booking
Unlock and lock cars with Drive mate app
Chat with car owners before making a booking
Leave the fuel top up to us. Just pay for the kilometers you drive
Comprehensive insurance for your peace of mind.
FOR CAR OWNERS:
Start your own car sharing business
Rent out your car and earn extra income
Comprehensive Insurance to manage claims if any
Meet people in your neighbourhood and build relationships
Block your car availability when you choose not to rent
Remote lock and unlock car 
Know where your car is located at all times
Scale your business at your convenience
TRANSPARENT PRICING
Drive mate utilises unused car hours of individual car owners and that makes rentals on Drive mate typically 30-40% affordable than traditional rental companies. 
BETTER ALTERNATIVE
Privately-owned cars are maintained well and sparingly used. This means cleaner and better cars at lower cost while you get to know your neighbours. 
KEYLESS ACCESS
With our proprietary Drive mate Go technology, car owners provide renters access for their cars directly via app instead of physically handing over the keys. This means you can go the car, unlock and drive.
FULLY VERIFIED 
Drive mate is a community built on trust! Only verified individuals with driver’s licenses may request for car bookings. Everyone’s safety and security is a priority.
TOWARD A GREENER CITY
We want to work towards a future with one million fewer cars on the road, and cities with more green space than parking lots. To achieve this we believe in the power of sharing, and that starts with you.
To start saving and sharing, download the app now!

bluejetty:00174793:ios.description:
Plan your whole journey and buy train and city transport tickets in Jakdojade.
Getting around the city? Find the best route, check current departures and buy a city transport ticket. Taking the train? Search for a rail connection, check train timetables, ticket prices and journey details, then buy your train ticket right in the app.
One app, many possibilities:
• Find a train and plan your trip: search intercity connections in PKP mode, compare departure times and check timetables, prices and on-board amenities.
• Choose the best way across the city: see available public transport connections and tailor your route to your needs.
• Buy train tickets in the app: pick the connection you want and buy a train ticket without using different operators' apps.
• Travel by bus, tram and metro: buy the city ticket you need while planning your journey.
• Keep your tickets with you: after purchase you can view them offline too, with no signal.
• React to changes on the way: track current departures and delays and check alerts for rail and city connections.
Why choose Jakdojade?
• Fewer apps, more convenience: handle rail and city transport in one place.
• A travel assistant on your phone: plan the whole route from the stop, through the station and the train ride, to your destination.
• No waiting, no uncertainty: check train, bus and tram departures and delays as they happen.
• Tickets here and now: buy a train or city transport ticket in moments.
• Same prices and discounts: buying a train or city ticket in Jakdojade, you pay the same as with the operator and get the same discounts.
• Faster everyday planning: save home, work or school and keep your most frequent connections at hand.
Who is Jakdojade for? For everyone travelling by train and city transport: to work, school, university or further afield. With Jakdojade you plan rail and city journeys in one app.
Train tickets from Poland's major rail operators in one app:
• PKP Intercity (PKP IC)
• Polregio
• Koleje Mazowieckie
• Koleje Małopolskie
• Koleje Śląskie
• Koleje Dolnośląskie
• PKP SKM w Trójmieście

listings.description:
Plan your whole journey and buy train and city transport tickets in Jakdojade.

Getting around the city? Find the best route, check current departures and buy a city transport ticket. Taking the train? Search for a rail connection, check train timetables, ticket prices and journey details, then buy your train ticket right in the app.

One app, many possibilities:
• Find a train and plan your trip: search intercity connections in PKP mode, compare departure times and check timetables, prices and on-board amenities.
• Choose the best way across the city: see available public transport connections and tailor your route to your needs.
• Buy train tickets in the app: pick the connection you want and buy a train ticket without using different operators' apps.
• Travel by bus, tram and metro: buy the city ticket you need while planning your journey.
• Keep your tickets with you: after purchase you can view them offline too, with no signal.
• React to changes on the way: track current departures and delays and check alerts for rail and city connections.

Why choose Jakdojade?
• Fewer apps, more convenience: handle rail and city transport in one place.
• A travel assistant on your phone: plan the whole route from the stop, through the station and the train ride, to your destination.
• No waiting, no uncertainty: check train, bus and tram departures and delays as they happen.
• Tickets here and now: buy a train or city transport ticket in moments.
• Same prices and discounts: buying a train or city ticket in Jakdojade, you pay the same as with the operator and get the same discounts.
• Faster everyday planning: save home, work or school and keep your most frequent connections at hand.

Who is Jakdojade for? For everyone travelling by train and city transport: to work, school, university or further afield. With Jakdojade you plan rail and city journeys in one app.

bluejetty:00170875:ios.description:
Steal alien powers and absorb their memories! Can you outlast your opponents to escape from planet Versus?
"VERSUS: The Lost Ones" is a thrilling 123,000-word interactive novel, the first in a new series, by Zachary Sergi, author of our best-selling "Heroes Rise" trilogy. Your choices control the story. It's entirely text-based--without graphics or sound effects--and fueled by the vast, unstoppable power of your imagination.
Become an interstellar warrior, gifted with the power to ransack the thoughts and abilities of others. Transported to an unfamiliar world beyond your wildest dreams, you must invade the minds of your fellow captives to survive.
Seduce Lady Venuma, a self-proclaimed goddess, or clash with Empress Vaccus, a tusked monster and the sworn enemy of your home world. Triumph in gladiatorial combat, or in the deadly politics of planet Versus. Absorb the right talents, and you just might save the galaxy!
• Fight for humans or androids in a morally ambiguous civil war
• Play as male, female, transgender, intersex, or a non-categorizable gender identity
• Subvert the corrupt Elite Courte, or join them to suppress rebellion
• Romance aliens, crossbreeds, and intergalactic royalty, or go it alone--the choice is yours
• Dive into a sci-fi hybrid of space operas, futuristic dystopias, fantasy epics, and political chess

- Simple yet challenging

bluejetty:00186664:ios.description:
* 10 beautiful learning games for babies and toddlers
* Learn first words, animals, colors, and shapes
* Developed with certified child psychologists 
About the game: 
----------------- 
"TinyHands Lotto" is an educational game for children of age 1.5 and up. 
The game consists of 10 boards, each focused on a different theme from the child's world such as shapes, colors, clothes, animals and vehicles. 
The game is designed to enhance the following: 
- Hand-eye coordination 
- Concentration 
- Categorization 
- Visual perception 
- Vocabulary 
Game Boards: 
-------------------- 
The game consists of 10 beautiful boards organized in a book like structure with big colourful buttons. This unique structure allows the toddler to easily navigate between the different boards and play independently. The boards were CAREFULLY CHOSEN in order to represent basic concepts from the child's world. 
TinyHands Games:
TinyHands Sorting Series
A set of sorting games designed to help children acquire basic concepts such as shape, color, size seasons and animals. Game boards are organized in an ascending difficulty level starting from basic sorting followed by more complex context based sorting and classification environments.
TinyHands Towers Series
A set of stacking games. The game is designed to help children acquire basic concepts such as: big VS. small, before VS. after, and bottom VS. top. Game boards are organized in an ascending difficulty level.
TinyHands What's My Pair Series
A series of three pair matching games. The game challenges the child to match pairs, initially based on visual aspects alone and in more advanced screens based on logic and understanding of card content.
TinyHands First Words Series
A set of vocabulary games for children of age 1.5 and up.
The game consists of 10 boards, each focused on a different theme from the child's world such as shapes, colors, clothes, animals and vehicles.
TinyHands Raccoon TreeHouse
This game is intended for toddlers aged 3+. The game presents 12 boards each focused on developing a set of basic concepts such as size, colors, numbers and patterns using everyday objects from the child's world such as clothes, food and many more.
TinyHands Town Center
Educational game recommended for age 3+. This game includes 10 beautiful boards each focused on developing a set of basic concepts such as size, colors, numbers and patterns using everyday objects from the child's world such as clothes, food and many more.
TinyHands Connect The Dots
The game consists of 12 mini game boards each presents a beautiful and magical scene. Each board contains several parts. The parts can be completed by connecting the numbered dots in a specific order. Upon completion, each part is dragged to gradually build an object. When all parts are drawn the scene is magically created and revealed. Designed for children aged 3+.
Note for parents:
Like all our games, this game is designed to provide quality playtime for parents and children together. Playing along with your children is highly recommended and will surely make them benefit the most from this app and help them expand their vocabulary.
We are sure that your children will enjoy this exciting educational game that will encourage their thinking and contribute to the development of their basic skills.
About the Team: 
We believe that children learn best through playing. We teamed up with certified child psychologists and experienced educators out of desire to create fun games that will help our children acquire new concepts and improve their skills. listings.description:

* Learn first words, animals, colors, and shapes
* Developed with certified child psychologists 

About the game: 
----------------- 
"TinyHands Lotto" is an educational game for children of age 1.5 and up. 
The game consists of 10 boards, each focused on a different theme from the child's world such as shapes, colors, clothes, animals and vehicles. 

The game is designed to enhance the following: 
- Hand-eye coordination 
- Concentration 
- Categorization 
- Visual perception 
- Vocabulary 

Game Boards: 
-------------------- 
The game consists of 10 beautiful boards organized in a book like structure with big colourful buttons. This unique structure allows the toddler to easily navigate between the different boards and play independently. The boards were CAREFULLY CHOSEN in order to represent basic concepts from the child's world. 

TinyHands Games:
 
TinyHands Sorting Series
A set of sorting games designed to help children acquire basic concepts such as shape, color, size seasons and animals. Game boards are organized in an ascending difficulty level starting from basic sorting followed by more complex context based sorting and classification environments.

TinyHands Towers Series
A set of stacking games. The game is designed to help children acquire basic concepts such as: big VS. small, before VS. after, and bottom VS. top. Game boards are organized in an ascending difficulty level.

TinyHands What's My Pair Series
A series of three pair matching games. The game challenges the child to match pairs, initially based on visual aspects alone and in more advanced screens based on logic and understanding of card content.

TinyHands First Words Series
A set of vocabulary games for children of age 1.5 and up.
The game consists of 10 boards, each focused on a different theme from the child's world such as shapes, colors, clothes, animals and vehicles.

TinyHands Raccoon TreeHouse
This game is intended for toddlers aged 3+. The game presents 12 boards each focused on developing a set of basic concepts such as size, colors, numbers and patterns using everyday objects from the child's world such as clothes, food and many more.

TinyHands Town Center
Educational game recommended for age 3+. This game includes 10 beautiful boards each focused on developing a set of basic concepts such as size, colors, numbers and patterns using everyday objects from the child's world such as clothes, food and many more.

TinyHands Connect The Dots
The game consists of 12 mini game boards each presents a beautiful and magical scene. Each board contains several parts. The parts can be completed by connecting the numbered dots in a specific order. Upon completion, each part is dragged to gradually build an object. When all parts are drawn the scene is magically created and revealed. Designed for children aged 3+.

Note for parents:
Like all our games, this game is designed to provide quality playtime for parents and children together. Playing along with your children is highly recommended and will surely make them benefit the most from this app and help them expand their vocabulary.

We are sure that your children will enjoy this exciting educational game that will encourage their thinking and contribute to the development of their basic skills.

About the Team: 
We believe that children learn best through playing. We teamed up with certified child psychologists and experienced educators out of desire to create fun games that will help our children acquire new concepts and improve their skills. In addition, we design our games to provide quality playtime for parents and children together.

bluejetty:00132183:ios.description:
Sleepzy is a smart alarm clock that tracks your sleep patterns, wakes you up during the lightest sleep phase in a way that feels natural to get up, analyzes your sleep quality, and notifies you if you have a sleep debt. It's an essential app for everyone, whether you're a morning person or a night owl.
IMPROVE YOUR AWAKENING:
- Wake up rested at the optimal time - don't feel groggy anymore!
- Sync with Apple Music to use your favorite tunes as an alarm - set your mood for the day
TRACK & ANALYZE YOUR SLEEP:
- Set your Sleep Goal and track Sleep Debt - stay motivated to get enough hours of sleep
- Track your sleep patterns - focus on sleeping not only long enough but well enough
- Know your Sleep Quality - make adjustments to your daily habits to get your quality % up
- Get helpful weekly stats
UNWIND YOUR MIND BEFORE SLEEP:
- Fall asleep to relaxing sounds & classical melodies
- Listen to Dream Radio: doze off to AI-generated music and hypnotic visuals
GET HELPFUL INSIGHTS:
- Receive daily personal sleep advice and explore worldwide sleep statistics with "Insights"
- Get Weather Forecast at your location in the morning to plan the day easily
KEEP YOUR SLEEP DATA SYNCED & SECURED:
- Sync your data with the Apple Health app 
- Backup your sleep data and restore it whenever you need it
Sleepzy + Apple Watch = More Fun
Monitor your sleep with Apple Watch - the clear and easy-to-use interface will help you overview what was going on while you're asleep
Go Premium to:
- Dive deep into insights with advanced stats and track your progress over time 
- Find out whether you snore
- Listen to a wider variety of relaxing sounds & classical music
- Use special breathing technics to calm your mind
- Unlock all sleep insights
- Get rid of ads
Please note that movement and noise from pets or a partner may impact results.
Start waking up stress-free at the best moment possible. Revolutionize your mornings!

Subscription with a free trial period will automatically renew to a paid subscription. You can cancel your subscription or free trial in the iTunes settings at least 24-hours before the end of the free trial period. The cancellation will take effect the day after the last day of the current subscription period and you will be downgraded to the free service.
* Please note: any unused portion of a free trial period (if offered) will be forfeited when you purchase a premium subscription during the free trial period.
For complete access to all features, you will need to allow access to the following: 
* Microphone – so the app can analyze your sleep and record your night sounds. 
* Notifications – so the alarm will ring. 
* Media Library Access – so you can set your own music as an alarm sound.
* Health App – so you can export your data to Apple Health. 
* Location – so you can receive the weather forecast for your area.

Explore the ultimate travel companion for passionate campers with the Campercontact app! With over 60,000 locations in 58 countries, you can easily find the perfect motorhome spot or plan your next camper route. Whether you've been roaming the world with your motorhome for years or trying out camper life for the first time, Campercontact consistently provides up-to-date and reliable information for a carefree and unforgettable journey. Discover. Stay. Share.
With over 800,000 reviews from fellow motorhome owners, you'll know exactly what to expect upon arrival at your camper site, including photos and practical details about facilities and prices. Bad reception? No problem! Campercontact is also available for offline use.
***** "An incredibly user-friendly app. Quickly see facilities and prices. Highly recommended for avid campers." - Camperbakker, 2023.
► Reliable information
The best camper adventures start with reliable and accessible information. No motorhome owner wants to encounter unpleasant surprises while travelling. That's why reliability of available information is a top priority at Campercontact. With 800,000+ reviews and experiences from other campers, you get a clear picture of the motorhome site.
► Campercontact PRO+
With a Campercontact PRO+ subscription, you get unlimited access to all camper routes and the Trip Planner. You also receive other benefits such as: ad-free app, offline access to all information, and much more!
► Motorhome routes: Drive the most beautiful routes throughout Europe
Campercontact's route experts have already mapped out the most enjoyable routes to various locations for you. Whether you want to explore culture in Italy or drive through the Pyrenees in France and Spain, there's something for everyone. 
► Find the best motorhome sites
The possibilities are endless when it comes to finding the perfect motorhome site. We help you find your next camper stop. With numerous filter options, effortlessly discover motorhome sites that cater to all your needs. Whether you're looking for a secluded, tranquil spot in nature or a location close to amenities and activities, you'll find it here. Found a beautiful motorhome? Add it to your favourites for easy access.
► Offline access in poor internet connection areas
If you're in an area with no coverage, no worries. The Campercontact app can be used offline. This way, you always have access to all the info in the app.
► Detailed information about your camper stay
Have all essential details about your motorhome site at your fingertips for a worry-free camper journey. Information about prices, accepted camping cards, available facilities, and the surrounding area is readily available. For a better understanding of the location and surroundings, you can easily switch to satellite map view. Want to contact the campground? All necessary contact details can be found in the app. 
► Motorhome sites reviewed by campers
We love travelling, motorhomes, and camper life—and we're not alone. The dedicated community of motorhome enthusiasts, with over 800,000 reviews, is the backbone of the Campercontact app. Explore everything about the experiences, reviews, and photos from other camper travelers, wherever you are.
► Ultimate camper experience with Campercontact PRO+
Campercontact PRO+
From just €1.49 per month (Payment is €17.99 per year) you can benefit from:
- Free access to over 20,000 kilometers of beautiful camper routes
- Plan the most beautiful camper route yourself with the Travel Planner
- Unlimited access to photos and reviews
- Free from advertising
- Save and organise your favourite locations
- Offline mode
- Extra filter options
***** Campercontact. Discover. Stay. Share. *****

bluejetty:00029560:ios.name: Spot Has Found This
bluejetty:00029560:ios.summary:
Play with Spot and enjoy the stories behind the junk items he collects!
Your friend Spot spends his days happily running around the wide meadow, bringing you various junk items he finds along the way.
Engage in games with Spot to receive th
bluejetty:00029560:ios.description:
Play with Spot and enjoy the stories behind the junk items he collects!
Your friend Spot spends his days happily running around the wide meadow, bringing you various junk items he finds along the way.
Engage in games with Spot to receive the collected items. Remember the sequence in which Spot turns his head and compete in the 'Guess Which Way' game. When you win, Spot lets go of the item and proudly shows it to you.
The odd items that Spot presents to you range from mundane things like bones and worn-out shoes to valuable items like gems and gold nuggets. Take a look at old photos and diaries hidden in abandoned houses, and imagine the comedies and tragedies experienced by their previous owners. The blood-stained handkerchief that Spot brings back one day might serve as a crucial clue in an unsolved mystery. What sad memories might be encapsulated in the small, ownerless ring? Through these unusual objects, catch glimpses of the lives of their past owners.
There are over 850 different kinds of these junk items included. Spot brings a selection of them to you every day. Open the app during brief moments, whether you're waiting for a train, lunchtime, or while standing in line for the restroom, and take a peek at his findings. What will Spot show you this morning? Could the item Spot shares tonight be connected to the one he brought the day before yesterday, sharing a common owner?
Why not start adding a touch of enjoyment to your daily routine with the company of Spot? Give it a try starting today!
Since its release over a year ago, we’ve updated Spot Has Found This regularly, and the number of junk items has already more than doubled from the initial launch. We plan to keep adding even more with future updates. Whether you’re trying it for the first time or returning after a break, we hope you’ll enjoy the daily discoveries alongside Spot!

Simply download the app and start learning now!
tonestro will help you to learn violin in a fast and fun way!

- music theory,
- music notes,
- violin tabs,
- violin fingerings,
- sheet music.
It’s like having a music teacher at your side. With exercises, you learn music theory, rhythm & pitch and with exams, you check your progress.
Secondly, it’s like playing a game!
During all lessons, you collect points for learning, practising, and consistency. Weekly challenges with songs give you the extra motivation to improve your instrument skills and persist with lessons. Beat high scores and compare yourself with other violinists!
Thirdly, learn by playing songs you simply love!

bluejetty:00187796:ios.description:
ExpressExpense is the easiest way to make custom receipts. It’s perfect for small business owners, sales reps, freelancers or anyone who needs a fast, easy to use mobile receipt making solution. 
Create, send and print receipts on your phone. Choose from a wide variety of receipt styles, fonts and templates. Customize your receipts with your logo, fonts and paper textures. It’s also great for small businesses and business travelers who might need a receipt generated for an upcoming expense report.
———
Features:
* Create receipts wherever you are - in the office, in the field or at home
* Send receipts via email or text 
* Print receipts using a Bluetooth Thermal Printer
* Customize your receipts with your company log
* Save receipts for faster receipt making later
* Customize receipt fields: quantity, price, date/time
* Customize receipt business fields: business name, address, location, city state zip, telephone
* Generate receipts using professionally designed, pre-built templates
* Automatically calculate receipt total, subtotal and taxes
* Add company logo to receipt
* Access also available online using website
—
5 Reasons to Love ExpressExpense:
1. PROFESSIONALLY DESIGN TEMPLATES
Our receipt templates are pixel-perfect and match common receipts used globally.
2. CUSTOMIZE EASILY
Quickly modify receipts to match your business needs. 
3. MAKE UNLIMITED RECEIPTS
Create as many receipt as you’d like. Members get access to additional receipt templates.
4. GENERATE RECEIPT ANYWHERE
Email, text or save your receipt from your mobile device. Send a receipt from your lemonade stand or your trade show.
5. BILL WITH CONFIDENCE
ExpressExpense is used by thousands of small businesses, entrepreneurs, sales reps, tax experts, accountants around the globe. It is consistently ranked as one of the top receipt maker apps.
--
ExpressExpense is the ultimate receipt maker: Make receipts using professional templates, receipt generator, JPG receipt maker - all rolled up into one easy-to-use app. Whether you need to create a last minute receipt for expenses or a business receipt for your side gig or track receipts for your small business. 
--
Ready to get started? Our app has a FREE receipt format that is available free-of-charge to all users. Become a member to access the other receipt templates/styles. Standard members can access a limited number of styles and receipts. PRO and Enterprise members can access all receipt templates/style.
Current receipt template styles: Restaurant receipt, gas/fuel receipt, sales receipt, cash receipt, taxi receipt, parking receipt, coffee receipt, grocery receipt, parking citation, ride share.
If you choose to join, membership will automatically continue for as long as you choose to remain a member. ExpressExpense membership is a month-to-month or yearly subscription that begins at sign up. You can easily cancel anytime, online, 24 hours a day. There are no long-term contracts or cancellation fees. Just sign up to get started! 
If you subscribe via iTunes: Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period at the rate of your selected plan above. 
Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings on the device. 
If you haven’t subscribed through iTunes, you can manage your subscription through ExpressExpense.com.

Privacy Policy - https://www.expressexpense.com/terms-conditions.php#privacy

For enterprises and teams, we built an admin panel, data & analytics and are working on a CRM integration.

- Compete with your friends and level up

bluejetty:00154939:android.description:
🎬 Welcome to bilibili – the ultimate home for anime fans, game addicts, tech geeks, and culture lovers.
Ever dreamed of a place where you could binge anime edits, watch live esports with 10,000 danmu (bullet comments), and explore the artistic treasures of diverse cultures—all in a single afternoon?
That's what we do here.
We're bilibili. We watch, we laugh, we remix, we overthink, and then we create again.
▍【Whatever you're into – we've got it.】
🎮 Hardcore into gaming?
From competitive esports to chill strategy let's-plays, we've got gameplay videos, walkthroughs, speedruns, and ragequits galore.
🤖 Love cool gadgets and future tech?
Dive into in-depth unboxings, quirky reviews, or sci-fi concepts brought to life.
🎨 Obsessed with anime or ACG culture?
This is your paradise—AMVs, cosplay tutorials, parody dubs, and wild fan theories included.
🌍 Curious about multi-culture?
Stories, global music, performing arts, creative writing, and street food from all over the world. Here, culture is binged just like a series.
💡 And now with our AI Dubbing, you can hear bilibili creators in your own language — no subtitles needed.
Less language barrier, more "I get you."
▍【Your passion deserves a stage. Or at least a fanbase. 🚀】
Got a hot take? A crazy remix idea? A cosplay transformation to show off?
This is your space.
Everyone here is a creator in the making — drawing, dubbing, animating, narrating, memeing, and always inventing something new.
From "fan" to "fan-made," the jump is just one upload away.
✨ So yeah, we're not just a video app.
We're the internet's most wholesome creative community,
where culture meets fandom, memes meet meaning, and your interests meet their tribe.
We'll see you in the danmu. Or maybe in the trending tab 😉
– With creativity & culture,
The bilibili team 💙💗

Discover the ultimate Miami trolley experience with our free, easy-to-use, real-time Miami Trolley Tracker app! Stay informed and never miss a trolley again with our comprehensive features:
• Free to Use: Every tracking feature above is free. An optional premium upgrade removes ads and unlocks Home Screen widgets.
• Live Routes, Stops & Times: Access real-time route, stop, and timetable information at your fingertips. Plan your journey effortlessly and avoid waiting at stops.

Download our Miami Trolley Tracker app now and transform the way you travel around the city!
Transit data, ETAs, stop information, and vehicle tracking are provided by the transit agency and its partners and may be delayed, unavailable, or inaccurate at times. Miami Trolley Tracker is an independent app and is not affiliated with the City of Miami or its transit partners.

bluejetty:00174998:ios.summary:
I built Weathergraph to be the weather app I always wanted — clear visual forecasts, professional-grade data, and zero tracking.
WHY OUTDOOR ENTHUSIASTS LOVE WEATHERGRAPH
• Up to 7 days of hour-by-hour weather in one glanceable chart
• Kn
bluejetty:00174998:ios.description:
I built Weathergraph to be the weather app I always wanted — clear visual forecasts, professional-grade data, and zero tracking.
WHY OUTDOOR ENTHUSIASTS LOVE WEATHERGRAPH
• Up to 7 days of hour-by-hour weather in one glanceable chart
• Know exactly when rain starts: “Light rain 2:30–3:15 PM,” powered by Rainbow.ai radar + ML
• Rain alerts up to 60 min ahead — plan your run, hike, or ride with confidence
• Built for kite surfers and sailors: wind speed + gusts, direction, pressure trends, UV peaks, heat index
• Works offline — forecast cached for 24 hours, even in the mountains or on travels
• Privacy-first — no accounts, no ads, no tracking, no data sharing
SEE YOUR WEATHER AT A GLANCE
Weathergraph turns raw weather numbers into a visual narrative:
• Temperature as a smooth gradient line — spot the warmest hour for your bike ride
• Rain & snow as blue bars — taller bars = heavier precipitation
• Sunshine breaks as real sun-rays between clouds — find the best window to head out
• Wind with gusts and direction arrows
• UV index curve — know when to apply sunscreen (hint: above 3)
• Barometer trends to understand pressure-driven changes
• Today’s highs and lows, sunrise, sunset and twilight, right in the chart
YOUR PLACES, ALL IN ONE APP
Save home, the mountains, your next trip — any place you care about. Switch between them with one tap for the full 7-day detailed forecast, with your choice of weather source.
A WEATHER STATION, WHEREVER YOU ARE
Turn your iPhone or iPad sideways, and Weathergraph spreads into two columns: today’s details on one side, the charts on the other. A complete weather station in your pocket. Unfold an iPhone Duo, and it fills the big screen.
APPLE WATCH APP DONE RIGHT
• The only weather app with full hourly graphs on your watch face
• Rich complications for every weather metric you care about
WIDGETS THAT ACTUALLY HELP
• Signature graphical widgets with next few days and week chart at a glance
• Icon-based forecasts, hour by hour, in three-hour steps or day by day, with temperatures and precipitation amounts
• Large widget with the nowcast, hourly charts, and up to a week of weather
• Quick-glance widgets: UV with sunscreen reminder, wind with direction arrow, dew point & comfort scale, sunrise & sunset …
• Lock screen widgets — see the detailed forecast before you even unlock
• Stack several for your morning weather briefing
TRUSTED DATA SOURCES
Apple Weather · Rainbow.ai (world-class radar + ML nowcast) · Foreca · Open-Meteo (aggregating national forecast models) · ECMWF IFS (European model, worldwide coverage) · Pirate Weather (NOAA’s HRRR, GFS and GEFS) · yr.no · Finnish Meteorological Institute
Pilots and surfers check the wind, photographers plan golden hour, stargazers wait for clear skies. If you loved Dark Sky or Weather Line, you’ll feel right at home.
Weathergraph is free to download and use — beautiful, detailed forecasts from the world’s best weather models, no ads, no accounts. Upgrade to Pro to unlock widgets, Apple Watch complications, premium forecast sources, multiple saved locations, background rain alerts, and full customization. Pro comes with a 7-day free trial, then an annual membership or a one-time lifetime purchase.
PRIVACY POLICY AND TERMS OF USE:
https://weathergraph.app/privacy
Please note:
Subscriptions made on Apple devices will be charged to your credit card through your iTunes account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You will not be able to cancel once activated. Manage or turn off your subscriptions in App Store app > Account > Subscriptions.

bluejetty:00014680:ios.description:
Manage your calendar, schedule your appointments, send automated SMS reminders, accept online bookings, track your sales, and keep an eye on your inventory; collaboratively with your colleagues.
SalonAppy is being used by more than 5000 beauty professionals globally in more than 50 countries. 
AMAZING FEATURES
- Appointment Scheduler - Managing your calendar has never been easier
- Online Booking Page - Let your clients see empty time slots and make their own bookings anywhere, anytime
- Automated Reminders - Reduce no-shows via automated SMS & e-mail reminders
- Google Calendar Integration - Your appointments are synced to your Google Calendar automatically
- Customer records - Keep and grow your customer database securely
- Product Sales - Track your inventory, sales and income
- Package Sales - Best way to track sales and usages of bundled services
- Checkouts - Enter your earnings easily and stay in control of your revenue
- Expenses - Track how much you spend on each category and item
- Debts - It is very easy to track customers' debts and get informed when they are due
- Customer Loyalty - Let your clients earn reward points from their visits and keep them coming
- Staff Performance Reports - Track staff performances and calculate their earnings automatically
- Financial Reports - Get detailed reports on your sales and stay in control of your finances
- Advanced Staff Permissions - You can adjust what each staff member can view and do using our advanced permission settings
- Multiple Locations - If you have more than one location, you can switch between them and control all of them at once easily
SalonAppy is all you need to manage your salon!
Available on all devices - In addition to our mobile app, you can also access your SalonAppy account using our amazing web-app using your computer.
You can now use the Starter Plan for FREE FOREVER, for up to 100 appointments per month.
SalonAppy is a powerful all-in-one software for hair & beauty professionals (such as Beauticians, Estheticians, Hair Stylists, Nail Stylists, Makeup Artists, Masseurs etc.) and businesses (such as Hair Salons, Nail Salons, Barbershops, Beauty Salons, Beauty Centers, SPAs, Make-up Studios, Tattoo Parlors, Solarium Centers etc).
* SalonAppy works on an automatically renewing monthly subscription, which depends on features of the software;
 - Free Starter Plan: Appointment and Customer Management Features (up to 100 appointments per month)
 - Unlimited Starter Plan: Free Starter Plan Features + Unlimited appointments + Online booking
 - Pro Plan: All Features (billed per person)
* Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
* You can cancel your subscription anytime by turning off the auto-renewal setting for this app from your store account
* Cancellation must be done at least 24 hours before the payment is due to avoid being charged for the next month
* Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
Terms of use & privacy policy: https://www.salonappy.com/policy.php

bluejetty:00184641:ios.summary:
Welcome to the ultimate Tonk experience! Whether you’re a seasoned card game pro or a newcomer eager to learn, Tonk Multiplayer Card Game brings you the excitement of the classic rummy-style game with a modern twist.
Game Modes to Suit Eve
bluejetty:00184641:ios.description:
Welcome to the ultimate Tonk experience! Whether you’re a seasoned card game pro or a newcomer eager to learn, Tonk Multiplayer Card Game brings you the excitement of the classic rummy-style game with a modern twist.
Game Modes to Suit Every Player:
Knock Mode: Take strategic risks by knocking to end the game. If you have fewer points than your opponent, you win. But be careful—if your points are higher, you’ll face penalties. Master the timing and strategy to become a Tonk champion!
No-Knock Mode: In this mode, knocking is off-limits. Players must use skill and strategy to spread or hit their cards to win. This mode emphasizes careful planning and tactical gameplay, offering a fresh challenge with every hand.
Exciting Features to Enhance Your Gameplay:
VIP Center: Earn VIP Points through gameplay and leveling up. Unlock exclusive rewards and benefits as you climb the VIP ranks, making each game more rewarding.
Play With Friends: Connect with friends easily and enjoy the social aspect of Tonk Multiplayer Online. Challenge your friends and see who can rise to the top!
Tournaments: Compete in thrilling tournaments with your chosen boot amount. Showcase your skills, climb the ranks, and win big while gaining recognition in the Tonk community.
Custom Tables: Create and personalize your own game tables. Set your preferred bet amount, invite friends, and enjoy a tailor-made gaming experience.
Leaderboards: Aim for the top and showcase your achievements on global leaderboards. Track your progress and see how you compare with players around the world.
Mini-Games: Spice up your gameplay with exciting mini-games. Earn additional chips and keep the fun going with new challenges and rewards.
Get Extra Chips to Keep Playing:
Initial Chips: Start with 10,000 free chips when you download the game. Jump right into the action with a generous starting amount.
Daily Chips: Enjoy daily bonus chips and keep your chip count high. Log in every day to claim your rewards and ensure you never run out of chips.
Invite Bonus Chips: Expand your circle by inviting friends to play and earn bonus chips for every new player you bring on board.
Magic Box: Get free chips from the magic box every few minutes. This ensures you always have the resources you need to keep playing.
Lucky Draw: Participate in lucky draws for a chance to win amazing rewards. Enhance your gameplay experience with fantastic prizes and boosts.
Why Choose Tonk Multiplayer Online Card Game?
Experience the thrill of Tonk with three distinct modes: Joker, Wild Card, and Point Gap. Each mode offers a unique twist on the classic game, ensuring endless excitement and a fresh challenge every time you play. Perfect for both experts and beginners, Tonk Multiplayer Card Game invites you to explore different strategies and find your perfect playstyle.
Download Tonk Multiplayer Card Game now and join a vibrant community of players from around the world. Whether playing casually with friends or competing in high-stakes tournaments, Tonk offers endless fun and strategic depth. See you at the table!

bluejetty:00174539:ios.name: Rest: Fix Your Sleep For Good
bluejetty:00174539:ios.summary: Trouble falling asleep or staying asleep? Rest is a personalized AI sleep program that helps you build lasting changes through daily education, coaching and support. Built with leading sleep experts from institutions like UCSF, and rated fi
bluejetty:00174539:ios.description:
Trouble falling asleep or staying asleep? Rest is a personalized AI sleep program that helps you build lasting changes through daily education, coaching and support. Built with leading sleep experts from institutions like UCSF, and rated five stars by more than 2,000 people on the App Store.
Through daily conversations and your sleep log, Rest learns about your patterns, routines and challenges, and remembers what you share. Your AI coach guides you through a structured program grounded in sleep science, adapting the education, practical steps and support to your progress.
In our real-world study of 318 users who completed eight weeks, participants cut their time to fall asleep by 52% and time awake during the night by 49%, on average. Sleep efficiency rose from 75% to 88% on average.
WHAT REST USERS SAY
"I've been struggling with sleep since my 30s and it's the first time I'm getting a really good, consistent sleep."
— June C., 60s
"I didn't know I could sleep this well."
— Kim B., 50s
FREE WITH REST
* Sleep assessment: answer a few questions about how you sleep and get your starting picture.
* Sleep log: record last night in under a minute, or let Apple Watch and Apple Health fill it in for you.
* Sleep metrics and trends: time to fall asleep, time awake at night, sleep efficiency and more, night by night and week by week.
* Share with your clinician: generate a private link so your clinician can follow your sleep data between visits or review it with you when you see them.
* Sleep sounds and stories to help you unwind.
REST PREMIUM
Everything in Free, plus:
* Daily personalized coaching: understand your sleep, work through challenges and turn what you learn into practical changes with your AI coach.
* A plan that adapts: a personalized sleep schedule and practical daily steps, adjusted as you progress.
* Support that builds over time: your coach remembers your history and follows your progress, so each conversation builds on the last. Talk by voice or text, with support available 24/7.
* Wind-down support: bedtime routines, Sleep Now tools and nighttime playlists with a sleep timer and loop.
* Sleep science lessons surfaced when they're relevant to your week.
THE SCIENCE BEHIND REST
Rest combines principles of CBT-I (cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia), circadian biology and neuroscience to help you understand your sleep and put lasting behavioral changes into practice.
BUILT BY A TEAM YOU CAN TRUST
Featured by Apple, Fox and Fast Company. Backed by Y Combinator and Floodgate, and part of Stanford-StartX. Our team has built consumer products with over 100 million installs.
Rest does not diagnose or treat any medical condition and is not a substitute for medical care. If you take sleep medication, talk to your prescriber before making changes.
SUBSCRIPTION
Rest Premium is an auto-renewing monthly subscription: $29.99 for your first month, then $49.99 per month. Prices are for United States customers; pricing in other countries may vary and charges may be converted to your local currency.
Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of that period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your Apple Account settings at any time. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.
Rest Terms of Service: https://getrest.app/termsofservice
Apple Standard EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://getrest.app/privacypolicy

bluejetty:00043911:ios.description:
Match Mahjong: Relaxing Tile Match for Seniors
Enjoy Match Mahjong, a free mahjong solitaire & tile match game designed for comfort, clarity, and peace of mind.
Play classic mahjong puzzles with large, eye-friendly tiles that are perfect for seniors and anyone who enjoys relaxing brain games.
This calm offline puzzle combines the traditional charm of mahjong solitaire with simple match-and-remove gameplay — easy to learn, rewarding to master, and soothing for your daily brain workout.
Train Your Mind with Relaxing Puzzles
Each level offers a gentle brain exercise — improve your memory, focus, and logic while having fun.
Plan your moves, match identical tiles, and clear beautiful layouts at your own pace.
No timer, no pressure — just a mindful brain workout for seniors and puzzle lovers alike.
Eye-Friendly & Senior-Friendly Design
Our goal is simple: make mahjong easy to see, easy to play, and easy to love.
 • Large Tiles for clear visibility and accurate tapping
 • Soft colors and clean layouts for maximum comfort
 • Simple touch controls and relaxing sound for stress-free play
Whether you’re relaxing at home or traveling, you can enjoy this offline mahjong puzzle anytime, anywhere — no Wi-Fi needed.
Classic Mahjong, Modern Matching Fun
Rediscover Classic Mahjong Solitaire with a fresh twist!
Thousands of handcrafted tile puzzles keep the challenge new every day.
Use hints or shuffle boosts when you’re stuck, and challenge yourself to master all levels.
From traditional Chinese tiles to modern themed designs, each puzzle feels calm, cozy, and satisfying.
Why Players Love Match Mahjong
 • Free mahjong tile match game for all ages
 • Senior-friendly & eye-comfort design
 • Offline play — no Wi-Fi required
 • Daily puzzles and relaxing events
 • Light brain training for focus and memory
 • Classic gameplay with smooth modern touch
Take a break from stress and unwind with Match Mahjong, the perfect relaxing puzzle game for seniors and casual players.
Enjoy peaceful matching moments, clear your mind, and find joy in every tap.
Download now — relax, match, and train your brain the cozy way!

bluejetty:00062894:ios.description:
iPersia Calendar is one of the most complete Persian Calendar (Jalali/Shamsi) apps available for iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Mac, and Apple Vision Pro.
More than a calendar, iPersia combines Persian, Gregorian, and Islamic calendars with prayer times, date conversion, live currency rates, gold and coin prices, holidays, FIFA World Cup schedules, birthdays, work shifts, notes, widgets, and powerful customization tools.
Whether you need a Persian calendar, Jalali date converter, prayer time app, Afghan calendar, currency tracker, birthday reminder, work shift manager, or daily planner, iPersia brings everything together in one application.
FEATURES
CALENDARS AND DATE TOOLS
* Persian (Jalali/Shamsi), Islamic (Hijri), and Gregorian calendars
* Daily, monthly, annual, and month-at-a-glance views
* Date conversion between Persian, Islamic, and Gregorian calendars
* Jump to any future or past date
* Persian and Gregorian week numbers
* Persian and Gregorian day-of-year numbers
* Date distance and day counting tools
* Ancient Persian year numbering
* Persian, Dari, Rumi, English, and Arabic month names
* Option to use Amordad instead of Mordad
* Annual event browser and holiday reference tools
HOLIDAYS AND EVENTS
* Persian national holidays and events
* Afghan national holidays and events
* International holidays
* Country-specific holidays
* Annual event lists
* Highlighted holidays and Fridays
* Event sharing through Messages, Email, and social media
PRAYER TIMES AND ISLAMIC TOOLS
* Accurate prayer times based on your location
* Countdown to the next prayer
* Azan reminders
* Sunrise and sunset times
* Qibla compass
* Moon in Scorpio (Qamar Dar Aqrab)
* Islamic calendar support
NOWRUZ AND ASTRONOMY
* Exact Persian New Year time
* Local and Iran time calculations
* Persian New Year countdown
* New Year notifications
* Astronomical information and seasonal data
PERSONAL ORGANIZATION
* Personal and recurring events
* Birthday reminders and management
* Work shift scheduling
* To-do lists
* Daily notes and journals
* Search events, birthdays, and notes
* View notes from previous years
* Import and export notes
* Backup and restore notes
* iCloud synchronization
CURRENCY, GOLD AND FINANCE
* Live currency exchange rates
* Currency converter
* Gold prices
* Coin prices
* Market information
* Exchange rate sharing tools
SPORTS
* FIFA World Cup schedules
* Match details
* Group standings
* Local timezone conversion
* Tournament tracking
CUSTOMIZATION
* Home Screen widgets
* Light and dark modes
* Custom themes and backgrounds
* Automatic monthly theme changes
* Custom widget colors
* Personal photo backgrounds
* Persian date on app icon
* Multiple calendar selections
* Custom startup page
* Flexible display settings
* Color-blind friendly mode
APPLE WATCH
* Apple Watch app
* Complications
* Infograph complications
* Daily and monthly calendar views
* Persian date display
* Prayer times
* Events and reminders
* Custom Apple Watch colors

bluejetty:00141375:ios.summary: Fiorry is the leading dating and social app built for the trans community, their friends, and anyone open-minded enough to meet amazing new people. Whether you’re here to date, make friends, or just see who’s out there, you’re in the right
bluejetty:00141375:ios.description:
Fiorry is the leading dating and social app built for the trans community, their friends, and anyone open-minded enough to meet amazing new people. Whether you’re here to date, make friends, or just see who’s out there, you’re in the right place.
This isn’t your average dating app. We combine serious safety with zero discrimination and a vibe where you can just relax, be yourself, and connect with real people.
WHY WE'RE #1
- Real people only – photo verification on every profile means you know who you’re talking to.
- Total control – choose who sees you, who can message you, and hide your location or age anytime.
- Freedom to explore – meet locals or search in other cities and countries.
- No endless swiping – see all active users and start conversations instantly.
- Real moderation – our team keeps out fakes, scammers, and anyone who can’t be respectful.
WHO'S HERE
Fiorry welcomes transgender, non-binary, gender-fluid, and gender-diverse people, plus the allies who respect them. Straight, gay, bi — doesn’t matter. What matters is that you’re here for real connections.
MORE THAN DATING
We know some people come here to find love, some just to make friends, and some for both. Whatever you’re looking for, Fiorry gives you the tools to meet people who get you — no judgment, no games.
JOIN MILLIONS OF REAL PEOPLE ALREADY USING FIORRY TO CONNECT
Whether you’re trans, an ally, or simply someone who’s tired of mainstream apps full of fake profiles and endless swipes, this is where the real connections happen.
If you choose to purchase Fiorry Plus or Fiorry Unlimited, payment will be charged to your iTunes account. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period. Auto-renewal may be turned off at any time in your account settings. Prices vary by country.
Privacy Policy: https://fiorry.co/privacy-policy
Terms & Conditions: https://fiorry.co/terms-conditions
Join us on our social media:
Instagram: @fiorryapp
Facebook: @fiorryapp

==== Over 40,000,000 kids love learning and play
bluejetty:00062772:ios.description:
Kiddoverse is a comprehensive early learning program packed with fun educational games that children adore. Learn ABCs, shapes, numbers, colors, and more. Great for children 1 to 5 years old!
==== Over 40,000,000 kids love learning and playing with 22learn apps! ====
==== Fascinating early learning adventure. ====
==== Perfect for babies, toddles, and preschoolers. ====
==== Members gain access to regular monthly updates and new games. ====
Packed with tons of engaging content that encourages learning, exploration, and play, Kiddoverse is your one stop for making screen time a learning time. Children who enter Kiddoverse are welcomed with an array of adventures that they independently choose. To play, children can assemble truck puzzles, play with animals, or build a farm using stickers. To learn, they can learn letter names, shapes, colors, first words, or tracing. Let your children play with Kiddoverse and be assured that their mind is engaged.
Funny characters, stunning visuals, quirky animations, and gentle encouragement keep young children constantly motivated as they gradually build their skills and confidence.
==== Learn. Play. Explore. ====
Learn: ABCs, shapes, colors, numbers, and much more!
Play: Build trucks, play with animals, complete puzzles.
Create & explore: Build a farm, interact with fun characters.
==== Educational and fun activities that boost children’s development. ====
Foundational preschool learning areas nourish children’s competence:
* Uppercase Letters
* Lowercase Letters
* Numbers
* Shapes
* Colors
* First Words
* Tracing Letters
* Tracing Numbers
Cornucopia of children’s favorite games:
* Logical and Shape Puzzles
* Connect the Dots
* Coloring
* Feed and Groom Animals
* Sort Fruit
* Memory Game
* Build Your Own Farm with Stickers
==== Features ====
+ Educational and fun mini-games for children
+ Professional animations, voice-over, and sound effects
+ Colorful child-friendly design
+ Developed in cooperation with experienced teachers and parents
+ Play all pre-downloaded games offline
+ No third-party ads or links to social media
+ Regular monthly updates
Fun games and educational activities are waiting. Time to learn! Prepare your child for success with this comprehensive early learning program by 22learn!
================
Subscription details:
Get your FREE 7-day trial to see whether the app is right for your child. After free trial, choose the best subscription plan for your family: monthly or annual.
Changed your mind? No problem – you can easily cancel your subscription at any time through your iTunes Account Settings at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period.
- You will be charged monthly or yearly depending on your chosen subscription within 24 hours prior to the end of the current subscription period. The subscription will be charged to your iTunes account.
- The first billing will occur at the end of your free trial; any unused portion of your free trial will be forfeited once you purchase subscription.
- The subscription will automatically renew itself unless you turn off auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period.
- To change or cancel your subscription at any time, go to your Account Settings of the iTunes Store. Find detailed instructions on how to view, change, or cancel your subscription at https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039
If you need help, please get in touch with us at info@22learn.com.

bluejetty:00177655:ios.description:
Suddenly transported to the 19th century, are you able to survive and escape?
Sarah is a young professional at a world-class museum who spends her day…. mostly fetching coffee for people. Not exactly the dream curator career she imagined for herself. While contemplating where everything went wrong, a sudden time portal transports her from downtown New York to 19th century England. Who does she first meet? What will she do?
Will Sarah use her modern wisdom to adapt and start a new life? Or will she find the answer to getting the portal to appear again and return home?
Embark on an incredible adventure through space and time! Explore various locations around the world, clear obstacles, and solve puzzles along the way. Build and decorate your farm house. Complete tasks to restore historical artifacts. Follow an exciting and interactive storyline. Unravel interesting facts about historical figures like Nobel and Van Gogh. Make your mark and change history!
GAME FEATURES:
DISCOVER an open map with over 100 locations around the world with various landscapes and wonderful graphics. Interact with unique cultures and friendly locals.
QUESTS: Complete fun and challenging quests daily or through special events.
BUILD and MANAGE your farm through design and renovation.
FARM and harvest plants, raise animals, and collect resources on your adventure. Cook recipes, fulfill orders, find treasures, and trade with the traveling merchant.
FIND artifacts and treasures. Restore them and showcase them in the museum showroom.
SOLVE puzzles during your adventure for rewards.
INTERACT with the thrilling storyline’s characters, including historical figures and more!
Download this free adventure & build game NOW, get on a thrilling journey!
Questions and suggestions? Contact our tech support at sarahadvanture-support@nutsplay.net.
Find us at:
https://www.facebook.com/Sarahs-Adventure-Missing-Treasures-106424391584825

bluejetty:00079146:ios.name: Zombie Slasher: Survival RPG
bluejetty:00079146:ios.summary:
►ATTACK OF THE LIVING DEAD
It’s finally happened – the zombie apocalypse is here! We knew this day would come, but do you think your fighting and defense skills are up to snuff? Smash and slash your way to survival by using your brains; be
bluejetty:00079146:ios.description:
►ATTACK OF THE LIVING DEAD
It’s finally happened – the zombie apocalypse is here! We knew this day would come, but do you think your fighting and defense skills are up to snuff? Smash and slash your way to survival by using your brains; because if you don’t use them, the zombie hordes will!
Start off the game in an abandoned and infested grocery store and fight through all sorts of buildings to gather materials and craft fantastic weapons and eventually shelters. All sorts of explorable locations await you, each holding different items that you’ll need to keep the zombies out of your base as well as to protect yourself when you’re out scouting the area for resources, such as logs and iron ore. Don’t forget to collect other items that were left behind by the less fortunate as you may be able to turn these into weapons – even a watermelon is better than nothing when a hungry mutant is approaching you!
►KNOCK ‘EM UNDEAD
• Use your head; cut off theirs – As one of the lucky (or unlucky, depending on your mood) survivors, you’ll find yourself outnumbered from the get-go, and always on the defense. Up your survival chances by picking up any and all items you come across and combining them to form the ultimate gun or other super weapon. This ability to craft will also help you in many other areas of the game, so experiment as much as you can.
• Location, location, location – Nearly a dozen various locations await you, each with different challenges and different rewards: for instance, visit the sawmill to get logs, which you can then use in crafting shelter and fortifications. Hone your survival skills too by exploring these different areas and ridding them of the zombies, and don’t forget to try and meet other survivors who can join you at your home shelter.
• The best of both worlds - A mix between survival and idle type games, this simulator ticks all the boxes in both of these categories. You get all the instant fun of smashing zombie heads in and fighting off waves of attack, plus the more passive fun of being able to collect tons of resources (55 different types and counting!) and combine them to create new objects. Toggle between these tasks effortlessly for maximum enjoyment.
►A GRAVE NEW WORLD
With your head on the line, put your survival, fighting, and crafting skills to the test in this exciting simulator game; you’ll need to mix both brains and brawn for fighting off zombies, crafting deadly weapons, and building strong fortifications from collected resources. 
Play Zombie Smash today to see if you’ve got what it takes!
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use
