bluejetty:00069037:ios.name: Melbourne Pollen Count
bluejetty:00069037:ios.summary:
The Melbourne Pollen App provides Victorians with pollen forecasts generated using real-world pollen count data collected from our statewide network of monitoring sites. 
You can use the Melbourne Pollen App to track your hay fever symptoms
bluejetty:00069037:ios.description:
The Melbourne Pollen App provides Victorians with pollen forecasts generated using real-world pollen count data collected from our statewide network of monitoring sites. 
You can use the Melbourne Pollen App to track your hay fever symptoms to figure out which pollen types are triggering your symptoms. Our notification system can alert you when grass pollen levels in your area are high, helping you plan your activities. 
Since the November 2016 thunderstorm asthma event, Melbourne Pollen has worked closely with the Victorian Department of Health and Bureau of Meteorology to develop and implement a Thunderstorm Asthma forecast system to minimize the impact that any future epidemic thunderstorm asthma events may have on the community and the Victorian health system. Our notification system can alert you to forecasts of thunderstorm asthma in your area. 
Key Features:
Accurate Pollen Forecasts: Get reliable predictions for a variety of pollen types, enabling you to identify and manage your hay fever triggers effectively.
Proactive Notifications: Receive timely alerts when grass pollen levels spike in your area, allowing you to plan your activities with confidence.
Thunderstorm Asthma Forecasts: Developed in collaboration with health authorities, the Thunderstorm Asthma forecast system helps protect the community and health system from potential future epidemics.
Contribute to Research: By participating in our surveys, you play a crucial role in advancing our understanding of pollen's impact on health, ultimately benefiting the wider community.
Comprehensive Allergy Management: From pollen counts to Thunderstorm Asthma alerts, we provide a complete suite of tools to help you navigate allergy season.
Don't let allergies hold you back! Download the Melbourne Pollen Count and Forecast App today and reclaim control of your well-being. Your comfort is our top priority! Together, let's create a healthier, more informed community.
Melbourne Pollen also conducts research aimed at better understanding the health impacts of the different types of pollen in our air. Completing the survey regularly helps us with this important work.
Terms of Use (EULA): https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00018257:ios.description:
PNC BeneFit Plus Mobile for Apple Devices¹
Save time and hassles while making the most of your HSA, HRA, and FSA health benefit accounts by quickly checking your balances and details. Our secure app makes managing your health benefits easy through real-time access and intuitive navigation to all your important account information on the go! Powerful features of the app include:
Easy, Convenient & Secure
• Simply log in to the intuitive app using your same health benefits website username and password (or follow alternative instructions if provided) 
• No sensitive account information is ever stored on your mobile device
• Your device will present you with a prompt to allow your location to be accessed; accepting the prompt will help minimize the request for additional security questions upon log in
Connects You with the Details 
• Quickly check available balances 24/7 
• View charts summarizing account(s) 
• View claims requiring receipts
• Click to call or email Customer Service
Provides Additional Time-Saving Options (if supported or applicable to your account(s)) 
• File a claim towards your medical FSA and HRA
• Take or upload a picture of a receipt and submit for a new or existing claim
• View, contribute and distribute HSA transactions
• Pay bills from any account and add a payee
• Using the Dashboard, enter medical expense information and supporting documentation
• Retrieve your forgotten username/password
• Report a debit card as lost or stolen
*This is not the PNC Mobile Banking app, which allows you to access your bank and brokerage accounts. 
For questions or support, call or email the PNC BeneFit Plus Customer Service Center at 844-356-9993 or pncbenefitplus@healthaccountservices.com
No personal or sensitive data is stored on the PNC BeneFit Plus mobile app.

bluejetty:00036342:ios.description:
Experience unrivalled World War 2 sniping gameplay with Sniper Elite 4. Take the role of SOE agent, and crack sniper, Karl Fairburne in a thrilling single-player campaign. Travel to the beautiful Mediterranean coast of Italy to battle the Axis Forces and free the country from fascism.
Sniper Elite 4 is an award-winning best seller, recognised for its authenticity and its intense gameplay experience.
EXPANSIVE SINGLE-PLAYER CAMPAIGN
Hours of gripping gameplay in huge, sandbox style, campaign levels with hundreds of enemies, vehicles, and high-ranking Nazi officers to hunt. Forge your own path to your objectives, uncover new sniper nests, find secret side missions, collectibles and more!
AWARD-WINNING SNIPING
Experience genre-defining rifle ballistics where snipers must take account of wind, gravity, and heart rate to land satisfying shots over hundreds of meters.
EXTENSIVE ARSENAL
Adapt seamlessly to any combat situation with an impressive array of iconic World War 2 rifles, pistols, submachine guns, heavy weapons, traps, grenades, and explosives.
ACCLAIMED X-RAY KILL CAMS
Sniper Elite’s acclaimed X-ray Kill Camera frames your most impressive melee attacks and explosive trap kills in bone-cracking detail.
APPLE DEVICE CROSS-SAVE
Whether at home or on the move, continue your mission across your Apple devices as you fight back against the Axis forces and help bring victory to the Allies.
TOUCH & CONTROLLER SUPPORT
As well as supporting a wide range of external controllers, you can play directly on your Apple device with intuitive touch controls.

تطبيق أواصر مصمم بطريقة فريدة للمجتمع السعودي، و يوفر أسلوبا جديدا لتعارف العائلات والأفراد من أجل الارتباط الجاد والزواج، وكل ما من شأنه بناء الأسرة والاستقرار. 
مميزات تطبيق أواصر: 
１. الانضمام إلى مجتمع خاص ومتميز، تغلب عليه شريحة المجتمع الراقية والمتعلمة من الأفراد والعائلات الجادة نحو الزواج. 
２. تطبيق أواصر هو الأول والوحيد الذي يمنح العائلات فرصة التسجيل كعائلة، ويقوم المشرف على العائلة (الوالدين أو الإخوة الكبار) بإدارة الحساب. مما يتيح فرصة عالية وغير مسبوقة لارتباط أبنائهم وبناتهم أفضل من الطرق التقليدية، وبجهد وتكلفة أقل.
３. وجود خصائص بحث متقدمة، مصممة لتناسب متطلبات مجتمعنا السعودي (مثال: البحث عن طريق المناطق أو المذاهب أو القبائل وغير القبائل، إلخ) 
４. القدرة على استخدام التطبيق من أجل الزواج غير التقليدي بين الأفراد، أو الزواج التقليدي بين العائلات والأفراد، أو بالطريقتين جميعا مما يرفع فرص النجاح. 
５. الخصوصية العالية، حيث يتحكم المستخدم بمعلوماته المدخلة، دون تدخل بشري من إدارة التطبيق. 
６. خصائص تقنية جديدة وغير مسبوقة تساعد المستخدم على تقليل التشتت ورفع التركيز على علاقة مناسبه من اختياره. والتي تجعل الطرف الآخر أكثر ثقة بجدية المستخدم. 
معايير الجودة تعتمد الحفاظ على خصوصية المستخدمين وقدرتهم على التحكم بمعلوماتهم، وفرز مجتمع مستخدمين متميز، راقي، ومتعلم، لديه القدرة والجدية العالية نحو بناء علاقة متينة وأسرة مستقرة. 
هُنا تُبنى الأواصر

bluejetty:00040649:ios.summary:
॥ Jai Gajanan ॥
Gajanan Pothi is the most complete devotional companion for followers of Shri Gajanan Maharaj of Shegaon. Whether you are at home, traveling, or at the Sansthan — carry the entire Granth in your pocket.
ADHYAY — CHAPTER RE
bluejetty:00040649:ios.description:
॥ Jai Gajanan ॥
Gajanan Pothi is the most complete devotional companion for followers of Shri Gajanan Maharaj of Shegaon. Whether you are at home, traveling, or at the Sansthan — carry the entire Granth in your pocket.
ADHYAY — CHAPTER READER
All 21 chapters of Shri Gajanan Vijay Granth in crisp Marathi Devanagari. Every chapter comes with a professionally narrated audio recitation — follow along or simply listen with your eyes closed.
• Resume exactly where you left off
• Adjustable text size
• PDF reader in Marathi, Hindi & English
AARTI & BHAKTI SANGEET
The complete collection of daily devotional music offered at the Shegaon Sansthan:
• Morning, Afternoon & Evening Aartis
• Shri Gajanan Maharaj Stotra
• Bavanni, Ashtak, Namasmaran & more
• Plays in the background — lock screen controls included
DARSHAN GALLERY
Rare and sacred photographs of Shri Gajanan Maharaj and the Shegaon Sansthan. Pinch to zoom, save to your library, or share with fellow devotees.
AMRUTVANI — DAILY VERSES
A fresh verse from the Granth greets you every morning. Save your favourites and share them as beautiful image cards with family and friends.
• Export favourites as a PDF
• Shareable verse image cards
MANTRA JAAP COUNTER
A simple, distraction-free counter for 51, 108, or 1008 bead cycles. Haptic feedback on every tap — no need to look at the screen.
FESTIVALS & YATRA
• Festival calendar: Prakat Din, Punyatithi, Gurupournima (2025–2029)
• Shegaon Yatra travel information
• Mahima Lila — inspiring stories from Maharaj's life
DAILY VERSE NOTIFICATION
Start each day with Maharaj's blessings. A gentle morning notification delivers a verse from the Granth directly to your lock screen.
ABOUT THIS APP
Completely free. No ads. No account required. No personal data collected or shared. Built by a devotee, for devotees — with no commercial intent whatsoever.
This app is an offering at the feet of Shri Gajanan Maharaj.
॥ Gan Gan Ganat Bote ॥

bluejetty:00038641:ios.summary:

- YEGO is for eve
bluejetty:00038641:ios.description:
Why YEGO?
Download YEGO and start riding the most stylish electric motorbikes in France and Spain. Our vintage look stands out on the streets. It's impossible not to spot a YEGO!
Move with ease and style around the city:
- YEGO is for everyone: locals and tourists.
- YEGO is sharing. You will find two helmets to ride with whomever you choose.
- YEGO is always with you. Enjoy your ride to the office, gym or your favourite café.
- YEGO is the best of both worlds. Ride freely as you would with your own motorbike, but with fewer worries — simply enjoy the ride while respecting the city's traffic rules.
- YEGO is green. Our motorbikes are electric, and we take care of recharging them.
- YEGO is convenient. Move around the city up to 50 km/h.
- YEGO is easy. Pay as you go. It will only cost you the time of your ride. The insurance is included.
- YEGO is available in several cities. Ride in Barcelona, Valencia, Seville, Malaga, Zaragoza, Paris, Bordeaux, Toulouse, and Nice.
How does it work?
Download the app and create an account in a few minutes.
You'll need your driving licence, ID, and payment method. Once we validate the account, you're ready to go!
Book your YEGO
Book through the app. You have 15 free minutes to get to the motorbike.
Move freely in the city
Unlock the motorbike through the app and open the top case: you'll find 2 helmets to travel with whom you prefer. Enjoy the ride!
Park and finish your ride
Park following the rules in any authorised place for motorbikes within YEGO's operative area. Put the helmets back and finish your ride on the app
Ride green, ride with style, ride YEGO

bluejetty:00151969:ios.name: Murmur-Private & Whispers
bluejetty:00151969:ios.summary:
In an era of instant messaging and digital noise, Murmur brings back the beauty of thoughtful, paced conversations. This is where your words carry weight, and every whisper is crafted with intention.
• Rhythm-Based Sharing
Murmur gently enc
bluejetty:00151969:ios.description:
In an era of instant messaging and digital noise, Murmur brings back the beauty of thoughtful, paced conversations. This is where your words carry weight, and every whisper is crafted with intention.
• Rhythm-Based Sharing
Murmur gently encourages meaningful pacing with our thoughtful sending limits. Share 5 profound whispers per connection daily, making each message special and anticipated.
• Natural Conversation Flow
Experience our smart cooldown periods that mirror real-life conversations. After sending a whisper, enjoy a moment of anticipation before your next - because the best conversations breathe.
• Whisper-Powered Messaging
Speak softly into your device - Murmur is designed for quiet, intimate conversations. Our smart audio detection encourages genuine whispering for that authentic secret-sharing feeling.
• Close-to-Ear Listening
Hold your phone to your ear like a real whisper. Our proximity-sensing technology creates an immersive experience where messages feel like they're spoken directly into your soul.
• Intentional Sending Windows
Morning, afternoon, and evening - choose the perfect moment for your whispers. Our timing suggestions help align your messages with natural daily rhythms.
• Quality Over Quantity
With limited daily sends, every whisper becomes precious. No more mindless chatting - just three meaningful exchanges that truly matter.
• Anticipation Built-In
The space between messages isn't empty - it's filled with the sweet anticipation that makes receiving a whisper so special.
• Best Friends - Replace endless chatting with three daily treasures of friendship and support
• Long-Distance Relationships - Make every message count when distance makes words precious
• Mindful Communicators - For those who believe some things are better said slowly and savored

취향이 맞는 유저는 팔로우 하세요! 마음에 드는 맛집 찾기가 더 쉬워집니다.

빈자리 알림을 설정해두면 빈 좌석이 생길 경우 바로 알려드립니다.

bluejetty:00096305:ios.description:
If you want to change your phone or your phone gets damaged, there’s no need to worry about losing your important information. Smart Switch: Transfer My Data is the simplest and most reliable way to move your photos, videos, audios, and files to a new phone. With a few quick taps, securely transfer everything you need with the Copy My Data app. 
Phone Clone App is a fast and secure solution for moving to a new device without stress. Transfer photos, videos, and audio in easy steps. Easily send data from your old phone to a new one or receive data from another device with the data transfer app. Whether you’re upgrading your phone, switching between devices, or backing up important files, the Copy My Data app ensures smooth and reliable transfers every time. 
Main Features of Smart Switch: Transfer My Data: 
High-Speed Data Sharing 
Clone Phone 
Smart Transfer 
Receive Files 
Seamless QR Code Transfer 
View Storage History 
High-Speed Data Sharing 
Enjoy high-speed data sharing like never before. With just some taps, transfer your photos and videos in seconds through the phone clone app. 
Clone Phone: 
Experience a smarter way to switch phones with quick and secure data transfer. Seamlessly move your photos, music, and more in just a few easy steps with Smart Switch. 
Smart Transfer: 
With Smart Switch: Transfer My Data, switching devices is no longer a worry. Effortlessly copy your files to any phone, ensuring your important data moves with you securely and instantly. 
Receive Files 
Smart Transfer makes it easy to collect photos, videos, and documents from any device in seconds. With fast speed and secure transfer, your data arrives safely every time—no cables, just seamless sharing. 
Seamless QR Code Transfer 
Quickly move your data with just a scan using the Phone Clone app. Generate a QR code on one device and scan it on another to instantly transfer photos, videos, and more. No cables needed, just fast, secure, and seamless sharing. 
View Storage History 
Get a clear view of your phone’s storage with detailed insights. See how much space is used by photos, videos, and documents, and manage your files smarter and more efficiently with the Smart Switch app. 
Some Benefits of Smart Switch: Transfer My Data 
No Cables Needed: Transfer data wirelessly. 
All-in-One Solution: Transfer photos, videos, audio, and documents in one go. 
Time Saver: Complete data transfers in just a few simple steps. 
Safe & Secure: Your data stays protected during data transfer. 
Device Upgrade Made Easy: Smart Switch to a new phone without losing your important files. 
Effortless Sharing: Send or receive any file instantly, anytime, anywhere. 
Get Smart Switch: Transfer My Data now and move everything you love to your new phone in seconds! By using our app, you accept our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use. 
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/corebitsolutionsios/smart-switch/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00122767:ios.name: FNB Iron Mountain
bluejetty:00122767:ios.developer: First National Bank & Trust Company of Iron Mountain
bluejetty:00122767:ios.summary: The FNB Iron Mountain App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can s
bluejetty:00122767:ios.description:
The FNB Iron Mountain App is a free mobile decision-support tool that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other financial institutions, into a single, up-to-the-minute view so you can stay organized and make smarter financial decisions. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Multi-Account Aggregation: View all of your financial information (balances, transaction history, merchant spending averages) in one place for on-the-go organization.
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact First National Bank & Trust customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the FNB Iron Mountain App, you must be enrolled as an First National Bank & Trust Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

لننطلق إلى جولة في مستقبل الصحة، الجمال، والعناية الشخصية مع المطوع؛ وجهتك التي تثق بها للحصول على ما يلبي احتياجات للعافية، العناية بالبشرة، وأساسيات حياتك اليومية في الكويت.
تعيد المطوع تشكيل مفهوم تسوقك المنتجات الصيدلية ومستحضرات التجميل، وذلك من خلال تقديم تجربة مفصلة بشكل شخصي لتلبي احتياجاتك بفعالية. من منتجات العناية بالبشرة ومستحضرات التجميل إلى مستلزمات العناية بالرضع، الفيتامينات، وحتى العطور، كل ما تبحثين عنه على بعد لمسة شاشة.
يمكنك الاستمتاع بتجربة تسوق سلسة وآمنة، مع توصيل سريع يغطي كافة مناطق الكويت، وعلى مدار 24 ساعة، بالإضافة إلى العروض الحصرية عبر التطبيق. سواء كنت ترغبين في تجديد مخزونك من الأساسيات، أو كنت تستكشفين خيارات جديدة في عالم التجميل، سوف تساعدك المطوع على التسوق بثقة.
ابقي على اطلاع، تسوقي بذكاء، واحصلي على منتجات العافية الشهيرة – فقط مع المطوع.
مميزات أساسية
• إنشاء حساب: يمكنك إنشاء حساب بسرعة وبشكل آمن للبدء في التسوق من تطبيق الصيدلية الذي يحظى بالثقة في الكويت.
• التحكم في الصفحة الشخصية: يمكنك تحديث بياناتك الشخصية وعنوان التوصيل بكس سهولة.
• استكشاف الأصناف: يمكنك تصفح منتجات الصحة، العافية، والأساسيات من المنتجات الصيدلية التي تم توزيعها بحسب الصنف، لمضان سهولة الوصول إليها.
• عروض حصرية: يمكنك البقاء على اطلاع بأحدث العروض والتنزيلات في الكويت.
• سجل الطلبيات: يمكنك مراجعة وإدارة طلبياتك السابقة في أي وقت.
• قائمة المنتجات المرغوبة: يمكنك حفظ منتجاتك المفضلة في قائمة المنتجات المرغوبة الخاصة بك للقيام بتجديد الطلب بشكل أسرع.
• خدمة العملاء والأسئلة الأكثر شيوعاً: يمكنك الحصول على إجابات لاستفساراتك، من خلال الدعم المخصص والاطلاع على الأسئلة الأكثر شيوعاً.
• في متناول يدك على مدار 24 ساعة: يمكنك تسوق منتجات الرعاية الصحية في أي وقت – فنحن متواجدون طوال الوقت، وفي كافة أنحاء الكويت.

It's 1984, and you've got a VHS camcorder! It'll look that way when you record and send old, messed up-looking retro videos to friends. They'll swear you built a time machine: "OMG, how'd you shoot that?"
With Rarevision VHS, you'll make videos that look and sound like real retro video tapes pulled out of storage after 30 years. "That's freakin' amazing!" -Everyone

• Four words: Best. Throwback. Videos. Ever.
• Create VHS-style retro videos of your kids that look like the ones from your childhood
• The only VHS cam app you should ever consider to capture your 80s and 90s-themed parties
• Shoot your own "found footage" movie and become a big Hollywood director like those other guys
• Make your kids' incredibly boring school plays actually rad
• Impress the new girl by using our app to convince her you built a time machine
• Pretend like you lived through the rad 1980s using our app!
What Rarevision VHS Can Do:
• Realism: the ORIGINAL and BEST VHS cam app for simulating the glitches of old videotape recordings
• Glitch the picture during recording using your finger or by shaking your device
• Fake zoom feature dramatically enhances the cheese factor
• Don't think we forgot to make things sound retro terrible. We didn't.
• Up to 60p recording for a more accurate VHS video look (depends on device capability)

bluejetty:00140784:ios.name: Hopp: Get a Ride
bluejetty:00140784:ios.summary:
Order comfortable, affordable rides or scooters with the Hopp app. Just open the app, set your destination, and request a ride or unlock a scooter to get where you need to go—fast.
EASY AND CONVENIENT RIDES
To request a ride with the Hopp
bluejetty:00140784:ios.description:
Order comfortable, affordable rides or scooters with the Hopp app. Just open the app, set your destination, and request a ride or unlock a scooter to get where you need to go—fast.
EASY AND CONVENIENT RIDES
To request a ride with the Hopp app, all you need to do is:
1. Set your destination
2. Pick a ride category
3. Request a ride
5. Leave a rating and pay
A WIDE RANGE OF RIDE OPTIONS
Select a ride that works for you, whether it's budget-friendly transportation or something a little extra. With Hopp, you can choose from a wide range of vehicles, from affordable rides to larger vehicles to premium cars for special nights out. 
HOPP SCOOTERS*
Rent a Hopp scooter to explore the city, skip traffic, or simply get where you need to go. Scooters are a great alternative to cars, making cities a little better for everyone. And they’re fun.
JOIN HOPP PLUS FOR EXTRA VALUE**
Get more from Hopp with Hopp Plus. Enjoy member perks that give you better value on every ride and added flexibility when plans change. 
EASY IN-APP PAYMENTS
Hopp integrates seamlessly with popular payment methods to make paying for your rides easy. Pay for your ride in-app using debit, credit, or Apple Pay. 
RELIABLE DRIVERS AND 24/7 SUPPORT
Hopp driver partners are carefully vetted and receive guidance to ensure safety and comfort on every ride. You can easily use the app to communicate with your driver, share your destination, and follow their progress.
WHY PEOPLE RIDE WITH HOPP
- Access to comfortable and affordable rides
- Fast arrival times, day and night
- Prices you can check before you order
- Seamless in-app payments (credit/debit/Apple Pay)
If you want to earn money as Hopp driver partner, sign up at gethopp.com/en-ca/driver/.
Questions? Reach out to info@gethopp.com or visit gethopp.com/en-ca/.
Questions about scooters? Visit https://gethopp.com/en-us/
*Hopp scooters are currently only available in Washington, D.C.
**Hopp Plus is currently only available in Canada.

9. Show timers every time a piece is moving
10. Languages: English, Vietnamese, Chinese
Thank you for using our product. Having fun!

bluejetty:00095449:ios.description:
Enjoy the first entry of the Way of the Hunter mobile series set in the beautiful North American Pacific Northwest. Try a limited time for free and upgrade to the paid version if you enjoy the hunt.
This authentic hunting experience lets you explore and hunt in large open-world environments in the Nez Perce Valleys, USA. Discover true-to-life animals in beautiful natural habitats and handle various detailed and highly realistic weapons.
Way of the Hunter provides a highly immersive, completely integrated experience amongst stunning wildlife with true-to-live animal group behavior. Witness the changing of complex ecosystems that react and adapt to your input. Learn what it means to be a true hunter and put your skills to the test.
Face the challenges of ethical hunting, supported by a compelling story, or simply enjoy hunting in rich environments freely.
* Dozens of strikingly detailed animal species with realistic behavior models for a genuinely immersive hunting experience
* Hunt like a pro with features that highlight animal signs, blood splatter analysis, and shot review with the rewindable bullet camera
* Use Hunter Sense to highlight important details and information or deactivate it
* Complex Trophy system generates unique antlers and horns based on multiple factors like fitness and age
* Sophisticated natural animal animations and reactions when sensing the player's presence
* 24-hour day/night cycle with changing wind and weather
* Realistic ballistics and bullet physics simulation
* A broad selection of firearms and equipment, including licensed gear from Bushnell, Federal, Leupold, Primos, Remington, and Steyr Arms
* An in-game economy that lets you hunt game and sell the meat to purchase new gear, hunting passes, and taxidermy for your trophy stands
* A compelling story about the struggles of a family hunting business and the rivalry and friendships that surround it
* Intuitive photo mode for capturing and sharing your favorite moments
* Stalk your prey with a gamepad or touch controls
* Optimized mobile controls for comfort and efficiency
WARNING:
Devices with less than 4 GB of RAM are not supported!
You need a device with at least 6 GB of RAM to use the highest graphics settings.
Imprint: http://www.handy-games.com/contact/
© www.handy-games.com GmbH

bluejetty:00186990:ios.description:
iPieta contains Catholic documents, teachings, writings, prayers, and liturgical calendars, including:
• Bibles: Douay-Rheims, Clementine Vulgate (Catholic and public domain; note that Psalms are COMPLETE but numbered as in the Vulgate).
• Baltimore Catechisms #1-3 (original); the Cat. of Christian Doctrine, the Roman Catechism, and the Cat. of St. Thomas Aquinas.
• Both the Ordinary (Novus Ordo) and Extraordinary (Tridentine) Calendars with access to the day's Gospel and Reading(s) from the Douay-Rheims & Vulgate.
• Numerous devotions and prayers, including 33-Day Total Consecration Preparation, Novena to the Holy Spirit, St. Alphonsus Stations of the Cross, and the St. Bridget 1-Year and 12-Year Prayers.
• Spiritual works from authors including St. Louis Marie de Montfort, St. Teresa of Jesus, St. John of the Cross, St. Catherine of Siena, St. Thomas Aquinas (Summa and Catena), St. Francis deSales, and St. Jean-Marie Vianney.
• Papal Encyclicals and Conciliar Documents
• Fathers of the Church (Erdman's collection)
• Search, History, Bookmarks, Highlights.
• Multi-version display of some data like versions of the Bible and prayers in different languages.
• Free downloadable audio for many prayers, New Testament, and some works.

bluejetty:00072232:ios.description:
BMG Money is a great loan solution for employees and retirees who are working on improving their credit scores. This app is for new loans for existing customers.
1. Better Loan Offers (4) - Loans ranging from $500-$10,000 & terms from 6-48 months 
2. No Credit Score Required (2) - We do not use FICO credit scores when reviewing loan applications
3. Easy Application - Loan offers in minutes from any device
4. Higher Acceptance Rate - When banks say no, we say yes
5. Instant Funding Available (1) - Most borrowers get their loan proceeds deposited in their bank accounts instantly. Loans are automatically paid through allotment, direct deposit, debit card, or payroll deduction.
6. Annual Percentage Rate (APR) ranging from 16.99%-35.99%
7. Loans do not require repayment in full in 60 days or less from the loan issue date
8. If you have been employed for at least one year, are over 18 years of age, are not active in the military and are not in bankruptcy, you may be eligible. Also you must be employed by one of the employers we work with. Access https://app.bmgmoney.com/signup to see if your employer qualifies, terms and conditions apply.
9. Stay informed when you enable notifications
10. Enable Touch ID / Face ID for instant access
11. Earn extra cash by referring BMG Money to your friends and colleagues
Loan example: A 17-month $2,000 loan with a finance charge of $500.06 and a 31.67% APR has 36 bi-weekly installments at $70.00 each, for a total loan cost of $2,500.06.
All loans marketed by BMG Money are made by WebBank, except the loans made to residents of Illinois, Ohio, Rhode Island are made by BMG LoansAtWork, Inc.

bluejetty:00185740:ios.summary: Feast your eyes on eleven beautiful girls and try to win their affection. Find all of the hand-crafted stories and cutscenes for all characters in this game. Discover life stories and colorful personalities of each character while you get t
bluejetty:00185740:ios.description:
Feast your eyes on eleven beautiful girls and try to win their affection. Find all of the hand-crafted stories and cutscenes for all characters in this game. Discover life stories and colorful personalities of each character while you get to know and help them in their daily life.
You decided to move to the town of Citampi to pay your parent’s debt and find happiness. 
However, you also found so much more in that place! You also found a lot of beautiful girls, friendly people, a wonderful neighborhood, and a place you can call home. Find your place in this pixel art – anime game. There is so much romance here you'll feel like you're trapped in a dating sim!
Propose and wed that special anime girl. You can find various types of girls here. From a shy and demure girl to a cheerful and sporty girl. From a classy uptown girl to a simple village girl.
But this is a lot more than just a visual novel. In this open-world RPG game, you can find various quirky jobs, a farming simulator, a crafting game, a pet simulator, treasure hunts, a fishing game, cooking game. This is a game about life and love!
Is that not enough for you? You can also turn your adventure into a fantasy story. Marry a ghost and meet with her supernatural friends. Have a ghostly child. Yikes!
A lot of things to do! All characters in Citampi Stories are full of stories. Discover the hand-made life stories and colorful personalities of each character while you get to know and help them in their daily life.
Have a family! The romance didn’t end after the wedding in our game. Do quests to improve your family life. Deliver fish and vegetables for your wife while she’s pregnant. Buy various dress-up costumes to keep her happy. Don’t forget to pay your utility bills to prevent blackouts. You can have an easy life or hard-working, fulfilling work.
Raise your child! Do different things while he/she grows from a baby, to a toddler, to a healthy boy/girl. Do various quests for your child and he/she will also help you.
Help your parent's farm. Raise farm animals and upgrade your parents' house. You can also build buildings all across Citampi for more abilities and features.
You’ll never run out of things to do in this anime role playing game!
Discover a lifetime of stories from a single guy, to a family man in this roleplay story. This is more than just a dating simulator, this is a life, simulated.

We stays true to the classic Solitaire (also known as Klondike Solitaire or Patience Solitaire).
Solitaire is funny, addictive and challenging brain games. Gameplay is very simple to start but hard to master. 
Our game is the most easy-to-play with clean and intuitive designs. Meanwhile, we have added many beautiful themes and Daily challenges for you.

Just single tap or drag and drop to move the card, and use the shortest time and moves get the highest scores. Simple and addicting!

==============Features==============
- Customizable beautiful themes
- Daily Challenge
- Unlimited free undo
- Unlimited free hints
- Draw 1 card
- Draw 3 cards
- Auto-collect cards on completion
- Auto-save game in play
- Track your records
- Left handed mode
- Tablet support
- Switch Portrait or Landscape view mode

Train your brain as well as kill time with friends together!
Have fun playing Solitaire!

bluejetty:00149402:ios.description:
Salem Skipper makes it easier than ever to move around the city of Salem, MA — with a few taps, book a ride using the app and we’ll pair you with others headed your way. No detours, no delays.
What we’re about:
SHARED.
Our tech matches people headed in the same direction. This means you’re getting the convenience and comfort of a private ride with the efficiency, speed, and affordability of a public one.
SUSTAINABLE.
Sharing rides reduces the number of vehicles on the roads, bringing down congestion and CO2 emissions. With a couple of taps, you get to do your part to make your city a little bit greener and cleaner, every time you ride.
AFFORDABLE
Rides are priced comparable to public transport and there are additional discounts for passengers who qualify. Head to salemskipper.com for more information. 
How does Salem Skipper work?
- Salem Skipper is an on-demand travel concept that takes multiple passengers heading in the same direction and books them into a shared vehicle. Using the Salem Skipper app, input your address and we’ll match you with a vehicle going your way. We’ll pick you up on a nearby corner and drop you off within a short walk of your chosen destination. Now for the clever bit; our algorithms provide journey times that are comparable to a taxi and much more convenient than other modes of travel, making public transportation easier than ever before! 
 How long will I wait
- You'll always get an accurate estimate of your pick-up ETA before booking. - You can also track your bus in real time using the app.
Questions? Head to salemskipper.com or reach out at support-
salem@ridewithvia.com.
Loving your experience so far? Give us a 5-star rating.

bluejetty:00144820:ios.summary:
Sleip – equine gait analysis for professionals

Trusted by more than 2,000
bluejetty:00144820:ios.description:
Sleip – equine gait analysis for professionals
Sleip turns your iPhone into an objective gait analysis tool for horses. Record movement, analyse asymmetries and review results without sensors or extra equipment.
Trusted by more than 2,000 equine veterinarians, Sleip has supported over 1.5 million analyses across more than 50 countries.
Choose cloud analysis when you have a strong connection, or analyse on-device when connectivity is limited.
Our app versions:
Sleip Pro Vet
• For equine veterinarians assessing lameness and following patients over time. Includes advanced clinical tools such as diagnostic analgesia documentation and comparison, compensatory pattern detection and flexion test analysis.
Sleip Pro 
• For equine professionals such as trainers, professional riders, physiotherapists and farriers. Enables gait monitoring to track changes over time, supporting early referrals to veterinarians and assessment of responses to training, rehabilitation, or shoeing.
Sleip Record (limited version)
• For people invited to record by a Sleip Pro Vet or Sleip Pro user. Sleip Record lets you capture and submit video, with access to the analysis video and stride count. Full analysis results and advanced tools require Sleip Pro or Sleip Pro Vet.
Why choose Sleip?
• Scientifically validated technology: Built on decades of equine biomechanics research and validated against gold-standard motion capture systems.
• Objective gait analysis: Quantify asymmetries, compare findings over time and support consistent assessment.
• No sensors or extra hardware: Record with your iPhone and analyse directly in the app.
• Works with limited connectivity: Get analysis data and results on-device when the connection is poor or unreliable. Upload later on a stronger connection to also get the slow-motion analysis video with synchronised stride curves.
• Remote recording: Invite clients, owners or colleagues to record a horse remotely and send the recording directly to your Sleip account.
• Share results: Share individual results and videos with clients or colleagues via link or PDF, without sharing the full horse record.
• Share horses and collaborate: Share a horse with another Sleip Pro Vet or Sleip Pro user so you can access the same history, recordings and analyses and collaborate on the case.
Get started:
Sleip is available to equine health professionals.
Contact us at hello@sleip.com or visit sleip.com to get started.

bluejetty:00040270:ios.name: Pepperfry: Furniture & Decor
bluejetty:00040270:ios.summary: Furniture isn't the whole story here; decor, furnishings, lighting and more all live in the same place, organised the way you actually shop: by room, by style, by what you need next. Some days that means finding the one sofa that finally fi
bluejetty:00040270:ios.description:
Furniture isn't the whole story here; decor, furnishings, lighting and more all live in the same place, organised the way you actually shop: by room, by style, by what you need next. Some days that means finding the one sofa that finally fits your living room; other days it's a few cushions and a new lamp to change how a space feels. Either way, the app moves at your pace, whether you're furnishing a home from scratch or just chasing an idea you saw and can't stop thinking about.
EXPLORE EVERY CORNER OF YOUR HOME
Find furniture for every room: sofas, sofa sets and recliners for the living room, beds with storage, wardrobes, almirahs and dressing tables for the bedroom, dining table sets for four or six, study tables and office chairs for work from home, and outdoor pieces built to last. Add storage that works hard - shoe racks, TV units, bookshelves and cabinets - and pieces made for how India lives, from sofa cum beds and bean bags to pooja mandirs. Beyond furniture, shop home decor including lighting and lamps, wall art, mirrors and accent pieces, plus furnishings like cushions, curtains and rugs. Round out your home with mattresses and kitchen and dining essentials - over 1 lakh products, all in the same app.
SHOP A LOOK, NOT JUST A LIST
The app is built around style, not just stock. In-house design brands - Mudramark, Amberville, Bohemiana, CasaCraft, Mintwud and Woodsworth - each bring a distinct point of view, from classic colonial pieces to bold contemporary statements to relaxed bohemian style. Instead of scrolling through thousands of unrelated products, filter and browse by the aesthetic that actually fits you.
Prefer to see and feel it first? Find a Studio Pepperfry near you in the app; we have 200+ across 100+ cities, where design consultants can help you plan a room, choose finishes, and make decisions you won't second-guess later. Start browsing online, finish in-store, or the other way around.
DELIVERY AND SETUP, HANDLED IN-APP
Track your order door to door, right from the app. Delivery and assembly run on PepCart, our own logistics network, so larger furniture gets assembled at your home by our own teams, not left for you to figure out. What you order is what shows up ready to use.
SHOP ON YOUR TERMS
Flexible payment options, including EMI, are built into checkout, so you can spread out the cost of bigger pieces instead of paying it all upfront. Check the app regularly for seasonal offers and deals available only here, across furniture, decor and more.
WHAT YOU GET WITH PEPPERFRY
- Furniture, home decor, furnishings and services in one app, not just a product catalogue
- Over 1 lakh products, trusted by millions of homes since 2012
- In-house design brands with real style, so you can shop a look instead of a list
- 200+ Studio Pepperfry stores across 100+ cities, searchable right from the app
- Delivery and assembly tracked and handled through PepCart
- EMI and other flexible payment options at checkout
- Regular offers and app-only deals across categories
- Easy browsing, saved favourites and simple returns
WHEREVER YOU'RE STARTING FROM
Whether you're furnishing your first home, upgrading a room you've outgrown, or just browsing for what's next, the app is built to move with you, from your first search to the last thing set up in your space.
Download the Pepperfry app and start finding your look - fashion for your home starts here.

bluejetty:00187176:ios.description:
Zoho Billing is an end-to-end billing software designed to help SMEs simplify their billing operations and drive business growth. From creating quotes and invoices to handling recurring payments and automating billing cycles, you can handle it all from the palm of your hand.
Zoho Billing is available on iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
Here's how the Zoho Billing app is transforming businesses like yours:
"I access the Zoho Billing mobile app every morning to take a quick look at the numbers. As a COO, it helps me stay updated on our business health, no matter where I am."
Let's look at everything you need to know about Zoho Billing, the comprehensive billing application.
GET INSTANT BUSINESS INSIGHTS AT YOUR FINGERTIPS
Gain 360° visibility into your business with a comprehensive dashboard that gives you insights into your net revenue receivables and key subscription metrics like signups, MRR, churn, ARPU, and customer LTV. 
MANAGE YOUR PRODUCTS FLEXIBLY
Easily create products, subscription plans, and services according to your business strategy. Close deals easily using tailored coupons, discounts, and price lists for your customers.
ENSURE A SMOOTH CUSTOMER JOURNEY
Manage subscription changes easily, including upgrades, downgrades, cancellations, and reactivations, all from one centralized hub.
SIMPLIFY YOUR PAYMENT COLLECTION
Enhance the way you handle transactions, from sending payment links to managing various payment types, while ensuring secure transactions.
COLLECT PAYMENTS EASILY
Accept multiple payment methods, including payment cards, ACH, mobile payments, and other popular regional methods, both online and offline.
RETAIN YOUR CUSTOMERS WITH AUTOMATED PAYMENT ALERTS
Reduce involuntary customer churn rates with a carefully optimized dunning system that automatically sends out reminders to delinquent customers behind on their payments.
MANAGE PROJECTS EASILY
Track billable hours and invoice customers for your work with intuitive time-tracking features.
STREAMLINE YOUR BILLING EXPERIENCE
• Create and send quotes in minutes to speed up the sales cycle.
• Convert approved quotes to invoices automatically to ensure timely payments.
• Choose and customize billing templates that fit your style.
• Handle cash flow better by bringing all billable and non-billable expenses in one place.
ENHANCE THE CUSTOMER ENGAGEMENT EXPERIENCE
Offer your clients the convenience of accessing all their transactions, invoices, subscription updates, and more in one place from the customer portal.
GET IMMEDIATE ACCESS TO BUSINESS ANALYTICS
Obtain quick insights into your business with 50+ reports on sales, receivables, revenue, churn, and subscription metrics like signups, active customers, MRR, ARPU, and LTV.
We are continuously refining your app for seamless integration with your Apple device. Here are some of the unique functionalities of Zoho Billing designed specifically for iOS users.
PUSH NOTIFICATIONS: The Zoho Billing mobile app provides real-time updates on transactions and other important customer-related events.
LOCK SCREEN WIDGET: Create invoices and track time from the lock screen widget.
GPS TRACKING: Track your mileage with GPS and later convert them to expenses.
BUSINESS SUMMARY ON THE HOME SCREEN: View activations, signups, active customers, net cancellations, churn, payment failures, MRR , ARPU, LTV, and under risk subscriptions.
DOCUMENT SCANNING: Easily capture documents and attach them to transactions
APP LOCK: With an extra layer of security added to your Zoho Billing mobile application, you can prevent unauthorized access to your critical financial information.
Zoho Billing is trusted by thousands of businesses across the globe. Download the app and simplify your business operations today.
Privacy Policy and Terms & Conditions:
- https://www.zoho.com/privacy.html
- https://www.zoho.com/terms.html
Have questions? Write to us at support@zohobilling.com.

bluejetty:00047084:ios.description:
From the editors of PEOPLE magazine — celebrity news, true crime, royals, recipes and daily games, all in one place.
The PEOPLE app brings you everything you love from one of America's most recognized pop culture brands, now with digital access to every PEOPLE issue, available two days early every week. Get breaking celebrity news, royal family coverage, true crime stories, Hollywood insider coverage, recipes and daily games and puzzles.
BREAKING CELEBRITY & ENTERTAINMENT NEWS Stay ahead of every story with real-time updates from PEOPLE’s newsroom. From relationship news to legal feuds, red carpet moments, and Hollywood exclusives, PEOPLE breaks it first.
250+ award-winning journalists
50+ years of trusted PEOPLE journalism
ROYAL FAMILY NEWS Up-to-the-minute news on Princess Kate, Prince William, Meghan Markle, and more from the outlet that covers the royals most closely.
TRUE CRIME COVERAGE Gripping courtroom drama, cold cases, and investigative features that go beyond the headlines. 
DAILY POP CULTURE GAMES Test your pop culture smarts with these daily games: 
- The Puzzler: America’s fan favorite pop-culture crossword
- Generations: New! Reveal your pop culture age in 10 trivia questions
- Groupies: Find the connections between your favorite stars
- PEOPLE Mini: The bite-sized pop culture crossword
- Pieces: A jigsaw puzzle packed with pop culture
- Second Look: Test your celeb spotting eyes
Earn badges and unlock achievements in select games, play new games for free every day, and access the full games library with PEOPLE VIP.
STARTRACKS Scroll through PEOPLE's iconic celeb photo feed — red carpet looks, candid sightings, on-set snaps, all updated constantly.
JOIN THE CONVERSATION Comment on the stories that have everyone talking. Ask your burning questions in live chats with stars and PEOPLE editors. The PEOPLE community is now open, and you are part of it.
APP-EXCLUSIVE VIDEOS Get closer to the stars with candid interviews and PEOPLE originals you won’t find anywhere else, including WAG World, The PEOPLE Interview, and more.
INTRODUCING PEOPLE VIP Take your PEOPLE fandom to the next level with early access, benefits, and experiences made exclusively for members:
- Every weekly issue, available two days early on Wednesday
- Monthly Entertaining Guides with celeb menus, seasonal decor, and hosting tips
- Recipe drops straight from your favorite stars
- Weekly live chats and AMAs with celebrities and editors
- VIP-only newsletters with extra inside scoop
- Unlimited play with the 1,000+ game library
- Members-only surprises all year long
THIS APP IS FOR:
Fans of celebrity news and entertainment
True crime followers
Royal family watchers
Daily crossword and puzzle players
Pop culture lovers
PEOPLE VIP members
WHY PEOPLE APP?
- Free to download
- 50+ years of trusted PEOPLE journalism
- Real-time push notifications for breaking news
- Entertainment news, games, video, photos, recipes, and issues in one place
- Fast, visual browsing built for your daily read
- People VIP — exclusive access for members
Download for free. Become a member today. Your A-list awaits.

Vita Solitaire is a groundbreaking new take on the Solitaire Classic Card Games, meticulously crafted for the senior audience. Immerse yourself in timeless card play with an eye-friendly easy-to-use interface that caters to both pad and phone.
At Vita Studio, we have always been dedicated to crafting classic mobile games designed for seniors that bring back relaxation, fun, and joy. Our repertoire includes popular titles like Vita Solitaire, Vita Color, Vita Jigsaw, Vita Mahjong, Vita Word Search, Vita Block, and more.
Why Choose Vita Solitaire?
• Large Card Design: Our large fonts and oversized cards ensure that each game is easy on the eyes. This results in an exceptional solitaire game experience, whether you're using a pad or phone.
• Classic Gameplay: Classic solitaire is one of the most addictive card games. We offer you the most classic rules and an authentic card gaming experience.
• Brain-Training Challenge: Playing our free solitaire card game enhances problem-solving skills, mental alacrity, and can even aids in a getting a better sleep, making it a truly all around beneficial puzzle card game.
• Smooth Interaction: Navigating through our intuitive card game interface is effortless. Whether you're a beginner or a seasoned veteran of solitaire, you're guaranteed to have a fantastic time in no time.
How to Play Vita Solitaire:
Playing free classic Vita Solitaire is made simple. Just tap or drag cards to arrange them how you want in descending order, with alternating numbers, colors, and suits. Moving cards to the foundation of the playing area, sorting all suits from Ace to King. For an added challenge, choose to draw one or three cards in this classic solitaire cards game.
Exclusive Vita Solitaire Card Game Features:
• Improve Your Skills: Opt for either Draw 1 or Draw 3 modes to experience the classic challenges.
• Unlimited deck of cards: There are always a new patience solitaire card game to play.
• Various Theme: Engage with different styles of cards and backgrounds under the classic gameplay.
• Useful Hint: Endless hints & undo which help you when you get stuck in the card game.
• Daily Card Challenges: Take on daily challenges, collect trophies, and improve your skills.
• Customized Card Play: Choose between portrait or landscape mode and select from a range of styles.
• Rewards for Every Game: Collect suits or numbers to complete game tasks and unlock free rewards.
• Game Statistics: Keep improving and challenging yourself during every free solitaire game.
• Weekly Card Challenges: Participate in weekly solitaire journey to win trophies.
• Multi-device: Optimized the classic games experience for both phone and pad of all shapes.
• Offline Solitaire Card Game Play: Enjoy free solitaire card game offline anytime and anywhere without wifi.
• Dynamic Card Updates: Regular updates ensure that each solitaire game free feels fresh and engaging.
• VIP Solitaire Experience: subscribe for ad-free user experience so you can focus on the classic solitaire.
• Multi-Card Games: Enjoy various card games for free such as Freecell, Spades, Mahjong Solitaire, and more.
• Thoughtful Convenience: We colorblind mode, left-handed mode, and dark mode for solitaire players in need.
Vita Solitaire is a versatile card game made for those who love classic solitaire and card games. Download this solitaire game and enjoy it now!

bluejetty:00033795:ios.description:
Dive into a world of endless fun with Solitaire Clash Infinite! Play classic Klondike Solitaire and compete in cash matches to win real cash and prizes! Download now and use your skills to earn those dollar bills!
Download for free and step into a world of diverse tournaments with REAL CASH prizes and more in cash matches! Don't miss out our secure gaming platform built on skill-based competition, ensuring a level playing field and chance to win for various skill level players.
HOW TO PLAY
-Solve the deck by moving all cards to the Foundation stacks in the same suit and ascending order (A to K).
-Stack cards in alternating colors and descending order (K to A) to sort the deck in the Tableau.
-Draw 3 cards at a time from the Stock and move them to the Tableau or Foundation.
-Solve the deck within the time limit or end the match early for a time bonus in multiplayer tournament.
High Score Tips:
-Remember the order of the cards in the Stock to plan ahead!
-The "Undo" button is there in case you make a mistake!
-The quicker you finish, the higher your score!
Play Cash Games, Win Real Cash!
-Use Gems to play free matches or participate in cash matches to win real money. Get free in-game items daily by logging in and participating in various in-game events like Scratchers, Dice Cruise, and more!
Compete in Exciting Multiplayer Tournaments
-Play in skill-based tournaments of different match modes with multiple players, where the top 3 players win prizes. The higher you rank, the bigger the prize! Practice for free before playing cash games, then choose from a variety of available prize pools to win REAL CASH and/or in-game items!
Smooth and Seamless Experience
-Each aspect of the game is crafted for a fun and addicting gaming experience! With captivating artistic designs, stunning animation effects, and a user-friendly interface, we provide a seamless and enjoyable journey for everyone.
Enjoy Safe and Secure Withdrawals
-It's safe and easy to withdraw your winnings with PayPal. We also work with trusted partners, including Apple Pay, Visa, and American Express(US only). Deposits and withdrawals are always secure and smooth.
*Cash Matches are unavailable in the following states: Arkansas, Delaware, Louisiana, Michigan and South Dakota, Maine, Indiana or U.S. territories including Puerto Rico. However, players in these states can still enjoy the fun with free card games!
*Players must be at least 18 years of age. In some jurisdictions where Cash games are unavailable, players can compete in our free games. See our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy for more information.

bluejetty:00187167:ios.name: SwiftoDo for todo.txt
bluejetty:00187167:ios.summary: SwiftoDo is a modern, powerful todo.txt app for iOS. It is a task list built specifically for the todo.txt file format, and allows you work with your existing todo.txt files via Dropbox or any data provider that integrates with the iOS 11+
bluejetty:00187167:ios.description:
SwiftoDo is a modern, powerful todo.txt app for iOS. It is a task list built specifically for the todo.txt file format, and allows you work with your existing todo.txt files via Dropbox or any data provider that integrates with the iOS 11+ Files app.
# FEATURES
- Full support for the todo.txt file format
- Dropbox sync
- Archiving completed tasks to done.txt
- Import tasks from Reminders
## Supported Todo.txt Format Extensions
- Due date tags (due:)
- Threshold date tags (t:)
- Recurring tasks (rec:+1w)
- Hidden tasks (h:1)
- Retain priority after completion (optional; two ways)
## User Interface
- Four task list styles to customize how you view your tasks
- Full file text editing mode, for when you need it
- Numerous dark and light themes
- Single or multiple task entry for new tasks
- One-touch edits to change priority, due date, etc.
- Select and edit multiple tasks from the task list with one-touch edits
- Pickers for inserting priority, projects, contexts, etc.
- Numerous sort presets, with grouping
- Powerful filtering capabilities
- Full-text search
- Undo/redo
- Hardware keyboard shortcuts
- Slide-over menu to open URLs contained in the task text
- Option to set a default priority on new tasks
## iOS 10+ Integration
- Universal app for iPhone and iPad
- Live filter split view in landscape on iPad, iPhone 6/6S/7 Plus
- Slide-over and split-screen multitasking on iPad (great for having tasks side by side with your favorite note-taking app)
- 3D Touch peek & pop and home screen quick actions
- Core Spotlight integration
- URL scheme with x-callback-url support
# ARE YOU NEW TO THE TODO.TXT FORMAT? SEE WHAT IT OFFERS:
## A task list that *you* control
Your task list is a plain text file, not some proprietary format owned by a company or locked to a specific application.
## A simple and timeless format
Plain text is the simplest file format there is. It will always be accessible, by some kind of application, forever.
## Few rules to learn
Learn only a few simple formatting rules (which SwiftoDo will take care of for you) to indicate task priority, task completion, and so on.
## A GTD-ready system
The todo.txt format was built with Getting Things Done in mind. It supports projects (which being with “+”) and contexts (which begin with a “@“).
## Use alongside any app on any platform
With Dropbox or Files app (iOS 11+ only) sync enabled, you can sync your task list with any app on any platform.

bluejetty:00045693:ios.description:
Unveiling an App-tastic experience with Adani Total Gas Application!
Experience the goodness with the upgraded version of the My Adani Gas app.
Adani Total Gas Limited has introduced add-on features to make our customer's gas connection journey hassle-free! The app is updated with new sections and options that enable users to have a complete view of their gas connection process. 
What's more? Customers can get an invoice for the connection charges, raise a query, share feedback, if any, and do much more in the elevated version.
The update is designed to make the app comprehensive and enhance customers' experience with constant assurance and indication of progress.
Other key features of the My Adani Gas app are:
Multi-lingual Support: The app is available in Hindi, English & Gujarati, so they can browse the application in their preferred language. Other features such as Online registration, 24/7 Customer Support, Quick Bill Payment, Self-Billing, Guided workflow, Nearby CNG Station, lesser loading time, bug fixes, and many more will continue to serve the customers for an enhanced user journey and experience.
24/7 Customer Support: 24/7 Customer Support by our team of experts ensures safety at all times! Adani Total Gas Ltd understands the safety-related concerns attached to the business and offers an Emergency calling feature available 24/7 for safety and support.
In case of suspected gas leakage or no gas supply, customers can call our emergency support team, and our experts will get in touch to resolve the issue and ensure safety at the earliest.
Adani Gas Online Registration: Registration can now be done from the comfort of our customer's homes! ATGL offers convenience through the new PNG connection registration feature, wherein they do not have to visit the office and go through endless paperwork for registration. Online registration has considerably reduced the steps and time involved in the registration process.
Quick Bill Payment: As the meter reading is generated, they can simply pay their gas bill that is due online without any hassle. They will also receive reminders of the due date to avoid delays or late fees.
Self-Billing: Adani Gas Bill Payment is seamless and convenient as customers can generate their bill on their own by scanning the meter reading and proceeding further to pay the bill online. We enable our customers to initiate and complete the billing process on their own without having to depend on anyone.
Nearby CNG Stations: Our customers can easily navigate to the nearby CNG station based on their location in a quick and convenient way. They can search for the nearest Adani CNG Pumps with just a click while saving time and effort and enjoying hassle-free travel.
Guided Workflow: Throughout the ATGL app, the guided workflow helps them understand and use the application as they go through the next steps while continuing to use multiple features.

bluejetty:00145037:ios.description:
Compound Interest Calculator — Investment & Savings Planner
The most complete compound interest calculator for personal finance, savings goals, and DeFi investments. Plan your financial future with precision using advanced tools that go far beyond a basic calculator.
Why Compound Interest Calc?
Whether you're building a retirement fund, planning long-term savings, or analyzing DeFi yields, this app gives you the clarity and control to make smarter financial decisions. Simulate real-world scenarios with taxes, inflation, contributions, and withdrawals—all in one place.
Powerful Calculation Engine
- Compound interest with fully customizable periods: years, months, weeks, days, or even 6-month intervals.
- Single or multiple tax brackets, including wealth tax integration.
- Advanced contributions and withdrawals with flexible scheduling.
- Inverse ROI calculator: input your initial investment, final balance, and duration to find your real rate of return.
Save, Compare & Analyze Scenarios
- Save unlimited investment scenarios and compare them side by side.
- Sensitivity analysis: instantly see how ±10-20% variations in rate, contributions, or duration affect your final balance.
- Make data-driven decisions before committing your money.
Professional Charts & Visualizations
- Pie chart: clear breakdown of principal, profits, and taxes.
- Simple vs. Compound Interest growth comparison.
- Tax vs. Inflation impact over time.
- Purchasing power chart: see how inflation erodes your real returns.
Detailed Period-by-Period Breakdown
- Track opening balance, contributions, interest earned, withdrawals, taxes, and cumulative profit for every single period.
- Export everything as a professional PDF report to share with your advisor or keep for your records.
Built for Serious Investors
- Supports decimal precision for accurate DeFi and crypto yield calculations.
Download now and take the guesswork out of compound interest. Your future self will thank you.

bluejetty:00072825:ios.name: Daylight Goals Sunlight Timer
bluejetty:00072825:ios.summary:
Start taking your sunlight seriously! Daylight Goals is the first and foremost sunlight exposure tracking app on the iPhone & Apple Watch. 
Ensure you are getting your proper UV exposure levels and how much vitamin-d you are absorbing base
bluejetty:00072825:ios.description:
Start taking your sunlight seriously! Daylight Goals is the first and foremost sunlight exposure tracking app on the iPhone & Apple Watch. 
Ensure you are getting your proper UV exposure levels and how much vitamin-d you are absorbing based on live weather conditions. Learn exactly how much time you have been exposed to the sun automatically with Apple Watch. Never miss your morning sunshine with sunrise notifications and next solar event countdown widgets. And make sure you are ready to capture the best shot with the countdown to Golden Hour.
Features:
- Automatic Daylight Exposure Tracking via Apple Watch
- Vitamin-D IU absorption estimates based on weather conditions and clothing type
- Sun timer with HeathKit integration
- Sunrise, Sunset and Daylight Time Notifications
- Sun Compass with accurate shadow angles & sun position
- Golden & Magic Hour countdowns
- Sun Exposure Charts (24 hours, 7 day, 6 weeks, and 6 months)
- Lock screen, Home Screen & Apple Watch Widgets
- Customizable minimum lux threshold - set the perfect amount of daylight for your area
- Set a minimum lux threshold to ensure only full sun minutes are counted
- Goals & Streaks to keep you motivated
- Precipitation radar to see when rain is on the way
- 10-Day & Hourly Forecasts to know the best times to get sunlight
- UV Index Chart to know when the sun is at its peak power
- Sun Path visualization to see the current azimuth angle
- Current conditions
- Weather widgets
- Sunlight Timer to keep track of how long you’ve been outdoors and automatically add it into Apple Health
Daylight Widgets
Stay up to date with how much sun exposure you are getting by keeping Daylight Goals on your home and lock screens! Add your 7 day sunlight chart to track how much time you’ve spent in the sun for the past week. New in 3.0 - check out the last 28 days widget for a beautiful grid view of your sun data.
Sunrise and Sunset Times
In the Sun Times view you can see times for Golden Hour, Astronomical Twilight, Nautical Twilight and the total available daylight for any day or any location, now including azimuth angle for even more accuracy! Use the sun path visualization to pinpoint the exact sun position with just a drag of your finger.
Sun Compass
Setup the perfect shot with the Sun Compass feature, letting you find the exact sun position and angle overlayed on a map! Check out precise shadow positions cast by accurate 3D building renderings. Or use it directly on your Apple Watch when you are out on the trails to plan the perfect sunset snap.
Full Weather Forecast
Get the full 7 day UV index forecast, or check it out hour by hour so you can always know the best time to catch some rays! In addition, get full temperature, conditions, precipitation and wind forecasts! View live & accurate precipitation radar to know how long you have to get outdoors.
Discover the Power of Sunlight:
If you are affected by SAD (Seasonal Affective Disorder) daylight Goals can help to boost your vitamin D intake by helping you reach your sun health goals. In the summer months Daylight Goals can help you ensure you aren’t getting too many rays and help to prevent sunburn. By getting morning sunlight you can get in tune with your natural circadian rhythm, which can certainly help to improve your sleeping habits.
Secure and Private:
We take your privacy seriously. All of your data is stored within the Apple Health app, where you have complete control over access. Your location data is completely optional and never leaves your device.
Daylight Goals works best when paired with an Apple Watch running watchOS 10 or later to enable automatic Time In Daylight tracking! Time in Daylight is supported on Apple Watch Series 6 and later, Apple Watch SE second generation, and Apple Watch Ultra models.
EULA: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Terms: https://daylightgoals.com/#terms
Privacy Policy: https://daylightgoals.com/#privacy

bluejetty:00069726:ios.name: myAlpha Mobile
bluejetty:00069726:ios.summary:
Access e-Banking from your mobile phone!
myAlpha Mobile was created for those of you that are always on the move, offering you the flexibility and autonomy you need to carry out your banking transactions from your mobile phone. Via myAlph
bluejetty:00069726:ios.description:
Access e-Banking from your mobile phone!
myAlpha Mobile was created for those of you that are always on the move, offering you the flexibility and autonomy you need to carry out your banking transactions from your mobile phone. Via myAlpha Mobile, you can also start banking with us or if you are already an existing Alpha Bank customer you can enroll to e-Banking.
Do you want to open your first Alpha Bank account without visiting a branch?
Now you can via myAlpha Mobile!
Get an account, a debit card and e-Banking access in a few minutes, without having to visit a Branch.
Do you need access to e-Banking?
If you have an Alpha Bank account and an active Alpha Bank card, you can register to e-Banking online, at no cost. Download the application on your mobile phone, follow the steps, and get a Username and Password to connect to e-Banking from wherever it might suit you each time! Whether that is your computer or tablet via myAlpha Web, your mobile via myAlpha Mobile or even the telephone via myAlpha Phone, banking with Alpha Bank becomes simple!
myAlpha Mobile for convenience and speed in your transactions!!
Login using a 4-digit PIN, fingerprint or FaceID (for devices that support it), find out about your products, pay bills and send money wherever you wish in minutes, now even easier, activating Push Notifications on the mobile app, the most convenient way to approve your transactions!
See what you can do via the app!
Get information on:
- the balance and activity of your products, as well as products that you hold in other Greek banks.
- your tax deduction as well as your withdrawals and daily transfer limits
- your Bonus Points via My Bonus Account
Carry out transactions such as:
- bills, credit cards and loans payments
- transfers within Alpha Bank and remittances to accounts within Greece and abroad
- e-commerce payments via QR Code scanning (IRIS Online Payments)
- commission free direct transfers to and from your mobile contacts up to Euro 500 per day, using your mobile phone number or e-mail of your contact, via IRIS Online Payments
Get online products, such as:
- myAlpha Quick Loan, a consumer loan up to 5.000€ via your mobile phone, for your daily needs
- Alpha Bank debit cards: Enter Bonus Mastercard, Enter Bonus Visa
,Enter Mastercard, Enter Visa
You may also:
- update your contact information online by uploading the necessary documents without having to visit a Branch
- pay your bills even faster with Scan 2 Pay, even using your credit cards
- manage your cards, such as temporarily block or unblock them for online or POS transactions, as well as, usage at ATMs, cancel, replace them or even request a new PIN to be sent via SMS
- add your Alpha Bank cards to myAlpha Wallet, your digital wallet.
- save your transactions on your device or e-mail yourself a copy upon completion
- cancel any pending transactions that you no longer wish to carry out
- get updates from the Bank in your Inbox
Along with:
- searching and tracking an Alpha Bank Branch, ATM or an Automated Payment System (APS) using maps and relevant route directions
- contacting us anytime for your transactions or queries
- getting familiar with the demo account
We are listening!
Our goal is to provide you with the best possible service levels. We listen to your suggestions and comments and are constantly updating the app with new features.
You can contact us at ebankingsupport@alpha.gr

bluejetty:00170893:ios.name: States Builder: Trade Empire
bluejetty:00170893:ios.summary:
► ARE YOU RESOURCEFUL ENOUGH TO BUILD A WHOLE WORLD?
It’s all about supply chains in this fun idle world-building simulator game where the aim is to develop all of human civilization one hex at a time. Log, mine, craft and process raw mate
bluejetty:00170893:ios.description:
► ARE YOU RESOURCEFUL ENOUGH TO BUILD A WHOLE WORLD?
It’s all about supply chains in this fun idle world-building simulator game where the aim is to develop all of human civilization one hex at a time. Log, mine, craft and process raw materials to earn coins, then use them to upgrade your facilities and expand your profits so you can open up more land, unlocking entire continents and eventually the whole wide world.
If you’re looking for a fun builder game with some complex strategy elements and satisfying challenges, then download States Builder now and start building your worldwide business empire.
◾ GET LOGGING: It all starts with wood – you cut trees to sell at market, then soon you’ll be able to afford a logging mill and a board factory. As you progress through the game, you’ll open up all sorts of other resources that can be processed in a variety of different ways.
◾ FEED THE CHAIN: Processed resources take longer to produce, but also make you more money. Use strategy to work out the best way to maximize your profits in the game by building varied supply chains, then watch the coins come pouring in.
◾ IMMEDIATE RETURNS: Spend profit on upgrading facilities on the map to increase your income in your current level. Each mine and processing facility has six levels, each of which increases productivity and profit. Adapt your strategy to make profits as fast as possible and move on to the next level of the game.
◾ INVEST IN THE FUTURE: You can also buy upgrades for resource production speed and greater profit. Upgrades apply to all facilities producing one type of material, and also carry across levels in the game, so you get to keep the benefits.
◾ RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT: Divert resources to equip and launch exploration balloons that will scout out new lands. Each time a balloon is launched in the game, you get coin and crystal bonuses.

bluejetty:00020602:android.description:
League of Angels: Chaos is an Action MMORPG designed to give you the RPG experience on mobile.
Ragnarok has engulfed the world in chaos and the heavens themselves have been torn asunder. You, a champion of the gods, are the last hope to bring back order and restore the realm.
Embark on your journey to become a legend!
[Game Features]
〓 Summon Angels ◆ Unleash True Power 〓
Summon forth the Angels and wield their divine power!
Each Angel possesses mighty abilities that will change the tide of battle.
Attack, Defense and Support-orientated Divine Blessings add more strategy to the combat.
〓 3 Legendary Classes ◆ Unique Combat 〓
Choose from Dragoon, Mage or Archer, each with their own skill sets and play styles.
Dragoon - Champion of justice that fights to uphold honor and the glory of his order. Wielding massive blades on each hand, he is a whirlwind of steel and death on the battlefield.
Mage - Master of the elements that controls the primal forces at his fingertips. Possessing generations of knowledge, he can unleash devastating spells on his foes.
Archer - Deadly marksman that never misses her mark. Trained by the ancient elves, her mastery of the bow is unmatched even by the gods themselves.
Plus more classes coming in future updates!
〓 Alliance Warfare ◆ Cross-Server Conquest 〓
Participate in cooperative Raids, join powerful Alliances, fight across Cross-Server battlegrounds, and claim glory for your server!
Clash in spectacular battles solo or alongside your comrades in a highly immersive combat experience!
〓 Forge Equipment ◆ Become A Champion 〓
Collect all kinds of gear, including equipment sets and Divine weapons; Craft and enhance your way to greatness!
Forge Legendary Equipment, upgrade Set Attributes, build up your power to conquer the battlefield!
Charge into battle on mythical Mounts while and illuminated Wings.
〓 Trade Freely ◆ In-depth Planning 〓
Trade to your heart’s content at the Auction House! Find the perfect equipment or make a profit playing the market!
Carefully plan your resource management to get ahead of the competition!
〓 Loot Loot and More Loot ◆ Auto Progression 〓
Every Instance, Boss, and Raid showers you with shiny loot.
Farm without lifting a finger with auto mode! Make progress even when you can’t access your phone!
Facebook: https://www.facebook

bluejetty:00162146:ios.name: Venue: Relaxing Design Game
bluejetty:00162146:ios.summary:
Venue is a relaxing interior design game where you decorate rooms, design dream homes, and build a virtual designer career, with no match-3, no timers, and no pressure.
• Style realistic spaces with hundreds of furniture, lighting, and dec
bluejetty:00162146:ios.description:
Venue is a relaxing interior design game where you decorate rooms, design dream homes, and build a virtual designer career, with no match-3, no timers, and no pressure.
• Style realistic spaces with hundreds of furniture, lighting, and decor items
• A pure room design app with no match-3, no timers, and no energy meters
• Build a designer career through client briefs and weekly themed series
• Get featured on Daily Top Designs and unlock new aesthetics in the Style Book
WHAT IS VENUE?
Venue is a free room decorating app for iPhone and iPad where players style realistic interior spaces, complete client projects, and design your room as they imagine it. One of the calmest decorating games on the store, Venue replaces match-3 and energy meters with intuitive drag-and-drop styling, soothing music, and a deep catalog of real-world decor.
WHAT MAKES VENUE DIFFERENT FROM OTHER HOME DESIGN GAMES?
Venue is one of the few home design games with no puzzles, no timers, and no daily play limits. Most popular decorating games lock progress behind match-3 or energy mechanics. Venue is built around the design itself: you spend your time styling, not solving. The catalog feels like a real interior decorating app, with textiles, lighting, and furniture modeled on current interior design trends, placing Venue among the best interior design apps for players who care about realism.
IS VENUE A GOOD GAME FOR ADULTS WHO WANT TO RELAX?
Yes. Venue is built as a calm creative home design game for adults. With soothing music, intuitive controls, and a deep library of dream room ideas, it suits evening wind-down, anxiety-friendly play, or quiet creative time. Many players use Venue the way others use coloring books: a low-stakes outlet for creativity, unlike most pressure-driven design games.
HOW DO YOU PLAY AND PROGRESS IN VENUE?
You receive a client brief, a blank room, and a curated catalog of furniture, lighting, plants, wallpapers, and textiles. Drag pieces into place, mix textures, and submit when happy. Earn rewards, unlock locations, and move through a designer career story. Weekly Limited Series, Pet Events, and the Style Book keep things fresh, setting Venue apart from generic room decoration games.
WHAT KINDS OF ROOMS CAN YOU DESIGN IN VENUE?
Venue covers living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, home offices, outdoor patios, and vacation properties from villas to cabins, penthouses, and cottages, one of the most varied games for house design available. It delivers the kind of range games about designing a house rarely offer.
WHO IS VENUE BUILT FOR?
• Adults looking for interior design games to unwind with after work
• Interior design fans who want home decor play without renovation costs
• Players tired of puzzle mechanics in other house design games
• Casual gamers who enjoy progression without competitive pressure
• iPad and iPhone users who want a polished, touch-first room decorating app
WHY PLAYERS LOVE VENUE
Updated weekly, Venue is a room decor application with content depth rare among make house games. The Daily Top Designs feed showcases community work, and the Style Book unlocks aesthetics from minimalist to maximalist.
FAQ
IS VENUE FREE TO PLAY?
Yes. Venue is free to download. The full design experience is available, and optional in-app purchases unlock premium decor items and cosmetic upgrades.
DOES VENUE HAVE MATCH-3, TIMERS, OR ENERGY?
No. Venue intentionally has none. You can redecorate a single room for as long as you want, take breaks, and return without losing progress, the core promise of these house games.
DOES VENUE WORK ON IPHONE AND IPAD?
Yes. Venue is built for both, with a touch-first interface in portrait and landscape modes, comfortable for longer home design game sessions on a larger display.
Download Venue today and start designing the dreamy rooms you have always imagined, with no pressure and puzzles. Your cozy creative escape is one tap away.
