You receive a client brief, a blank room, and a curated catalog of furniture, lighting, plants, wallpapers, and textiles. Drag pieces into place, mix textures, and submit when happy. Earn rewards, unlock locations, and move through a designer career story. Weekly Limited Series, Pet Events, and the Style Book keep things fresh, setting Venue apart from generic room decoration games.

WHAT KINDS OF ROOMS CAN YOU DESIGN IN VENUE?
Venue covers living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, home offices, outdoor patios, and vacation properties from villas to cabins, penthouses, and cottages, one of the most varied games for house design available. It delivers the kind of range games about designing a house rarely offer.

WHO IS VENUE BUILT FOR?
• Adults looking for interior design games to unwind with after work
• Interior design fans who want home decor play without renovation costs
• Players tired of puzzle mechanics in other house design games
• Casual gamers who enjoy progression without competitive pressure
• iPad and iPhone users who want a polished, touch-first room decorating app

WHY PLAYERS LOVE VENUE
Updated weekly, Venue is a room decor application with content depth rare among make house games. The Daily Top Designs feed showcases community work, and the Style Book unlocks aesthetics from minimalist to maximalist.

FAQ

IS VENUE FREE TO PLAY?
Yes. Venue is free to download. The full design experience is available, and optional in-app purchases unlock premium decor items and cosmetic upgrades.

DOES VENUE HAVE MATCH-3, TIMERS, OR ENERGY?
No. Venue intentionally has none. You can redecorate a single room for as long as you want, take breaks, and return without losing progress, the core promise of these house games.

DOES VENUE WORK ON IPHONE AND IPAD?
Yes. Venue is built for both, with a touch-first interface in portrait and landscape modes, comfortable for longer home design game sessions on a larger display.

bluejetty:00027373:ios.name: CropSize: Image Resizer Editor
bluejetty:00027373:ios.summary: CropSize is your go-to app for precise image resizing and editing. Make your photos the perfect size, composition, and quality for photo library, social media, and various projects. Enhance results with accurate color adjustments and proper
bluejetty:00027373:ios.description:
CropSize is your go-to app for precise image resizing and editing. Make your photos the perfect size, composition, and quality for photo library, social media, and various projects. Enhance results with accurate color adjustments and properly crafted metadata. Automate the entire editing process with batch processing and workflows. Share and print your creations in the right format and dimensions. All these tasks are easily achievable with CropSize—an excellent addition to your photo editing toolkit!
As an essential element of your editing arsenal, CropSize plays a distinctive role as it allows to specify exact sizes and positions for image crop and resize, where other apps offer only approximate solutions. It also provides detailed information throughout the editing process, making your experience more transparent and intuitive. Additionally, the app's ability to operate in various units of measurement can notably streamline your workflows.
With these comprehensive features, CropSize ensures you have the control you need to achieve your editing goals:
PHOTO CROP
• Crop photos in Standard and Inverse Crop modes, using pixels, inches, centimeters, or percentages
• Adjust the size and position of the crop frame using gestures or by entering values on the keyboard
• Rotate images smoothly within a 0-360° range with a slider or specify rotation angle via keyboard (Long press slider)
• Change the crop aspect ratio using customizable presets (Long press Ratio button)
• Adjust the crop position and size by one pixel in correction mode (Tap a marker)
• View crop-specific image details, including size, position, rotation, and estimated file size
IMAGE RESIZE
• Resize images in Stretch, Insert, Clip, and Canvas Size modes, using pixels, inches, centimeters, or percentages
• Specify exact image size via the keyboard or customizable presets, up to 9000 x 9000 pixels (81 megapixels)
• Resize proportionally with a percentage slider or specify the relative size via the keyboard (Long press slider)
• Adjust position using gestures and one-pixel corrections for Insert, Clip, and Canvas Size modes
• Preview changes in actual size
• View resize-specific image details, including size, offset, and estimated file size
PHOTO FILTER
• Apply any combination of photo filters and effects, including Chrome, Bloom, Vignette, Sepia, Sharpen, Blur, and more
• Adjust filter intensity using a slider or horizontal on-screen gestures
• View changes Before / After using two-finger gestures
BATCH PROCESSING & WORKFLOWS
• Edit multiple photos simultaneously, applying the same combinations of crop, resize, color, orientation, and metadata changes to all of them
• Use workflows by saving entire editing sessions as reusable Programs on the History screen, and accessing them from the Load screen
• Edit up to 50 photos shared with CropSize from other apps or the Photo Library
PHOTO METADATA
• View image details on the Load and Metadata screen
• Update photo DPI and creation date
• Provide information and copyrights using up to 25 fields of IPTC metadata
• Remove original GPS, EXIF, TIFF, and JFIF details from your photos
• Create and manage multiple metadata profiles for better organization
IMAGE ORIENTATION:
• Flip and rotate images using one-finger swipe gestures on the Main and Batch Processing screen
SHARE AND PRINT:
• Choose export formats: Auto, PNG, TIFF, JPEG, and HEIC, with compression quality for JPEG and HEIC
• Specify metadata settings using one of your previously created metadata profiles
• Configure export filenames using original values, custom entries, or filename patterns
• Save images to the Photo Library, automatically organizing Results and Originals into a convenient album structure
• Print multiple photos on A4, Letter, and other page sizes using exclusive “Print Plus” option from sharing menu
GUIDES
• Explore our step-by-step guides: https://www.cropsize.com/guides
• Watch the video overview of main features: https://vimeo.com/188002923

bluejetty:00136674:ios.description:
If you deal with painful periods, mood swings, PMDD, PCOS, endometriosis, or mystery symptoms that disrupt your life, you're not alone, and you don't have to just "deal with it."
Aavia helps you understand your pain, find what actually works, and advocate for the care you deserve. Track your patterns, get personalized relief recommendations, and finally connect the dots between your symptoms and your cycle.
Proudly women & AAPI-owned. For all people with ovaries. Built with leading OBGYNs.
YOUR PAIN DESERVES ANSWERS:
* Identify patterns - Track pain, mood, energy, symptoms & more to see what's really going on
* Get relief recommendations & perks - Science-backed tips for nutrition, movement, supplements & products tailored to YOUR body 
* Forecast bad days - Predict when symptoms are coming so you can plan ahead
* Advocate with data - Insights to show doctors what you're experiencing (no more "it's normal")
* Learn what's normal vs. common - Cycle School teaches you what pain you shouldn't ignore
* Connect with community - Participate in moderated, public discussions about reproductive health and cycle symptoms. No direct messaging.
FIGURE OUT IF IT'S MORE THAN “JUST” CYCLE SYMPTOMS:
One minute of daily check-ins helps us spot patterns that might indicate PMDD or other conditions. Get flagged early so you can pursue diagnosis and treatment faster, not years later.
FIND WHAT ACTUALLY WORKS FOR YOU:
VIP members get personalized recommendations for managing pain, mood, sleep, and energy based on your unique patterns. From anti-inflammatory meal plans to workouts based on your cycle, discover what helps YOUR body feel better.
YOUR DATA IS YOURS:
It is our duty to keep you safe. You are in control of your personal information. Aavia does not profit from your individual health information. You can delete your account and data at any time, no questions asked.
Check out our easy-to-read privacy policy, terms and conditions, and community guidelines:
Privacy Policy: https://aavia.io/pages/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://aavia.io/pages/terms-and-conditions
Community Guidelines: https://aavia.io/pages/aavias-community-guidelines
VIP SUBSCRIPTION:
Unlock daily personalized recommendations, symptom forecasts, hormone condition screening, and more. Partner sharing via SMS included for US members.
Payment charged to Apple account at purchase confirmation. Auto-renews unless turned off 24 hours before period ends. Manage in Account Settings.
FSA/HSA plans are available. Learn if you are eligible: https://aavia.io/pages/fsa-hsa

Whether you're negotiating with foreign leaders, meeting your residents' demands, or coping with unexpected catastrophes, every decision you make will have far-reaching repercussions. The dynamic gameplay ensures that no two presidencies are the same, delivering limitless replayability and a sense of discovery.

Dive into politics, embrace the presidency, and leave your stamp on hist

bluejetty:00152742:ios.description:
Welcome to Mahjong Sort: Tile Matching, where the classic art of mahjong evolves into a mesmerizing new puzzle experience! Strategize your way through unique levels by sorting and merging tiles to create beautiful, evolved designs.
HOW TO PLAY
• DRAG & MATCH: Sort identical tiles together to make matches.
• MERGE! : Combine matching tiles to make them disappear!
• CLEAR THE BOARD: Use your wisdom to evolve all tiles and solve the puzzle.
 KEY FEATURES 
• INNOVATIVE GAMEPLAY: A fresh twist on mahjong! It's not just matching—it's merging and evolving for a deeply satisfying strategic challenge.
• RICH CULTURAL JOURNEY: Each tile you evolve unveils a piece of art and history, celebrating the heritage of mahjong.
• HUNDREDS OF BRAIN-TEASING LEVELS: Progress through expertly designed puzzles that will test your logic and foresight.
• PLAY OFFLINE, ANYTIME: No WiFi? No problem! Enjoy the game anywhere, perfect for short breaks or long journeys.
• RELAXING YET ENGAGING: Play at your own pace with no time limits. Perfect for unwinding and training your brain.
• HELPFUL BOOSTERS: Stuck? Use clever power-ups like Hints and Shuffle to get back on track.
This is more than sorting—it's a strategic evolution. Whether you're a puzzle enthusiast, a mahjong lover, or someone seeking a captivating mental workout, Mahjong Sort: Tile Matching offers a unique and beautiful experience.
Download now and begin your journey to become a merging master!

bluejetty:00031119:ios.description:
Avanti Weather, or AWeather for short, is a weather app for iDevices (iPhones, iPads, and iPods) that lets you manage weather forecasts from NOAA (the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration) and the National Weather Service (NWS) while you're on the go and away from the internet. Weather data can be downloaded for multiple locations when you have a net connection and can be viewed later whether you have a net connection or not. In addition to using the accurate NOAA/NWS forecast data, you can get the forecast for where you want it and not only for major metropolitan locations.
The app supports larger text for Accessibility.

Numberless, no expiry date or CVV on the physical card, reducing your risk of losing personal information. With the Mox Card, you can also withdraw cash at JETCO ATM for free.

+ Customer Service – your way, the VIP way

+ Don’t just take our word for it:

bluejetty:00070043:ios.description:
A story about play, connections and adventure.
====
“What a game. I love it.” – Eurogamer
“a peaceful, intelligent, and nostalgic work of art” – Games Radar
“Light Brick Studios has proven itself to be capable of great things.” – Touch arcade
“It’s a simple tale, but touching in its way. And it feeds directly into the relaxing atmosphere.” – The Verge
“an astoundingly polished debut from Lego’s new studio” -EDGE Magazine
====
Step through levels brick by brick with puzzles that ask us to sometimes follow the instructions… and sometimes to be creative and break the rules.
Builder’s Journey is a poetic puzzle that takes place in a LEGO® brick world, brought to life with the most accurately rendered LEGO® elements yet to feature on screens. Be taken through a breathtaking world filled with brick-by-brick effects, accompanied by a beautiful soundtrack.
Throughout the narrative, there will be ups and downs, challenges and celebrations. Take the time to experiment, and most importantly, to play as figuring out who we are and what we become is the Builder’s Journey.

bluejetty:00024947:ios.description:
CTCB is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with CTCB:
-Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
-Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
-Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
-Transfer money between your accounts
-Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
-Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
-View and save your monthly statements
-Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use the CTCB app, you must be enrolled as a Citizens Tri-County Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

bluejetty:00145672:ios.description:
Master the Art of Drifting!
Drift Legend invites you to embark on an adrenaline-fueled journey into the world of drifting! With three thrilling game modes and an array of customisation options, get ready to leave your mark on the asphalt.
Key Features:
- Unlock New Cars: Discover a diverse selection of high-performance vehicles waiting to hit the track. From sleek sports cars & JDM cars to futuristic hypercars, find the perfect ride to suit your style.
- Customise Your Ride: Personalise your cars with a range of customisation options. Change paint colours, upgrade spoilers, and equip new wheels to make your cars stand out from the crowd.
- Coin Shop: Need a boost? Visit the coin shop to stock up on coins and accelerate your progress. Unlock new cars and purchase upgrades to dominate the competition.
- Find Secret Cars: Keep your eyes peeled for hidden treasures scattered throughout the game. Discover secret cars tucked away in unexpected places and unlock exclusive rewards.
Three Game Modes:
1. Levels Mode: Take on a series of challenging levels, collecting coins and dodging obstacles as you race towards the finish line. Master each level and prove yourself as the ultimate drift legend.
2. Endless Mode: Hit the open road and test your drifting skills in an endless challenge. Collect as many coins as you can while avoiding obstacles and aim for the top spot on the leaderboard. How many coins can you collect?
3. Relax Mode: Need a break from the action? Drift away in Relax Mode, where you can enjoy the serene sounds of LoFi music as you cruise through the scenic sunset landscape.
Ready to unleash your inner drift legend? Download Drift Legend today!
Follow us on TikTok & YouTube for behind-the-scenes sneak peeks: @RocketFuelGames

bluejetty:00160857:ios.name: StoryZone: AI Text Adventure
bluejetty:00160857:ios.summary:
WRITE ANYTHING. YOUR STORY FOLLOWS.
StoryZone is an AI text adventure and interactive fiction app with no preset answers and no rulebook. Write your move in your own words – what your character does, what they say, or where the plot should
bluejetty:00160857:ios.description:
WRITE ANYTHING. YOUR STORY FOLLOWS.
StoryZone is an AI text adventure and interactive fiction app with no preset answers and no rulebook. Write your move in your own words – what your character does, what they say, or where the plot should go, one at a time or combined. The AI writes the next chapter from exactly those words. Or simply let the story continue. Roleplay, storytelling and reading in one place.
STORIES THAT REMEMBER
Characters remember names, promises and arguments. Choose short-term memory for quick scenes or long-term memory for stories that run for hundreds of chapters. You can see what the story remembers – and correct it.
A STORY THAT NEVER HAS TO END
Your stories have no last page. Start a new season whenever you like, jump forward in time and keep playing.
EVERY GENRE YOU LOVE
A fantasy RPG, a sci-fi saga, a murder mystery, horror, drama or slice of life – start with a scene that matches your interests, explore scenarios and characters from the community, or build everything yourself.
ROMANCE THAT TAKES ITS TIME
Slow burn, enemies to lovers, second chance or fake dating: love stories where feelings have room to grow – across chapters and seasons. You set the pace.
FANFICTION AND ORIGINAL WORLDS
Write fanfiction for your fandom, play an alternate universe (AU) or a self-insert as Y/N – or invent your own world with original characters.
YOUR CHARACTERS, YOUR TEMPLATES
Create a character once and take them into any story – as the hero or at their side. Save your setup as a template and start a new story in seconds.
YOUR LIBRARY, YOUR DAILY RITUAL
All your stories in one place – continue where you left off with one tap. A daily task, your streak, ranks and achievements make StoryZone part of your day.
READ YOUR WAY
Dark, light or sepia, adjustable text, chapters read aloud, and offline reading for the stories you already have. Available in 28 languages.
Free to start. Get more chapters with Stars – through your daily task or in the shop.
StoryZone is for adults (18+). Stories and characters shared by the community are created by users; you can report anything that breaks the rules.
Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple ID. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your App Store account settings.
Terms of Use: https://storyzone.app/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://storyzone.app/privacy/

bluejetty:00115240:ios.description:
AI Song Generator & Creator is a powerful tool for creating your own tracks in a wide variety of music genres and styles. Use your own lyrics or your favorite songs via a link to create engaging covers.
AI Song Generator & Creator uses artificial intelligence technologies to generate musical backgrounds and lyrics. Getting started is simple: add your own text or let the app handle it for you. You can also voice the track yourself — just record your voice and use it during generation.
In addition, you’ll have access to a wide selection of genres and moods. Available genres include metal, pop, blues, rock, jazz, funk, rap, classical, EDM, electronic music, and much more. Whether you’re making beats, remixing classic songs, or exploring new sounds, AI will combine lyrics with music to produce a ready-made masterpiece.
Cover Creation Feature
To create your own cover, simply copy a link and paste it into our app. Then select your personal settings. You can choose a standard male or female voice, record your own voice, or explore the large library of voices available — some resembling famous performers. Your creative possibilities are endless.
Subscription Information
Enjoy all the features of AI Song Generator & Creator with a subscription.
Payment will be charged to your iTunes account upon purchase confirmation.
Subscription renews automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
Renewal cost will be charged within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period.
You can manage or cancel your subscription in your account settings.
Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited once a subscription is activated.
If you do not cancel the subscription before the end of the trial, the selected plan will automatically activate and the corresponding amount will be charged to your account.
Terms of Use: https://telegra.ph/Terms-of-use-09-02-4
Privacy Policy: https://telegra.ph/Privacy-Policy-09-02-70

bluejetty:00131070:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00131070:ios.description:
The world’s No. 1 baby app! Understand why your baby cries more at certain times, isn't himself or herself and... what you can do to help.
During our research, which began in 1971 with Jane Goodall and the chimpanzees in Tanzania, we discovered that babies are more prone to cry and to be clingy or cranky from time to time. This behavior was shown to be related to a leap in the baby's mental development. More specifically, babies go through 10 mental leaps in the first 20 months of their life. A leap may be tough, but it's a positive thing: it gives your baby the opportunity to learn something new.
Use The Wonder Weeks app to:
- See when a leap starts and ends thanks to a personalized leap schedule
- Be automatically notified when a leap is about to start
- Learn to recognize the leaps based on the various signals your baby gives 
- Discover the new skills your baby develops with each leap
- Stimulate your baby's new skills with 77 playtime games
- Keep track of your baby's development in your personal diary
- Link the app to your partner's app to keep track of your baby's developments together
- Share your experiences and ask questions in the forum
- Watch fun and interesting videos about parenting
- Complete fun polls and find out what other parents think about certain topics
Our mission is to help parents gain confidence in the face of the greatest leap in life: having a baby. We take a candid look at parenting, shed light on all sides and are there for all parents. We can all help each other and learn from each other.
Millions of parents before you have already followed, supported and stimulated the 10 leaps in the mental development of their babies. It's not a coincidence that we have been one of the best-selling baby apps worldwide for many years!
Disclaimer: This app has been developed with utmost care. Neither the developer nor the author is liable for any damage resulting from inaccuracies or omissions in this app.

bluejetty:00028835:ios.description:
Dog Translator — dog translator and pet care
Dog Translator is a multifunctional mobile application created for dog owners who want to better understand their pet, take care of its health, and spend time in a useful and enjoyable way. The app combines entertainment and supportive features that make communication with your dog more engaging and fun.
Main features of the Dog Translator application
Dog Translator
The “dog translator” feature allows you to interpret your dog’s barking, sounds, and behavior in an entertaining format. Using special algorithms and pre-prepared sound patterns, the application “translates” dog sounds into phrases understandable to humans.
This feature is designed as a fun way to interact with your pet, better feel its mood, and strengthen the emotional bond between you and your dog.
Important: the translation feature is intended for entertainment purposes only and does not provide real or accurate translation of animal communication.
Dog training (learning basic commands)
In the Dog Translator application, you will find a dedicated dog training section that helps teach your pet basic commands and improve everyday behavior.
The app offers various video lessons and training approaches so you can choose the most suitable method based on your dog’s age, breed, and personality.
Veterinary passport
The application allows you to store a digital veterinary passport for your pet. You can keep all important medical information in one place, including:
— vaccination records
— vaccine names
— vaccination dates and revaccination schedules
This helps you stay organized, avoid missing important procedures, and maintain your dog’s health.
Reminders
The reminder feature helps you take care of your pet on time. You can create reminders related to:
— revaccination
— veterinary visits
— grooming procedures and routine health check-ups
Subscription
To access all features of the Dog Translator application, an active subscription is required. The subscription unlocks the full functionality of the app and provides the best possible user experience.

bluejetty:00166888:ios.description:
Screw Frenzy is an innovative casual game! A game that combines matching, collecting, and building together. This game is fast-paced, entertaining, and challenging!
How to play the game?
In the game, players observe the color of the toolbox and the position of the screws on the glass, unscrew the screws on the glass, and put the screws into the corresponding toolbox until all the screws are collected. Of course, each level has extra spaces for screws. Please note that if you don't have space to store screws, the level will fail! If you win the level, you can get stars and use them to renovate the room decoration.
Game features:
1. Novel Collection Mode: Each level has different collection goals, and players need to collect the correct screws into the toolbox. Clear the glass by collecting all the screws so that you can collect other glasses's screws, which tests the player's eyesight and quick reaction.
2. Diverse Level Designs: From ordinary screws to star-shaped screws, from collecting single screws to moving two screws together at the same time, and so on. The levels range from simple to complex. When you unscrew the screws and release the glass, you can relax and release the pressure instantly.
3. Efficient Prop Assistance: As the game progresses, players can unlock a variety of props, such as props for increasing holes, hammer props for breaking glass, and props for increasing toolboxes. These props can help you turn the tide at critical moments.
4. Diverse and interesting activities make your game full of randomness and constantly stimulate your interest and enthusiasm!
Screw Frenzy brings a brand new gaming experience with its unique and challenging gameplay. Download it now!

apple-macos:6788943940.description:
Type it like you'd say it. "Lunch with Sam Friday 1pm" becomes an event before you finish typing.
Chrona is the calendar Fantastical fans wanted — plus a real task system, habit tracker, and weather-aware reminders, all in one app.
Own it once for $59.99. No subscription required.
CALENDAR, DONE RIGHT
• Natural-language Quick-Add — type a sentence, get a structured event
• Month, Week, Day, Agenda, and a continuous week-scroll view
• Calendar Sets to group and filter what you see, free (no paywall)
• Works with your existing Google, iCloud, and subscribed calendars
• Native on iPhone, iPad, and Mac
A REAL TASK SYSTEM
• Projects, areas, tags, and smart lists — built for people who outgrew Reminders
• Drag tasks straight onto your calendar and time-block your day
• Multi-select, swipe actions, and a quick-capture composer that keeps up with you
HABITS THAT STICK
• Curated presets and morning/evening routines to get started fast
• See which day of the week you actually skip — not just a streak number
• Custom reminder text for the habits that need a nudge
REMINDERS THAT KNOW THE WEATHER
• Weather forecast right in the notification
• Time-to-leave alerts that account for real drive time
• A daily digest of your day, tasks, and forecast — one push, not five apps
• Persistent reminders for the things you keep snoozing
BUILT FOR PRIVACY
• Your calendar, tasks, and habits stay on your device and sync only through your own private iCloud account — no Chrona account required
• Optional AI text-capture: only when you tap to use it, your typed text is sent securely to our server to turn it into tasks, then discarded — you can always keep it fully on-device instead
• No ads, no third-party analytics, no tracking
FREE VS. PRO
Calendar, Quick-Add, Calendar Sets, and one reminder per task are free, forever. Chrona Pro ($1.99/month, $19.99/year with a 7-day free trial, or $59.99 once — own it for life) unlocks the full task system, habits, time-blocking, Smart Reminders, 10-day forecast, and more.
Chrona is built by a solo indie developer. If something's missing, tell us — we're still building.
Chrona Pro is available as a monthly subscription, an annual subscription with a 7-day free trial, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation of purchase. apple-itunes:6809084082.name: Large Text Calculator
apple-itunes:6809084082.description:
Need a calculator you can read at a glance? Large Text Calculator puts big numbers and clear results first. Short results appear especially large, while longer numbers shrink to fit the screen.
• Large, easy-to-tap buttons and a simple layout
• Addition, subtraction, multiplication, division and percentages
• Light mode, dark mode or follow your phone's theme
• Backspace, clear and gentle vibration when tapping
The basic calculator includes a banner ad. An optional one-time in-app purchase removes ads permanently and gives your calculations more screen space. No subscription. Purchases can be restored.
Made for everyday sums, whether you prefer larger text, have trouble reading small numbers or just want a straightforward calculator.
